Department-wise Vacancy Distribution:

  • Lower Division Clerk (LDC): Public Health Engineering and Water Supply (31 posts), Education - Higher and Technical Education (1 post), DC Rada Lepa (1 post), DC Itanagar Capital Region (1 post), Finance - Audit & Pension (1 post), Small Savings (1 post), Food and Civil Supplies (2 posts), Environment Forest and Climate Change (5 posts), Women and Child Development (4 posts), Urban Development and Housing (5 posts), Health and Family Welfare (2 posts), DC Tirap (3 posts), DC Siang (2 posts), Cultural Affairs - Public Libraries (2 posts), Disaster Management (1 post), DC Changlang (1 post), DC Lower Dibang Valley (5 posts), DC Tawang (1 post), Tourism (3 posts), Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (1 post), DC Upper Subansiri (2 posts), DC Namsai (2 posts), DC Upper Siang (1 post), Power (5 posts)
  • Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA): Secretariat Administration (14 posts)
  • Driver: Environment Forest and Climate Change (25 posts), Health and Family Welfare (6 posts), Food and Civil Supplies (12 posts), and various other departments

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Lower Division Clerk (LDC) - Post Code 2/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) - Post Code 3/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Driver - Post Code 4/26:
    • Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for LDC & JSA:
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) of the concerned Department with 8 (Eight) years of regular service in the grade, and possessing Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution, OR
    • Skilled Contingency Staff with minimum of 12 (Twelve) years of continuous service as skilled contingency in the concerned Department/office and possess educational qualification of Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for Driver:
    • Contingency skilled driver who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution with 10 (Ten) years of service in the concerned Department/Office, OR
    • Handyman who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass Certificate from a recognized Board/Institution with 6 (Six) years of regular service in the concerned Department/Office
  • General Eligibility:
    • The candidate must be a citizen of India
    • The educational qualification, required length of service, age, category as stipulated shall be determined as on the closing date of submission of application i.e. 25-02-2026
    • The name of the candidate should be in the certified list of eligible candidates submitted by the HoD/HoO
    • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-4
  • Salary Range: Rs. 25,500 - Rs. 81,100 Per Month
  • This pay scale is applicable for all three posts: Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Driver

Age Limit (as on 25-02-2026)

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS): Should not be more than 45 years (50 years in case of candidates belonging to APST)
    • Skilled Contingency Staff: Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
APST Candidates Rs. 150
General Candidates Rs. 200
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Nil (Exempt)
  • Payment Mode: Online only
  • The application fee is non-refundable

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date of Application 12/02/2026 (Thursday)
Closing Date of Application 25/02/2026 (03:00 PM) (Wednesday)
Tentative Date of Written Examination 29/03/2026 (Sunday)

Selection Process

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate marks in the written examination paper
    • Stage-II (Skill Test): Typing Speed Test of 35 words per minute on computer (10500 KDPH). The Typing Test is of qualifying nature only and marks will not be counted for final merit
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Technical Paper: 100 marks (50 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate in both the papers separately i.e., for Common Paper and Technical Paper
    • Stage-II (Driving Test): Qualifying nature only. Candidate shall produce a valid Driving License for appearing in the Driving Test
  • Shortlisting for Stage-2: The total number of candidates shortlisted for Stage 2 will be in 1:3 ratio (if total vacancies are 10, then 30 candidates will be shortlisted)
  • Final Merit List: Will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in written examination only. Marks in Skill Test/Driving Test will not be counted but candidates must qualify
  • Note: There is no negative marking in the examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall be summarily rejected
  • Login Credentials: Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates through e-mail & SMS to their respective e-mail addresses and mobile numbers furnished by their Departments/Offices
  • Eligibility Determination: APSSB will not entertain any representations from candidates with regards to eligibility and the same shall be determined solely by the concerned Head of Department/Office
  • Provisional Candidature: Candidature of applicants shall be purely PROVISIONAL at all stages of the recruitment process
  • Examination Centre: The Centre for the examination will be ITANAGAR
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidate will have to provide a valid Aadhar Card/Government authorized Photo Identity Card. They will have to carry the same ID card in original along with the admit card to the Examination Centre
  • Prohibited Items: Use of Calculator, Laptop, Palmtop, other digital instrument/Mobile/Cell Phone/Pager/Electronic watches etc. is not allowed. Candidates found in possession of any such gadget will be debarred from examination
  • Admit Card: Individual Admit cards will not be sent to candidates and have to be downloaded from the website www.apssb.nic.in
  • Vacancy Status: The vacancies published are provisional and subject to change. In case the vacancy position is reduced or withdrawn by the user department, the Board shall not be liable to compensate the applicant
  • No Re-evaluation: There is no provision of re-evaluation/re-checking of Answer sheet/Answer scripts
  • Board's Rights: The Board reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage, cancel part or entire examination process, change examination scheme, conduct medical test for PwBD candidates, and make any amendments as deemed necessary
  • Scribe Facility for PwBD: Facility of scribe will be provided to eligible PwBD/PwD candidates as per Government guidelines. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be provided to persons allowed use of scribe
  • Multiple Applications: In case an applicant applies multiple forms for the same post, only the latest application form shall be considered by APSSB
  • Malpractice Action: Candidates found involved in violating guidelines, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents etc. will face strict action including police action, FIR lodging and debarment from all future APSSB examinations
  • Final Selection: The Board makes provisional selection and recommends to the Indenting/User Department. The Appointing Authority verifies and satisfies about authenticity of documents before finally appointing the candidate

How to Apply

  • Eligible departmental candidates are required to apply online only through the website www.apssb.nic.in using their unique login credentials/passwords
  • Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates' respective mobile numbers & e-mail IDs by their departments
  • Application period: 12-02-2026 to 25-02-2026 (03:00 PM)
  • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply
  • Documents to be scanned and uploaded at time of online application:
    • Scanned signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (10-50 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
    • Latest/recent passport size photo (50-100 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
  • Documents to be submitted during Document Verification:
    • Recent passport size Photograph (2 copies)
    • Matriculation certificates/II issued by the Board/Institute for proof of date of birth
    • Class XII pass certificate & marksheet issued from a recognized Board/University
    • APST Certificate (if applicable)
    • Valid Driving License (for Driver post)
    • Print out of Admit Card
    • Any other documents as may be relevant
  • Shortlisted candidates will have to produce above-mentioned Certificates/Documents in original during Document Verification failing which candidature will be summarily rejected
  • The applicants are advised to fill up the application form carefully. They will not be allowed to edit/modify the details after the closing date
  • Application with incomplete or invalid details will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates are advised to keep track of the Board website www.apssb.nic.in for any latest information related to the examination
  • No request for change in date, time and centre of exam will be accepted under any circumstances

  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard. Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/documents. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/documents for providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidates will result in automatic rejection of his/her candidature.

Candidates will have to make their own arrangIndian Army DG EMEnt for lodging/boarding during conduct of all types of examination.

Aadhar Card prepared more than 10 years ago will not be accepted and identity proof should have same name as given in the application.

Selection Process for GSSC Primary School Teacher 2026

The selection process consists of THREE stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test - I (CBT-I) - Screening/Shortlisting

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 10
Test of Marathi Language 10
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 20
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

Minimum Passing Marks (CBT-I):

  • Unreserved (UR) candidates: 45%
  • OBC/PwD candidates: 40%
  • SC/ST candidates: 35%

Konkani Language Test (Mandatory):

  • Marathi Medium: Minimum 4 marks out of 10 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani Medium: Minimum 8 marks out of 20 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani language questions will appear in the first 10/20 questions
  • Only candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in Konkani will be evaluated for merit list

Shortlisting for CBT-II: 3.5 times the number of posts in each category/sub-category based on CBT-I merit

Stage 2: Computer Based Test - II (CBT-II)

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Marathi Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

Shortlisting for Class Demonstration: Twice the number of candidates in each category/sub-category based on CBT-II merit

Stage 3: Class Demonstration - 10 Marks

  • Candidates will be asked to demonstrate on a particular concept of the post for which they have been shortlisted
  • Shortlisted based on CBT-II performance
  • Carries 10 marks

Final Merit & Selection

  • Combined Score: CBT-II marks + Class Demonstration marks
  • Common merit list prepared in descending order of Combined Score
  • Selection process as per Government of Goa O.M. No.1/6/83-PER(Vol.II)Pt.(a)/143 dated 14.01.2019
  • In case of tie (equal marks): Candidate born earlier gets precedence
  • Wait list will also be prepared for each post in descending order of merit

Selection Process (Category-wise):

  1. First: PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Meritorious Sportspersons candidates shortlisted on merit and adjusted against their vertical category (UR/ST/SC/OBC/EWS)
  2. Second: Unreserved (UR) category candidates shortlisted in descending order
  3. Third: Reserved category candidates (who didn't avail age relaxation/concessions except fee) adjusted against UR if eligible on merit
  4. Fourth: Reserved category candidates (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) shortlisted separately in descending order

Important Selection Notes:

  • No Negative Marking in CBT examinations
  • CBT-I is only for screening/shortlisting (marks not counted for final merit)
  • Question type: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Compensatory time for PwD: 25 minutes for CBT-I (60 marks), 35 minutes for CBT-II (80 marks)
  • If PwD/Meritorious Sportspersons not available in their reserved category, vacancies deducted from unreserved
  • If Ex-Servicemen not available, vacancies filled by meritorious candidates
  • If reserved category candidates not available, vacancies remain unfilled

  • Maximum age: 45 years.

Application Fee

  • Examination and other processing fees are prescribed category-wise in the notification under “EXAMINATION AND OTHER PROCESSING FEES”; fee is payable only through online payment (no other mode is acceptable).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded and will not be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

Fee structure for an examination process.

  • Total Examination Fee: ₹800.00
  • Fee Breakdown: ₹100/- for examination fee and ₹700/- for processing fee.
  • Correction Fee: ₹100.00
  • Correction Window: Open for seven days, starting three working days after the closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORAS).

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 21-01-2026
Opening date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form 27-01-2026 (10:00 AM)
Closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form 27-02-2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Date for determining eligibility (Essential Qualification/Experience) 27-02-2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Correction window for rectifying errors in ORA For 7 days, commencing after 3 working days from closing date of ORA (exact dates as per notification schedule)

Selection Process

  • Mode of Selection: Computer Based Test/Written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration (or as decided by the Aayog) followed by a Typing Test, which shall be mandatory and qualifying in nature.
  • The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • Scope of syllabus:
    – Subjects of 10+2 level prescribed as per essential qualification and as notified in the advertisement.
    – Syllabus relating to Computer Science/Computer Application/IT/ITES/Information Practices prescribed as essential qualification.
    – General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric standard.
  • Skill test on computer with minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi for those who qualify screening test; skill test is of qualifying nature.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in written screening test/OMR/CBT: 45% for General category candidates and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/ Wards of Freedom Fighters; Aayog may relax qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% if required and record reasons in writing.
  • Where skill/physical test is essential, candidates will be shortlisted for such tests based on merit of MCQ/CBT as per ratios given (up to five times, specific caps for 30–40 and more than 40 posts).
  • In case of multiple-shift CBT examination, scores shall be normalized using Z-Score (Mean and Standard Deviation) method for merit preparation.
  • A category-wise waiting list/panel will be prepared, valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation by HPRCA to appointing authority; size of waiting panel depends on number of advertised posts as specified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Online Applications are invited through the official website of HPRCA (https://hprca.hp.gov.in); no offline application form will be accepted.
  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA and should carefully read instructions/terms and conditions before applying.
  • The downloaded copy of online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be brought at the time of document verification or whenever required by HPRCA.
  • Date for determining eligibility in respect of essential qualifications and experience shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of ORA.
  • Minimum and maximum age limits are reckoned as on 01.01.2026; category-wise relaxations apply only to domiciles of Himachal Pradesh as per rules.
  • Candidates must provide working mobile number and email ID in ORA and ensure their validity till completion of selection process; communication will be through SMS/e-mail and official website notices.
  • Number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease; posts of similar R&P Rules may be clubbed up to 31.05.2026 or till date of CBT/written test.
  • Benefit of reservation is admissible only to bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh; reserved category candidates from other States will be treated as General (UR) and will not get reservation/fee concession.
  • The candidate shall be eligible for appointment if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh; this condition does not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Candidates of reserved categories of other States will be treated as General (UR) and the benefit of reservation and fee concession shall not be admissible.
  • Candidates will be admitted to selection process provisionally subject to verification of eligibility at document verification stage; furnishing incorrect information may lead to rejection.
  • Detailed instructions are given for validity and use of OBC, BPL, EWS and other certificates; candidates must possess valid certificates on the last date of ORA and at document verification.
  • PwBD candidates with functional limitations may avail scribe/reader and/or compensatory time as per detailed guidelines subject to prior authorization from HPRCA and necessary documentation.
  • Disqualifications include dismissal from previous service, conviction for offences involving moral turpitude, influence in selection process, prohibited marriages and being an un-discharged insolvent, as detailed in notification.
  • HPRCA reserves the right to change terms of advertisement, rectify errors, club posts, determine criteria where eligible candidates are fewer, and to implement clarifications/instructions from Government during recruitment process.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must first sign up on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in) to create a username and password.
  • After sign-up, candidates must complete One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading recent photograph, signature and relevant supporting documents.
  • Only users with a completed profile can apply for posts; profile can be updated for changes in qualifications or contact details.
  • Candidates can view available posts on HPRCA portal and click “Apply” for the desired post (Junior Office Assistant (IT) (Job Trainee), Post Code 26001).
  • Applicants must select preferred exam district(s) from the dropdown; HPRCA reserves the right to allot any district/centre due to constraints like availability of computer nodes.
  • The system auto-fills application details from profile; candidates must review and confirm application details.
  • Candidates must pay application fee through the prescribed online payment gateway; no other mode is accepted.
  • After successful payment, the application is considered complete; candidates should ensure no column is wrongly filled or left blank and that all required documents/certificates are uploaded.
  • The notification also provides a checklist and detailed steps for uploading Matric, qualification, experience, category and other certificates, which must be produced in original at documentation.

Various other Assistant posts Electrical, S&T, Engineering, Mechanical A2/A3/B1/C1
TOTAL VACANCIES: 22195 Posts

Railway Zone-wise Distribution (Sample - Major Zones):

  • Western Railway (Mumbai): 3,166 posts
  • Northern Railway (Delhi): 3,537 posts
  • Central Railway (Mumbai): 2,157 posts
  • Eastern Railway (Kolkata): 1,078 posts
  • Other Zones: Remaining posts distributed across NFR, NER, SCR, SR, SWR, WCR, ECR, ECoR, SECR, NWR, NCR, SER

Note: Detailed Railway Zone-wise and post-wise vacancy table available in Annexure-B of the official notification. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.

Eligibility Criteria for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Educational Qualification (as on 02.03.2026):

  • 10th Pass (Matriculation/SSC/SSLC) from recognized Board, OR
  • ITI (Industrial Training Institute) certificate from recognized institute, OR
  • Equivalent qualification, OR
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT)
  • Important: Candidates waiting for final results are NOT eligible to apply
  • Diploma/Degree in Engineering will NOT be accepted in lieu of ITI/Course Completed Act Apprenticeship

Medical Standards:

Medical Standard Distant Vision Near Vision
A-2 (e.g., Pointsman B) 6/9, 6/9 without glasses (no fogging test) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 without glasses
A-3 (e.g., Assistant Track Machine) 6/9, 6/9 with/without glasses (power ≤ 2D) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses
B-1 (Most posts) 6/9, 6/12 with/without glasses (power ≤ 4D) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses
C-1 6/12, 6/18 with/without glasses Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses

Important Medical Notes:

  • Candidates must ensure they are medically fit as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM) Vol. I Chapter 5
  • LASIK surgery candidates NOT eligible for A2 & A3 medical standard posts (must submit declaration as per Annexure-VII)
  • Different medical standards for Ex-Servicemen (Para 534 of IRMM)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Age Limit for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 (as on 01.01.2026)

General Age Limits:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Born on or before 01.01.2008)
  • Maximum Age: 33 years for UR & EWS (Born on or after 02.01.1993)
  • Maximum Age: 36 years for OBC-NCL (Born on or after 02.01.1990)
  • Maximum Age: 38 years for SC/ST (Born on or after 02.01.1988)

Age Relaxation:

Category Age Relaxation
OBC-Non Creamy Layer (NCL) 3 years
SC/ST 5 years
PwBD (UR & EWS) 10 years
PwBD (OBC-NCL) 13 years (10+3)
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years (10+5)
Ex-Servicemen (UR & EWS) 3 years (after deducting military service)
Ex-Servicemen (OBC-NCL) 6 years (after deducting military service)
Ex-Servicemen (SC/ST) 8 years (after deducting military service)
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - UR/EWS Up to 40 years
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - OBC-NCL Up to 43 years
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - SC/ST Up to 45 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - UR Up to 35 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - OBC-NCL Up to 38 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - SC/ST Up to 40 years
Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) - UR/EWS Maximum 3 years (extent of apprenticeship training)
CCAA - OBC-NCL Maximum 6 years (including category relaxation)
CCAA - SC/ST Maximum 8 years (including category relaxation)
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - UR/EWS Up to 35 years
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - OBC-NCL Up to 38 years
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - SC/ST Up to 40 years

Important Notes:

  • If eligible for multiple relaxations, maximum relaxation will be given (NOT cumulative)
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL applying against UR vacancies: No age relaxation
  • PwBD applying against UR vacancies: PwBD age relaxation applicable
  • Maximum upper age limit (except Ex-Servicemen): 52 years
  • Matriculation certificate is the ONLY acceptable proof of age

Application Fee for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Category Fee Amount Refund
General, EWS, OBC-NCL (Male candidates not covered in Sl. 2) Rs. 500/- Rs. 400/- (after deducting bank charges) - on appearing in CBT
SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities, Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250/- Full Rs. 250/- (after deducting bank charges) - on appearing in CBT

Payment Mode: Online only through Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI (all service charges borne by candidate)

Payment Deadline: 04.03.2026 up to 23:59 Hrs

Important Notes on Fee:

  • Fee refund (minus bank charges) will be credited ONLY to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
  • No refund for incomplete/rejected applications or candidates not appearing in CBT
  • Applications without prescribed fee will be summarily rejected
  • Minorities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Zoroastrians (Parsis) - must submit affidavit at DV
  • EBC: Family income < Rs. 50,000/- per annum (valid EBC certificate/BPL card/Izzat MST required)
  • Note: EBC, EWS, and OBC are three DIFFERENT categories. EBC eligible for fee concession only (NOT job reservation)

Important Dates for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Event Date & Time
Indicative Notice in Employment News 27.12.2025
Online Application Start Date 31.01.2026 (00:00 Hrs)
Online Application Closing Date 02.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Fee Payment Last Date 04.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Application Modification Window (with Rs. 250/- fee) 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Scribe Details Entry Window (for eligible PwBD candidates) 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
Computer Based Test (CBT) - Tentative Will be notified on RRB websites
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Will be notified on RRC websites
Document Verification (DV) Will be notified on RRC websites
Medical Examination (ME) Will be notified on RRC websites

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 02 Project Research Scientist I, Project Technical Support III Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official PGIMER website. The last date to submit the application form is 10-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the PGIMER Project Research Scientist I, Project Technical Support III Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

PGIMER Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) & Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER)
Post Name Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) & Project Technical Support III
No of Posts 2
Salary As per ICMR rules
Qualification Post graduate degree in Life Science/ Pharmacology or allied subjects from a recognized university
Age Limit 35 years
Last Date for Apply 10/02/2026

Vacancy Details

Post Name Total
Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) 1
Project Technical Support III 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical)
    • Essential Qualification: Post graduate degree including integrated PG degree in Life Science/ Pharmacology or allied subjects from a recognized university.
    • Desirable Qualification:
      1. Candidates who have qualified NET/GATE or an equivalent examination.
      2. Those possessing hands-on experience in Molecular biology techniques such as RT-PCR & genome sequencing, LCMS/HPLC techniques.
      3. At least 1 year of experience in health research preferably involving hospital-based study.
      4. Prior experience in ICMR/DST/DBT/other funded projects
      5. Knowledge of data analysis using SPSS/Stata/R.
      6. Familiarity with ICMR ethical guidelines, GCP and project coordination and fluency in English, Hindi and Punjabi
      7. Good communication and team coordination skills in managing hospital level liaison.
  • Project Technical Support III
    • Essential Qualification: Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences/Pharmacology or allied subjects from a recognized university or Bachelor's degree in Pharmacology/Life sciences or allied subjects from a recognized university with three years of experience.
    • Desirable Qualification:
      1. Preference will be given to candidates having hands on experience in LCMS/HPLC technique and molecular biology techniques.
      2. Knowledge of Biostatistics and Bioinformatic analysis.
      3. Familiarity with ICMR ethical guidelines, GCP and project coordination and fluency in English, Hindi and Punjabi

Salary/ Stipend

  • Emoluments per month: As per ICMR rules.

Age Limit (as on 10-02-2026)

  • Upper Age limit: Not exceeding 35 years
  • Relaxation will be given as per rules

Important Dates

Last Date for Submission of Application 10-02-2026, 5:00PM

Selection Process

  • Shortlisted candidates shall be invited to appear for interview along with original certificates/ degrees/ marksheets.

General Information / Instructions

  • The engagement in the project is purely on a temporary basis maximum for the period of duration of the project.
  • However, appointments will initially be offered for a period of one year and to be extended on a yearly basis depending upon satisfactory performance and co-terminus with the project.
  • Please note that it is not a PGIMER/ICMR appointment and will not confer any right on the incumbent to any claim implicit or explicit on any position.
  • The correspondence will be through email and/or mobile phone. It is the responsibility of the candidate to ensure that the provided contact details are legible and correct.
  • No separate interview letters will be sent. No TA/DA will be paid.
  • Candidates are encouraged to submit a letter of recommendation from previous employers/ mentors in support of their application

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the above conditions should submit their complete bio-data and photograph along with attested copies of academic degrees, marksheets, certificates in support of date of birth, qualification, experience, skills, trainings by 10-02-2026, 5:00PM in the office of the undersigned at Department of Pharmacology, Room No 4016, 4th Floor, Research Block - B, PGIMER Chandigarh - 160012.
  • An advance copy should be emailed to [email protected].

Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

  • For Tailor & Dresser: 18-40 years (Applicants born not before 01-01-1986 and not later than 01-01-2008)
  • For Nurse, Craft Instructor, Craft Helper, Yoga Instructor, Yoga Instructress & Pharmacist: 21-40 years (Applicants born not before 01-01-1986 and not later than 01-01-2005)

    • SC, ST (P) and ST (H): 5 years

  • There will be no Application Fee.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 16 January 2026
Online Application Start Date 22 January 2026
Online Application Last Date 22 February 2026
Edit Option Available 5 days from the last date of submission (only once and subject to SLPRB approval)

Selection Process

  • Medical Examination
  • Physical Standard Test (PST) - No marks, qualifying in nature
  • Trade Proficiency Test (TPT) - 50 Marks (33% qualifying marks)
  • Preliminary Identity Verification using Admit Card and Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Driving Licence etc.)
  • Biometric verification before appearing in PST & TPT and at the time of exit
  • Final merit lists will be prepared based on marks scored in the Trade Proficiency Test
  • In case of tie in marks, older applicants will be placed higher; if same date of birth and equal marks, higher height will be considered

Physical Standards

Standard General/OBC/MOBC/SC ST (P)/ST (H)
Height (Male) 160 cm 158 cm
Height (Female) 150 cm 147.5 cm
Chest (Male) - General/OBC/MOBC/SC/ST(P) Min. 80 cm + 5 cm expansion
Chest (Male) - ST(H) Min. 77 cm + 5 cm expansion
Weight Proportionate to height and age as per Medical Standards

Physical Fitness

  • Must have sound health both mentally and physically and free from organic defect or bodily infirmity likely to interfere with the efficient performance of duty.
  • Shall be required to undergo medical examination before appointment to the service.
  • Weight: Proportionate to height as per medical standard.

Medical Standards

  • Applicant must be in good mental and bodily health and free from physical deformities.
  • Must be free from diseases such as diabetes, heart disease, hernia, piles, respiratory diseases, knock-knee, flat foot or any other physical deformity.
  • Should not be colour blind or squint eyed.
  • Eye Sight: Distance vision should be 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for the other without correction. Near vision should be normal.
  • Varicose vein shall be considered as temporary disqualification.

General Information

  • The present number of vacancies is tentative in nature and subject to final clearance by the Government.
  • Vacancies are subject to change and may increase or decrease at any time/stage of recruitment process.
  • Applicants must register in the application portal only once for all Advertisements. Multiple Application IDs using different mobile numbers will lead to cancellation.
  • Applicants must register with their name exactly as per Class VI/Class VIII/HSLC Certificate/Birth Certificate.
  • No document will be accepted after completion of PST & TPT. All documents should be issued on or before 22-02-2026.
  • No TA/DA will be admissible to Applicants for journey and stay during any stage of recruitment.
  • Incomplete/defective/invalid applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Appointees will have to sign an agreement to serve a minimum period of 3 years or refund the cost of training and travelling expenses.
  • Selected Applicants will be required to join and work in any District or Unit anywhere in the State of Assam.
  • Final appointment is subject to satisfactory Police Verification Report and Final Medical Examination Report.
  • CCTV will be installed for recording each event of PST and Trade Proficiency Test.

How to Apply

  • Register on the application portal with valid mobile number and accurate information including Employment Exchange Number, Highest Qualification, District, Gender, Caste/Category, Date of Birth, and Aadhaar Number.
  • After successful registration, an Application ID will be generated.
  • Login using Application ID or Registered Mobile Number along with Date of Birth.
  • Apply for the relevant Advertisement and upload necessary documents including passport size photograph (max 450 KB in JPEG/JPG/PNG), digital signature (max 100 KB), proof of age, educational certificates, experience/training certificates, Employment Exchange Registration Card, Aadhaar Card, and Caste Certificate (if applicable).
  • Select post preferences (if applicable).
  • Fill in personal details and enter academic details carefully.
  • Generate OTP and download the Acknowledgement Slip.
  • Detailed instructions regarding uploading of documents and filling up online application will be available at SLPRB website.

The Government of Assam, Department of School Education has announced the Special Assam Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) 2026 for candidates aspiring to become teachers in Lower Primary (LP) and Upper Primary (UP) level schools. This special examination is being conducted exclusively for Bodo, Garo, Manipuri, and Hmar medium schools to address the shortage of Language-1 teachers in these mediums across the state.

The notification, numbered 740235/1562055 and dated January 6, 2026, invites online applications from permanent residents of Assam under the provisions of Section 23 of the RTE Act 2009 and NCTE guidelines.

Eligibility Criteria for Special Assam TET 2026

Basic Eligibility Requirements

A. Residency: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam.

B. Academic and Professional Qualifications: Candidates must meet NCTE-prescribed minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualification for Lower Primary TET (Classes I to V)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  3. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education)
  4. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education

Minimum Qualification for Upper Primary TET (Classes VI to VIII)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. At least 50% marks in Graduation + B.Ed.
  3. At least 55% marks in Post Graduation (or equivalent grade) + 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.
  4. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  5. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year B.A./B.Sc. Ed. or B.A. Ed./B.Sc. Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks + 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education)

Important Note: Minimum percentage requirements in graduation do not apply to candidates who took admission to B.Ed. or B.El.Ed. or equivalent courses before July 29, 2011.

Relaxation in Eligibility

  • 5% relaxation in academic marks (HSSLC or Graduation) for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) candidates
  • PWD candidates must have a minimum 40% degree of handicap certified by competent authority

Exam Pattern and Structure

Paper I - Lower Primary (Classes I to V)

Subject Questions Marks
Child Development & Pedagogy (Compulsory) 30 MCQs 30
Language I – Bodo/Garo/Manipuri/Hmar (Any one) 30 MCQs 30

Mathematics (Compulsory) 30 MCQs 30
Environmental Studies (Compulsory) 30 MCQs 30
Total 150 MCQs 150

Paper II - Upper Primary (Classes VI to VIII)

Subject Questions Marks
Child Development & Pedagogy (Compulsory) 30 MCQs 30
Language I – Bodo/Garo/Manipuri/Hmar (Any one) 30 MCQs 30
Language II – English (Compulsory) 30 MCQs 30
Mathematics & Science OR Social Science (Studies) 60 MCQs 60
Total 150 MCQs 150

Exam Duration: 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) for each paper Additional Time: 20 minutes per hour for visually impaired candidates Marking Scheme: Each question carries 1 mark Negative Marking: No negative marking

Qualifying Marks for Special Assam TET 2026

For General Category Candidates

  • Overall: 60% (90 marks out of 150)
  • Language-1 Section: 60% (18 marks out of 30)

For SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) Candidates

  • Overall: 55% (83 marks out of 150) - 5% relaxation
  • Language-1 Section: 50% (15 marks out of 30) - 10% relaxation

Both conditions must be satisfied to qualify the examination.

Examination Fee Structure

Paper Category Fee
Paper I General ₹550
  SC/ST(P)/ST(H)/OBC/MOBC ₹450
  PWD(PH) ₹300
Paper II General ₹550
  SC/ST(P)/ST(H)/OBC/MOBC ₹450
  PWD(PH) ₹300

Important:

  • Candidates appearing for both papers must pay fees separately for each
  • Payment mode: Online only (net banking/credit card/debit card)
  • Fees once paid are non-refundable

Exam Centers

Candidates must select one center district from the following options:

  1. Cachar
  2. Dibrugarh
  3. Kokrajhar
  4. Kamrup
  5. Kamrup Metro
  6. Hojai
  7. Sonitpur

Application Process

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: https://sebaonline.org
  2. Read instructions carefully for submitting the online application
  3. Fill the application form with accurate details
  4. Upload documents:
    • Recent passport-size color photograph
    • Signature
    • Pass certificate of professional qualification
    • (Size specifications as mentioned in instructions)
  5. Pay examination fee through online banking/credit card/debit card
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference

Important Application Guidelines

  • Portal opens on January 7, 2026
  • Exact dates for application submission and admit card release will be notified separately
  • Incomplete forms will be summarily rejected
  • No corrections will be entertained after submission
  • Carefully verify all details before final submission

Medium of Question Papers

The question papers will be available in the following languages:

  • Assamese
  • Bengali
  • Bodo
  • English

Important Links

  • Official Notification: Click Here
  • Apply Online: Click Here

Validity of Certificate

The Special Assam TET 2026 certificate will remain valid for lifetime from the date of issue by the Empowered Committee, TET, Government of Assam (unless otherwise notified by the appropriate government).

Important Points to Remember

  1. No Automatic Appointment: Qualifying the Special Assam TET 2026 does not confer automatic right to appointment. Teacher recruitment in government/provincialized schools is a separate process conducted when vacancies arise.
  2. Document Verification: No document verification during examination. However, documents will be thoroughly verified during the teacher engagement process. False information can lead to criminal liability.
  3. State-Specific Validity: Qualified candidates can participate in teacher recruitment processes only in Assam.
  4. TET as Qualifying Criteria: TET is one of the qualifying criteria for teacher recruitment. Candidates must also meet other academic and professional qualifications as per NCTE norms.
  5. Both Papers: Candidates intending to appear in both Paper I and Paper II must submit separate applications and pay fees for each paper separately.
  6. Regular Updates: Candidates should regularly visit the official websites for updates on application dates, admit cards, and examination schedules.

The Special Assam TET 2026 is a significant opportunity for aspiring teachers in Bodo, Garo, Manipuri, and Hmar medium schools. This examination addresses the critical shortage of Language-1 teachers in these mediums across Assam. Eligible candidates should prepare thoroughly by reviewing the syllabus, understanding the exam pattern, and ensuring they meet all eligibility criteria before applying.

For Forester Grade-I (Total 150 marks):

  • PET: 40 marks + Written Test: 50 marks + NCC: 5 marks + Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks

For Boatman, Bandman & Bugler (Total 110 marks):

  • PET: 40 marks + Written Test: 50 marks + NCC: 5 marks + Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks + Swimming/Trade Test: 10 marks

  • Advertisement Number: R&D/1249/UMW/541
  • Principal Investigators: Dr. M. Selvam and Dr. Koushik Roy, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Patna

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
  • Minimum 70% marks in B.Tech examination OR minimum 7.5 CPI on a 10-point scale.
  • Candidates should meet or exceed the required percentage/CPI.

Age Limit

Desirable Qualifications

Other Requirements

Position Monthly Stipend
Research Assistant (RA) Rs. 30,000 (Consolidated)
  • Nature of Stipend: Consolidated Rs. 30,000 per month.
  • Payment Mode: Monthly disbursement.
  • Total Duration: 6 months (01-03-2026 to approximately 31-08-2026).
  • Total Compensation: About Rs. 1,80,000 for the complete 6-month period.
  • No additional allowances or benefits beyond the consolidated amount.
  • No permanent employment benefits or guarantee.

Application Procedure

  1. Download the application form (Form No: RD-M003) from the official notification or IIT Patna website.
  2. Fill the application form completely with all required information.
  3. Prepare an updated resume/CV with all qualifications and experience.
  4. Gather self-attested scanned PDF copies of all supporting documents.
  5. Compile the filled form, resume, and all documents for email submission.
  6. Send the email to both investigators before the deadline.

Required Documents (Self-Attested Scanned PDF)

  • Duly filled application form (Form No: RD-M003) with applicant's signature.
  • Updated resume/CV.
  • 10th class mark sheet and certificate.
  • 12th class mark sheet and certificate.
  • B.Tech degree certificate.
  • B.Tech mark sheets (all semesters).
  • GATE scorecard (if qualified).
  • Research publications/papers (if any).
  • Category/caste certificate (if applicable).
  • Proof of identity (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport).

Important Instructions

  • Email must include the duly filled application form with applicant's signature.
  • All supporting documents must be self-attested scanned PDF copies.
  • Incomplete applications or those without complete documents will not be shortlisted.
  • IIT Patna reserves the right to reject applications that lack complete information or supporting documents.
  • Subject line of the email must exactly read "Research Assistant(RA)".
  • Keep original copies of all documents ready for verification during the interview.

  1. Stage 1 – Application Screening: Verification of application completeness and eligibility criteria.
  2. Stage 2 – Shortlisting: Based on academic performance, GATE score (if any), and research profile.
  3. Stage 3 – Online Interview: Only shortlisted candidates will be called.
  4. Stage 4 – Final Selection: Based on interview performance and overall merit.

  • Fulfillment of eligibility criteria (B.Tech Civil, 70% marks/7.5 CPI, age ≤ 28 years).
  • Overall academic merit and performance in B.Tech.
  • Valid GATE qualification is an added advantage.
  • Research publications in SCI/Scopus journals are advantageous.
  • Completeness of application with all supporting documents.

Nature of Appointment

  • Time-bound research position for 6 months only.
  • Contractual appointment with consolidated stipend.
  • No claim for permanent employment or continuation after project completion.
  • Position is project-specific and subject to project continuation/funding.

Service Conditions

  • Candidate must work full-time on the assigned project.
  • Must maintain confidentiality of project data and information.
  • Must follow IIT Patna rules, regulations, and code of conduct.
  • Must adhere to all laboratory safety protocols.
  • Stipend is subject to satisfactory performance and regular attendance.

Post-Project Status

  • No obligation on IIT Patna to provide further employment after project completion.
  • No permanent employment rights or benefits.
  • Experience certificate will be provided upon successful completion.
  • Certificate of participation in the research project may be issued if requested.

  • Ineligibility: Candidate married before minimum marriage age; male with more than one living wife or female married to such male; not medically fit; not suitable after inquiry; convicted of offense against women.

How to Apply

  • Minimum qualification for both posts: 10th Standard Pass from a recognized board/institution.

  • All educational certificates must be from recognized boards or institutions.

Residence / Domicile Requirement

  • Applicant must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh.
  • Valid Residence/Domicile Certificate issued by competent authority is mandatory.

Other Important Eligibility Conditions

  • Reserved category candidates must attach permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
  • Candidates who married before attaining the minimum legal marriageable age are not eligible.
  • Government / Semi-government employees must apply through proper channel and enclose a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.

  • Preparation of merit list based on: Educational qualification marks – 80 marks, Experience – up to 10 marks, Skill Test – 10 marks.

Outreach Worker

  • Candidates will be shortlisted according to merit for interview/skill test as per department decision.

Tie-Breaking Rules

  • If two or more candidates obtain equal total marks, preference will be given to the candidate older in age (based on date of birth).

Experience Requirements

  • Experience certificates must be issued by the employer on official letterhead with office name, registration number, address, post name, nature of work, and duration/period of experience clearly mentioned.

  • Experience marks: 2 marks per completed year of relevant experience, subject to a maximum of 10 marks.

  4. Attach mandatory documents: Enclose self-attested copies of residence/domicile certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), all educational certificates and mark sheets, age proof (Birth Certificate or 10th mark sheet), and experience certificates as required.

  6. Verify mobile number and email ID: Ensure your active mobile number and email ID are clearly written in the form for communication regarding merit list, skill test, or interview.

Application Submission Address

Send/submit the application to the following address:
District – Balodabazar-Bhatapara, Chhattisgarh
Phone: As mentioned in the official advertisement.

  • All posts are purely contractual for 3 years under Mission Vatsalya Yojana with no claim for permanent government service.

  • Selected candidates must join and report with original documents within 15 days from the date of issue of appointment order.
  • Eligible candidates shortlisted on merit will be informed regarding further process through phone and/or email provided in the application form.
  • The decision of the Collector/District authorities will be final and binding in case of any dispute or interpretation regarding recruitment.
  • Age, educational qualification, and experience will be considered strictly as on 01.01.2026.
  • Any form of canvassing, recommendation, or influence will lead to disqualification of the candidate.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per Chhattisgarh Public Service (Reservation) Act, 1994 and related government orders.
  • Only local residents of Chhattisgarh fulfilling domicile conditions are eligible to apply for these posts.

In this article, you’ll find the Ekta Mahila CLO Kuakonda IFC Anchor Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

Ekta Mahila CLO Kuakonda IFC Anchor Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Ekta Mahila Cluster Level Organization (Ekta Mahila CLO Kuakonda)
Post Name IFC Anchor
No of Posts 1
Advt No 58 / CLF-IFC/2026
Salary 30,000/-
Qualification Degree/Post Graduate in Agriculture, Horticulture and related subjects from a government recognized university.

Start Date for Apply 28/01/2026

Vacancy Details

Post Name Number of Posts
IFC Anchor 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Degree/Post Graduate in Agriculture, Horticulture and related subjects from a government recognized university.
  • Minimum 01 year experience in field level agriculture and animal husbandry based livelihood work after the prescribed educational qualification.
  • If candidates as per column 2 and 3 are not available, then regular degree/post graduate degree from a government recognized university along with 02 years experience in rural level and agriculture related work is desired.
  • Priority to experience in rural supervision and marketing.
  • Capable of working in Hindi and English language as well as knowledge of local language.
  • Proficient in computer and MS Office, Hindi and English typing.
  • Proficiency in report writing and data management.
  • Own vehicle (two-wheeler) with all necessary documents for field visits.

Salary / Stipend

  • One time monthly honorarium (Rs.) 30,000/-
  • Travel allowance (Rs.) 3,000/-

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • The age of the candidate as on 01 January 2026 should be more than 21 years and less than 45 years.

Important Dates

Application starting date 28/01/2026
Last date 12/02/2026 till 5:00 PM evening

Selection Process

  • Selection process will be as per the guidelines.

General Information / Instructions

  • Resident - Must be original resident of Chhattisgarh state/district.
  • IFC Anchor honorarium will be released from the provisioned IFC budget by the Nodal CLF.
  • The appointment of IFC Anchor will be completely temporary, which can be extended for the next year based on evaluation as per the need of the project. If CLF wishes, the appointment period can be increased beyond IFC.
  • The decision of the evaluation committee will be final.
  • After appointment of IFC Anchor, there will be minimum 01 month probation period. After evaluation of work in the said period, appointment period will be extended for 11 months. Also, after completion of 01 year of appointment, appointment can be extended for the next 01 year based on review of work by the committee constituted under CLF on the basis of obtaining minimum 75 percent score in various KPIs.
  • Candidates who have been separated from Chhattisgarh Livelihood Promotion Committee or any other government department on the basis of service indiscipline/improper behavior/arbitrariness or irregularity in any post will not be eligible for selection. If wrong information is given, the candidature will be considered cancelled.
  • Incomplete/unclear and erroneous application forms will be cancelled. And no information will be given.
  • Candidates who have married before the minimum prescribed age for marriage will not be eligible for appointment.
  • Candidates who have married a person who already has a living husband/wife will not be eligible. In such cases, the government can take a different decision, i.e., if the government is satisfied that there is sufficient reason for doing so, exemption can be granted from this prohibition.
  • If the candidate directly or indirectly creates any kind of obstruction in the appointment process or tries to influence, the candidature of the candidate can be cancelled.
  • The right to take final decision on any dispute and problem arising during the recruitment process will remain with the appointing Cluster Organization.

How to Apply

  • Applications can be sent by registered post to the address - Office, Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Kuakonda (NRLM Branch), District Dantewada, Chhattisgarh from starting date 28/01/2026 to last date 12/02/2026 till 5:00 PM evening.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official District Panchayat Mahasamund website. The last date to submit the application form is 20-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the District Panchayat Mahasamund Regional Coordinator, Accounts cum MIS Assistant Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

DPM Regional Coordinator & Accounts cum MIS Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name District Panchayat Mahasamund (Chhattisgarh) (DPM)
Post Name Regional Coordinator & Accounts cum MIS Assistant
No of Posts 4
Advt No No./613/NRLM/Z.P./2025-26
Salary Rs. 23,350 - 26,490
Qualification Graduate + Computer Diploma + Experience
Age Limit 21 to 35 years
