DPM Regional Coordinator & Accounts cum MIS Assistant Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts Reservation Details
Regional Coordinator 02 Unreserved – 01
OBC – 01
Accounts cum MIS Assistant 02 ST – 01
OBC – 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: For Regional Coordinator - Graduate from recognized university
  • For Accounts cum MIS Assistant - Graduate in Commerce from recognized university
  • Essential qualifications: One year diploma/certificate in computer from recognized institution/university; For Accounts cum MIS Assistant - One year diploma and tally certificate in computer
  • Desirable: Knowledge of computer operations

Salary/Stipend

  • Regional Coordinator: Rs. 26,490 per month
  • Accounts cum MIS Assistant: Rs. 23,350 per month

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 35 years

Important Dates

Notification Date 05/02/2026
Start Date for Application 05/02/2026
Last Date for Application 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Merit based on weightage of marks in Graduation (35), 12th (20), 10th (20)
  • Additional marks for experience beyond minimum: 02 per year max 10
  • Marks for experience in Chhattisgarh State Rural Livelihood Mission: 01 per year max 05
  • Written/Skill Test (10 marks)

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications will be accepted in the prescribed format in a sealed envelope from 05.02.2026 to 20.02.2026 during office hours only.
  • All educational and experience related documents (self-attested) copies along with registered/speed post must be sent to Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Mahasamund-493445 by 20.02.2026.
  • Applications received through any other means will not be accepted, and applications received after the date will not be considered.
  • For more than one post, separate applications must be submitted. The envelope must clearly mention the applied post and category name.
  • Two blank envelopes with Rs.5 postage stamp and self-address must be attached with each application.
  • Age minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years. Relaxation in age limit as per General Administration Department instructions for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories.
  • Age calculation based on 01 January, 2026.
  • Permanent caste certificate issued by competent authority will be valid.
  • Applicant must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh state. Self-attested copy of residence certificate issued by competent authority must be attached.
  • Applicant's photo and self-attested photocopies of all listed certificates and documents must be attached.
  • Experience certificate (related to the applied post's qualification) only from government/semi-government/government funded/government subsidized non-government institutions will be valid.
  • Experience beyond described in the advertisement will not be accepted.
  • At the time of application, the experience certificate must include the issuing institution's full address, office outward number, date, issuing officer's name, designation, contact phone number, and email.
  • For non-government institution experience, continuous 6 months pay slip and certified bank statement must be submitted.
  • If the number of applications is high, for skill test, 10 applicants per post will be called based on priority.
  • Appointment to the highest scorer combining educational qualification, experience, and skill test marks.
  • Waiting list for one year for lower scorers.
  • If marks sheet has grades instead of percentage, average percentage of the grade will be given.
  • In claims/objections after preliminary list publication, no new certificates will be accepted.
  • Only clerical errors will be corrected in claims/objections.
  • For equal marks, older candidate will be preferred.
  • Employed applicants must submit through proper channel with no objection certificate.
  • Applicants previously removed for indiscipline etc. from Chhattisgarh Livelihood Promotion Society or any government department are ineligible.
  • Incomplete/unclear/erroneous applications will not be considered.
  • Applicant who married before minimum age for marriage is ineligible.
  • Appointee must submit medical fitness certificate from registered doctor.
  • Candidate married to a person with living spouse is ineligible unless exempted by government.
  • Number of posts is variable.
  • If applicant attempts to influence the process, candidature can be canceled.
  • Contract appointment for one year, extendable based on performance etc.
  • General Administration Department memo dated 31 December 2012 conditions apply for contract appointment.
  • Leave entitlement as per Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules 2012.
  • Governed by Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules 1965.
  • Appointment can be terminated by either party with one month notice or one month salary.
  • No pension, gratuity, or death benefits after service termination.
  • Final decision on any dispute by Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Mahasamund.

How to Apply

  • Submit application in prescribed format with self-attested documents via registered post/speed post to Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Mahasamund - 493445 by 20/02/2026.
  • Separate application for each post.
  • Mention post and category on envelope.
  • Attach two stamped self-addressed envelopes.
  • Include photo, all self-attested certificates.

National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur) has released an official notification for the recruitment of Faculty Positions Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official NIT Raipur website. The last date to submit the application form is 17-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the NIT Raipur Faculty Positions Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

NIT Raipur Faculty Positions Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur)
Post Name Faculty Positions
No of Posts 14
Salary Pay Level 10 to Pay Level 14A
Qualification Ph.D. in relevant/ equivalent discipline with first class in preceding Degrees
Age Limit Below 60 years
Start Date 15 January 2026
Last Date 17 February 2026
Official Website http://www.nitrr.ac.in
Trending Govt Jobs
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026
  • Yantra India YIL 3979 Trade Apprentices Online Form 2026

Vacancy Details

Name of the Post Department Category-wise distribution
Professor (Pay Level 14A) 1) Biomedical Engineering; 2) Chemistry; 3) Information Technology ST – 02 and OBC – 01
Associate Professor (Pay Level 13A2) 1) Architecture and Planning; 2) Biotechnology; 3) Chemical Engineering; 4) Mechanical Engineering; 5) Mining Engineering and 6) Physics SC- 02, ST - 02 and OBC – 02
Assistant Professor Grade I (Pay Level 12) 1) Architecture and Planning; 2) Biomedical Engineering; 3) Chemistry; 4) Metallurgical and Materials Engineering ST-01, OBC-03
Assistant Professor Grade II (Pay Level 10) Biotechnology OBC-01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: The qualification and other terms and conditions of appointment of academic staff as specified under Schedule ‘E’ of NIT Statutes (Amended 2017) (Ref. Gazette of India No. 651, dated July, 24, 2017) shall be read in conjunction with the guidelines or clarifications issued with the approval of the Council on 13thSeptember, 2017; 30th November 2017, 4th December, 2017; 31st January, 2018; 20thApril, 2018; and 16thApril, 2019 and other amendments issued by MoE, Govt of India from time to time (available at www.nitrr.ac.in\recruitment_rules)
  • Essential Qualification: For Engineering Disciplines: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent and Ph.D. in relevant/ equivalent discipline with first class in the preceding Degrees. BE/B.Tech. with direct Ph.D. with first class in preceding Degree will also be considered.
  • Essential Qualification: For Architecture Department: B. Arch. or equivalent and M.Arch./M.Plan. or equivalent. Further following shall also be essential qualification without insisting on credit point requirements at Assistant Professor level: (i) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with one-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 6000 (ii) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with two-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 7000 (iii) For higher cadres the educational qualifications and credit point requirement shall remain same as given in the Table of Schedule‘E’ for Engineering and Sciences
  • Essential Qualification: For Non-Engineering Departments: Ph.D. degree in the relevant or equivalent discipline with first class in preceding Degrees.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case, first class is not mentioned in the preceding Degrees by the University / Institution, then the candidates should have secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case the candidate has secured CGPA under any other point scale (other than 10-point scale), then certificate issued by the authorized signatory (not the Mentor/Supervisor/Head of the Department) of the Institute / University to the effect of having secured first class in such Degree must be attached. Alternately, the CGPA may be equivalently converted on 10- point scale for determination of eligibility.
  • Desirable criteria for Professor (Level 14A): (a) Good quality publications with at least 20 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least three, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least two Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized three activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Associate Professor (Level 13A2): (a) Good quality publications with at least 10 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least two, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized two activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -12): (a) Good quality publications with at least 5 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least one ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project OR one patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed/ ongoing. (d) Organized one Conference OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course.
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -10): (a) Good quality publications with at least 3 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals.
  • Experience: Experience as per Clarification no. 7, GoI, Ministry of Education(MoE, erstwhile MHRD), F.No.33-9/2011-TS.III, Dated 16th April, 2019, (including prior to implementation of NIRF) shall be considered if acquired in any of the following Institutions: • Fully Funded Central Educational Institutions. • IIMs, Other Management Institutions and Research institutions ranked by NIRF up to 50 for any two years. • State Educational Institutions funded by respective State Government. • Other Educational Institutions (Universities and Engineering institutes) ranked by NIRF up to 100 in Overall, and 10 for Architecture, for any two years.
  • Experience: Experience as mentioned above and as per RRs in an Institution/ Organization will only be considered for calculating total experience.
  • Administrative Experience: Contributions to Institute/Department Administration shall be recommended by concerned Head and approved by the Head of the Institution. Otherwise, weightage of administrative experience for evaluating the credit points may not be considered for determining the eligibility. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard. [As prescribed in Note 1, Point no. 4 of Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated, July 24, 2017)].
  • Experience: Less than six months of individual (independent/discrete) experience in different Organizations with gaps in-between even in relevant regular position in any Organization will be ignored in computing total experience.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Assistant Professor Grade I & Grade II: Pay Level 12, 10
  • Associate Professor: Pay Level 13 A2
  • Professor: Pay Level 14 A

Age Limit (as on 17-02-2026)

  • Below 60 years, however candidates within 35 years will be preferred for the entry level post of Assistant Professor Level 10 and 12.
  • Age relaxation may be given for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD candidates as per the Govt. of India (GoI) norms.

Application Fee

  • Rs. 2500/- (Rupees Two Thousand Five Hundred Only) for OBC applicants
  • Rs. 1250/- (Rupees One Thousand Two Hundred Fifty Only) for SC/ ST/ PWD applicants
  • No Processing Fee is required from the existing regular Faculty of NIT Raipur
  • For the candidates applying from abroad, application fee will be Rs. 5000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only)

Important Dates

Notification Date 9 January 2026
Online Application Start Date 15 January 2026
Last Date for Online Application 17 February 2026
Last Date for Hard Copy Submission 27 February 2026

Selection Process

  • The short-listed candidates may be required to appear for written exam/presentation/seminar in the respective Departments, in addition to facing the Selection Committee.
  • The final selection of such candidates will be made on the basis of the recommendations of a Medical Board appointed for examining the physical disability at Raipur.

General Information / Instructions

  • This being an advertisement governed by the four-tier flexible Faculty Recruitment Rules, relevant instructions from MoE issued till the date of interview will be applicable to this recruitment process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease number of vacancies including those in the Reserved Categories without notification.
  • Since all the posts are to be filled-in by open advertisement, candidates working in NIT Raipur who are aspiring for higher Pay levels are required to submit their application even if the posts in the concern Department are not advertised.
  • For the Departments which are not having any vacancy, movement in higher Pay Level or Cadre will be carried out as per specified selection process but restricted to only for serving faculty members of the respective Departments of the Institute (as per Note 1(5) of Schedule ‘E’ of Statutes 23[5](a) of the First Statutes of the National Institute of Technology (Amendment) Statutes, 2017) and as directed by MoE, Government of India, from time to time.
  • The Institute reserves the right to modify/ defer or cancel full / part of the advertisement / recruitment process at any stage of processing without assigning any reason whatsoever and no communication in this regard will be made.
  • Financial assistance for attending national/international conferences for presenting research papers or Chairing sessions, for sponsored training in India and abroad, for membership of professional Societies etc. under the Scheme of Cumulative Professional Development Allowance [CPDA] limited to Rs.1.00 lakh per annum subject to the maximum limit of Rs.3.00 lakh in a block period of three years or as per rules.
  • An initial Research Grant (Seed Grant) up to Rs. 5.00 Lakh for new Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision for undertaking consultancy and testing work as per Institute norms.
  • On campus residence [depending on availability].
  • Medical Facilities to Faculty and their dependent family members as per rules.
  • Reimbursement of expenses on telephone as per approved norms.
  • Group Insurance Scheme for Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision of Child care Leave, Children Education Allowance and maternity/paternity Leave as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • LTC as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • HRA as per the Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • New entrants will be covered under the New Pension Scheme [NPS-2004] as per Ministry of Education Guidelines, GoI norms, NIT Act and Statutes. The existing Faculty members, if selected, shall be governed by their current Pension Scheme.
  • Leave will be granted as per CCS Leave Rules, 1972.
  • The appointees will be granted ‘No Objection Certificates’ and applications of such appointees for outside job can be forwarded only after completion of two years of services and as per the NIT Statutes.
  • Candidates are required to go through the details of Posts and instructions available on the Institute Website carefully before applying to ensure their eligibility for the post.
  • All recruitment and pay-fixation shall be done by the Appointing Authority, i.e., Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute only on the recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees. The decision of the Appointing Authority shall be final. There is no scope for fixing or altering the pay (pay in Level/Cell) outside the Selection Committee for Level10 and 12. The Selection Committee shall be the only entity empowered to consider the past services and qualifications of a candidate. However, higher starting Pay and/or Pay Level may be offered to deserving candidates on recommendation of the Selection Committee upon approval of the Board of Governors for Levels 13A2 and 14A. Selected candidates to the above faculty positions will be fixed in the minimum basic pay as per norm and only the regular service at NIT Raipur, will be counted for any purpose thereafter.
  • As this is a fresh appointment [As per Schedule ‘E’ of Statute 23(5)(a) Note 1(1)], any change in the Pay Level/Cell in 7th CPC, is through direct recruitment through open advertisement. Therefore, the term “promotion” used in RRs/ Guidelines/ MoE (erstwhile MHRD) communications should be read as “Appointment through Direct Recruitment”.
  • The appointee (new entrants)in the contract position should undergo or submit medical fitness certificate and verification of the character antecedent in consonance with; the GoI guidelines.
  • Persons serving in Govt. / Semi Govt. / PSUs / Universities / Educational Institutions should send their applications either THROUGH PROPER CHANNEL or should furnish a NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE from the Competent Authority of the Organization serving, in the prescribed form at the time of interview otherwise they may not be allowed for interview. However, they can submit the advance copy of the Application Form.
  • Applications which are not online/ not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures and without fee shall be summarily rejected. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • The minimum qualification with regard to academic qualification and experience (on credit basis) for all positions advertised shall be governed by the Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (issued vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated July, 24th 2017 [As per Schedule ‘E’ of Statute 23(5)(a), Note 1(1)] and the Amendments.
  • Desirable areas of specialization in various Departments are given in Annexure-II. However, candidates with other relevant areas of specialization may also apply.
  • The date for determining the eligibility of candidates in every respect, i.e., qualifications, experience and preferred age limit etc. shall be considered as on the closing date, i.e., the last date of the submission of Online Application Form.
  • Instructions for submission of application are attached in Annexure-III and is required to be followed.
  • Candidates shall indicate two references of Eminent Person(s) in the specialization/ profession who may be contacted by the Institute for their recommendations.
  • Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.
  • All Degrees and Certificates should have been obtained from recognized Institute/University.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualification/ experience will not entitle the candidate to be called for interview/ selection or appointment.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum and the areas of specialization while shortlisting, taking into account the specific requirements of the individual departments. The short-listing norms may not be uniform across the departments/ posts of the Institute and shall be binding on all the applicants. Priority of shortlisting shall be as under: (i) All three degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (ii) At least two degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (iii) At least one degree (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500.
  • The decision of the Institute related to all matters pertaining to the recruitment shall be final and binding on the applicants.
  • Note: if the candidate achieves the degree under integrated mode, then it shall be considered as two degrees among UG/PG/PhD.
  • Policy on avoiding ‘In-Breeding’: Candidates who have obtained their most recent Degree (Ph.D.) from NIT Raipur, will not be considered for recruitment, except where there is a 3-year gap between leaving the Institute and last date of the submission of online application.
  • Govt. of India (GoI) norms of Reservations are followed in the Institute. All reserved candidates are required to submit their Caste/Category certificates in prescribed format [Annexure-IV/V/VII] along with the hard copy of application. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof of Caste/Category.
  • The Caste/Tribe/Community certificates (Annexure-IV) in the proforma prescribed and issued by any of the authorities stated in the OM No. 36012/6/88-Estt. (SCT), Dated 24.4.1990 and OM No.36012/22/93-Estt. (Res.), Dated 15.11.1993, GoI, No. 36028/1/2014-Estt (Res), Dated 3rd September, 2015 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidate’s claim belonging to Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe/ Other Backward Class (NCL). Relevant Caste /Tribe/ Community certificates are required to be submitted with duly completed application form. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof.
  • (i) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of SCs given at: https://socialjustice.gov.in/common/76750 or https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Compendium-2016.pdf
  • (ii) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of STs given at: https://tribal.nic.in/ST/LatestListofScheduledtribes.pdf
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued on or after 1stApril 2025 shall only be considered for reservation under OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category. [Refer Annexure-V].
  • EWS certificate should be issued by Competent Authority (Tahsildar or above). Also, this certificate must be issued on or after 1st April 2025 in order to be considered for reservation under EWS category [Refer Annexure-VI], (NOT APPLICABLE IN THIS ADVERTISMENT).
  • The persons with disability (PWD) shall be required to submit the Disability/Medical Certificate in the prescribed form (Annexure–VII) issued by the Competent Medical Authorities for the purpose of employment as per Government of India norms along with the hard-copy of the application form.
  • The reserved candidates who have applied for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any age relaxation or any other concessions as per DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36011/1/98 Est. (Res) Dated, 1-7-98.
  • The directives contained in the matter of reservation in posts and implementation of Central Educational Institutions Act, 2019 enunciated in the Ministry of Education’s letter dated 05.11.2019 (attached herewith as Annexure-VIII) shall be applicable.
  • Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence of any form will be treated as disqualification for the faculty position applied.
  • Legal disputes if any, with NIT Raipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Raipur Courts only.
  • The applicant will be solely responsible for the authenticity of submitted information, documents and photographs, etc.
  • The list of candidates shortlisted for further participation in the selection process such as written test/presentation/interview etc. will be displayed on the Institute Website only. The applicants need to keep on visiting Institute Website www.nitrr.ac.in for updates. No correspondence will be made regarding non-eligibility/ not-short listing/ non-selection of the candidates.
  • Information uploaded on the website shall not be provided to the candidate or any other person under R.T.I Act. 2005. The information uploaded on the website shall remain for a specific period only. Therefore, the candidates are advised to download the uploaded information and keep with them for future. During ongoing process of recruitment, neither any application under Right to Information Act. 2005 shall be entertained nor information will be provided. Factual information under the R.T.I Act shall be provided only after declaration of final results of the process. Inferential questions or speculative questions shall not be answered in RTI.

How to Apply

  • Please note that application(s) filled only through the official portal (Google Chrome is more friendly for filling the online application) in the institute website (www.nitrr.ac.in) shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted but summarily rejected. Applicants are required to apply separately for different Posts in the same discipline or in different Disciplines/Departments. Office Executive (On Contract)

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
  • Experience: Proven work experience of at least 3 years as Office Assistant / Admin Assistant.
  • Work Domain: Experience in academic/administrative coordination in a research or educational institution (preferred).

Essential Skills

  • Clerical Work: Routine clerical work including letter writing, document preparation, record keeping.
  • Logistic Support: Providing logistic support for organizing meetings, seminars, conferences, and academic events.
  • File Management: File maintenance, documentation, data entry, and record organization.
  • Financial Support: Processing invoices, claims, and billing coordination.
  • MS Office Proficiency: Strong proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and office correspondence.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Multitasking Ability: Ability to handle multiple tasks and work independently.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to perform any other work assigned by the Competent Authority.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience with academic/research organizations.
  • Familiarity with research administration and project management.
  • Knowledge of office management software and systems.
  • Experience in guesthouse or hospitality coordination (useful for I-House operations).

  • Age Relaxation: As per Government of India norms for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/ESM).
  • Age Calculation: Based on Date of Birth as on 15-02-2026.

Salary & Compensation

  • Post: Office Executive (Contract).
  • Salary Range: Rs. 30,000 – 35,000/- per month.
  • Determination: Exact salary will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  • Nature: Consolidated pay structure for contract position.
  • Benefits: No additional benefits/allowances specified (contract basis).
  • Frequency: Monthly remuneration.

Key Responsibilities & Job Description

The selected candidate will assist in day-to-day administrative and coordination activities of ICMS, SSL, International House (I-House), and School of Advanced Materials (SAMat).

1. Academic & Statutory Coordination

  • Coordinate academic and statutory meetings.
  • Prepare meeting notices, agendas, and minutes.
  • Follow up on action items and decisions.
  • Maintain meeting records and documentation.

2. Administrative & Logistical Support

  • Provide administrative and logistical support for visiting faculty and students.
  • Organize seminars, lectures, conferences, and academic programs.
  • Support PGDMS and the Annual International Winter School.
  • Handle event coordination, venue booking, catering, and material arrangements.

3. Recruitment & Documentation

  • Assist in recruitment-related documentation and processing.
  • Prepare academic reports and submissions.
  • Process recruitment and administrative forms.
  • Maintain candidate documentation and records.

4. Financial & Procurement Support

  • Assist in procurement processing and vendor coordination.
  • Coordinate billing and invoice processing.
  • Maintain financial records and documentation.
  • Follow up on payments and claims.

5. Project Documentation & Research Support

  • Maintain project documentation and reports related to SSL.
  • Organize sponsored research activity records.
  • Manage files for ongoing and completed projects.
  • Support researchers with administrative requirements.

6. Guesthouse (I-House) Operations Support

  • Support I-House operations, including bookings and reservations.
  • Assist with guesthouse billing and coordination.
  • Coordinate services for visiting guests and researchers.
  • Maintain I-House records and guest registers.

7. Additional Support

  • Provide secretarial and administrative assistance for SAMat activities.
  • Assist with publication coordination and conference submissions.
  • Support office correspondence and communication.
  • Perform general clerical work including data entry, typing, and document preparation.
  • Any other work assigned by the Competent Authority.

    • Experience certificates (copies)

  6. Use a clear subject line such as: “Application for Office Executive Position - ICMS/SSL”.

UCSL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 13 Manager & Executive Posts

Advertisement

Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL), Malpe, Karnataka, a wholly owned subsidiary of Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) under Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, has released the official notification for UCSL Recruitment 2026. Candidates looking for UCSL jobs 2026 can apply online for 13 vacancies of Assistant General Manager, Senior Manager, Manager, and Deputy Manager posts on permanent rolls. The UCSL online form 2026 will be available from 27-01-2026 to 17-02-2026 on the official website. This UCSL vacancy 2026 offers attractive monthly emoluments ranging from ₹1,03,400 to ₹1,65,440 for various executive positions. Interested Engineering graduates with relevant experience in Shipbuilding, Ship Repair, Offshore Fabrication, or related industries must check complete details about eligibility criteria, pay scale, and selection procedure before applying for UCSL Malpe recruitment 2026.

The selection for UCSL vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Selection Stages:

Stage 1: Application Shortlisting

  • Shortlist based on eligibility requirements
  • Only shortlisted candidates called for selection

  • Duration: Maximum 10 minutes
  • Topic: Highlighting work experience
  • Work experience assessed by selection committee
  • Based on documents submitted + presentation
  • Further shortlisting for Group Discussion & Interview

  • Only candidates meeting notified work experience and job requirements permitted

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)

  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Full-time B.E / B.Tech in Aerospace or Aeronautical Engineering from AICTE approved college/institute or recognized university with minimum First Class.
  • OR full-time M.E / M.Tech in Aerospace or Aeronautical Engineering from AICTE approved college/institute or recognized university with minimum First Class.

  • End-to-end solution development starting from high-level system requirements to final product realization.

Application fee is non-refundable. Candidates must pay through SBI Collect, either online or via SBI branch, and mention the SBI Collect reference number in the application form.

How to Pay Application Fee via SBI Collect

  • Visit www.onlinesbi.com and select “State Bank Collect”.
  • Accept the terms and conditions and click “Proceed”.
  • Select “All India” as State and choose “PSU – Public Sector Undertaking”.
  • Select “Bharat Electronics Limited” as the corporation/PSU.
  • Select payment category: “Senior Engineer (E-III) Post”.
  • Enter required details, complete payment and save/print the SBI Collect reference number and receipt.
  • Write the SBI Collect reference number in the relevant field of the application form and attach the payment receipt copy.

BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Step 1: Application Screening

  • Applications will be screened based on eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, experience and supporting documents.
  • All details filled in the application form must match exactly with the attached documents.
  • Incomplete applications or those without required enclosures are liable to be rejected without further notice.

Step 2: Written Test

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Written Test at BEL, Bengaluru.
  • Passing marks in Written Test: 35% for General category, 30% for SC/PwBD candidates.
  • Weight of the written test will be considered for final selection alongside interview marks.

Step 3: Interview

  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:7 (category-wise) based on written test performance.
  • Interview will carry 15 marks with passing marks 35% for General and 30% for SC/PwBD candidates.
  • Interview will be conducted at BEL, Bengaluru, and outstation candidates will be reimbursed III Tier AC train fare as per rules.

Final Selection Criteria

  • Final merit list will be prepared category-wise combining Written Test and Interview scores.
  • List of candidates shortlisted for Written Test and Interview will be uploaded on BEL website only; no individual call letters by post.
  • Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee selection or shortlisting for further stages.

Important Notes on Experience

  • Only relevant experience from industry or defence laboratories will be considered for eligibility and shortlisting.
  • Academic, teaching, apprenticeship, internship or purely research experience will not be counted as relevant experience.
  • Trainee, fixed-tenure, contractual or temporary engagements in BEL or other PSUs will not be treated as qualifying experience.
  • Experience without proper documentary proof (appointment letters, relieving letters, experience certificates, pay slips) may be rejected.
  • The decision of the BEL Selection Committee regarding experience relevance and calculation will be final and binding.

How to Apply for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026

  1. Download the application form: Visit the BEL careers section at https://bel-india.in/ and download the prescribed application format for Senior Engineer (E-III) – Job Code US01.
  2. Fill the form carefully: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, total experience, current employment, category and contact details neatly. Ensure all entries match your certificates.
  3. Pay the application fee: If applicable, pay the fee through SBI Collect under “Bharat Electronics Limited – Senior Engineer (E-III) Post”, then note the reference number and attach the payment receipt.
  4. Attach self-attested documents: Enclose photocopies of SSLC/Matriculation, PUC/12th/Diploma, degree marks cards, final degree certificate, CGPA conversion certificate (if any), experience certificates, appointment and relieving letters, latest pay slip, ID proof and category/disability certificates as applicable.
  5. Prepare detailed experience write-up: Attach a separate sheet describing your roles, responsibilities and experience relevant to UAV design, aerospace systems and other required skills.
  6. Prepare and superscribe the envelope: Place the filled form and all enclosures in an A4-size envelope and clearly superscribe: “Application for the post of Senior Engineer (Job Code No. US01)”.
  7. Send by Registered Post only: Dispatch the envelope through Indian Post (Registered Post) so that it reaches the below address on or before 24.02.2026; applications received after the cut-off date will be rejected.

Vacancy Details

Post Name No. of Vacancies
Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) 01
Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) (Post 1): Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy / Psychology / Public Health / Psychiatric Social Work / Social Work / Sociology /Microbiology/Biochemistry / Chemistry with 5 years post-qualification experience. or Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy / Psychology / Public Health / Psychiatric Social Work / Social Work / Sociology /Microbiology/Biochemistry/ Chemistry with PhD + 2 years' post-qualification experience.
  • Desirable for Post 1: Experience in Public Health / Implementation Research with Publications in Peer-Reviewed Journals.
  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) (Post 2): Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy/Psychology/Public Health / Psychiatric Social Work/Social Work/Sociology/Microbiology / Biochemistry / Zoology /Chemistry with 3 years' post-qualification experience. or Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy / Psychology / Public Health/Psychiatric Social Work/Social Work / Sociology / Microbiology/ Biochemistry/Zoology/Chemistry with Ph.D.
  • Desirable for Post 2: Experience in Public Health/Implementation Research with Publications in Peer-Reviewed Journals related to Cognitive Behavioural Therapy /Depression/Anxiety
  • Qualification for Field Supervisor: Bachelor's degree in Public Health / Nursing / Life Sciences / Social Work / Allied Health Sciences. Minimum 2 years of experience in community-based health projects, preferably NCD or surveillance studies. Familiarity with field data collection using digital tools. Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Willingness to travel extensively in field areas.
  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist – I (Medical): MBBS degree from a recognized university / institute.
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support – III (Post 5): A Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) degree with 3 years' post qualification experience. or A Master of Physiotherapy (MPT)
  • Desirable for Post 5: 2 Yrs Experience on Pulmonary rehabilitation of CRD patients/Community based health survey/ field work /laboratory work
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support – II: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + 05 Years Experience in relevant subject/field Or Graduation degree in Science (BMLT/Nursing) with 2 years' experience in collection of biological samples, handling of analyzers, ELISA etc.
  • Desirable for Post 6: Community based health survey/ field work / laboratory work
  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist – II (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree in Public Health /Epidemiology /Biostatistics /Life Sciences/Health Sciences with three years post-qualification experience in the relevant subjects. OR Post Graduate Degree in Public Health /Epidemiology/Biostatistics/ Life Sciences/Health Sciences with a PhD in the relevant subject.
  • Desirable for Post 7: Prior experience in oral cancer / head & neck cancer / NCD research, preferably in screening or early detection programs. Experience working with Health & Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs) or Community Health Officers (CHOs). Experience in training, capacity building, or IEC/BCC activities. Experience in community-based or implementation research, including field coordination and stakeholder engagement. Hands-on experience in data collection, management, and analysis using SPSS / STATA. Familiarity with public-health surveillance systems, program monitoring, and reporting. Ability to prepare technical reports, policy briefs, and scientific manuscripts.
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support- III (Post 7 ii): Graduate degree with Public Health /Epidemiology/Biostatistics/Life Sciences/Health Sciences with 3 years post-qualification experience. or Postgraduate in Public Health / Epidemiology / Biostatistics / Life Sciences/Health Sciences.
  • Desirable for Post 7 ii: Experience in oral cancer/head and neck cancer / NCD-related public-health research, preferably in screening or early detection programmes. Experience in community-based field work, including coordination with Health & Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs) and Community Health Officers (CHOs). Experience in data collection, entry, and basic analysis using MS Excel / SPSS / STATA. Exposure to training, IEC/BCC activities, and community awareness programmes Familiarity with public-health reporting, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support - I: Three-year Graduate degree in Life Science /Biotechnology /Microbiology / Biochemistry / Biomedical Sciences /Genetics/ Molecular Biology /Zoology/Botany with 1-year post-qualification experience in the relevant field. OR 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT or equivalent) + 2 years' experience in the relevant field.
  • Desirable for Post 8: Prior experience in dengue or other vector-borne disease research/surveillance Experience in sample collection, processing, and basic laboratory techniques (ELISA, RT-PCR, molecular or serological assays) Exposure to entomological or field surveillance activities, including coordination with state/district health teams Experience in data entry, management, and basic analysis using MS Excel / SPSS / STATA.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) (Post 1): Rs. 78,000/- + HRA per month fixed without any other allowances
  • Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) (Post 2): Rs.67,000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated)
  • Field Supervisor: Rs. 40,000/- per month (Consolidated).
  • Project Research Scientist – I (Medical): Rs.67,000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated)
  • Project Technical Support – III (Post 5): Rs.28,000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated)
  • Project Technical Support – II: Rs.20,000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated)
  • Project Research Scientist – II (Non-Medical): Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated)
  • Project Technical Support- III (Post 7 ii): Rs. 28000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated)
  • Project Technical Support - I: Rs. 18,000/- + HRA per month (Consolidated).

Age Limit (as on the date of the walk-in interview / written test)

  • Post 1: Not exceeding 45 years
  • Post 2: Not exceeding 40 years
  • Field Supervisor: Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Research Scientist – I (Medical): Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Technical Support – III (Post 5): Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Technical Support – II: Not exceeding 30 years
  • Project Research Scientist – II (Non-Medical): Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Technical Support- III (Post 7 ii): Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Technical Support - I: Not exceeding 28 years

Project Technical Support - I 8 12 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Only eligible candidates will appear for Walk-in-interview / written test. In case of more than 30 candidates, a written test may be taken. The qualifying marks for the written test will be for SC / ST: 35% UR / OBC / EWS: 40%.
  • The candidates scoring qualifying marks may be interviewed, if written test is conducted. Generally, Up to Top 05 candidates will be shortlisted for interview appear for each position.
  • The candidates will be selected on the basis of their performance in the written test / interview subject to qualifying the skill test, wherever applicable.
  • The final merit shall be prepared on the basis of the marks of the written test and interview. In case of non-conductance of written test being less than 30 candidates, the merit shall be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the interview.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The above project positions are purely on temporary basis only.
  • Candidates, those who have rendered service in ICMR Projects / ICMR Institutes for more than three years are not eligible for this Walk-in.
  • The advertised positions are tentative without commitment for its filling. Recruitment will depend upon requirement of project and approval of the competent authority.
  • Emoluments: The rates of emoluments / stipend shown in this advertisement are project specific and may vary according to sanction of the funding agency of the Project. Payment of emoluments to the project person will depend on availability of funds from the funding agency.
  • The Director & Appointing Authority has the right to accept / reject any application without assigning any reason(s) and no correspondence in this matter will be entertained.
  • The selected candidate should work for a period of at least one month, failing which, the emoluments drawn by him / her will to be forfeited.
  • The engagement can be terminated with one-month notice from either side without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates already employed should submit a “No Objection Certificate” from their present Employer / PI at the time of Walk-in-interview / written test failing which he / she will not be allowed to appear for Interview / written test.
  • Since, the project position(s) is / are temporary; the incumbents selected will have no claim for regular appointment at ICMR-NIIRNCD or continuation of his / her services in any other project.
  • The results of the final selection will be placed on ICMR-NIIRNCD and ICMR web sites.
  • The recruited project person(s) is / are governed as per ICMR project staff recruitment guidelines and will have to give the undertakings before joining.
  • At the time of joining duty, the candidates should bring all original certificates of educational qualifications (from SSC onwards), No Objection Certificate from present employer if working in ICMR Projects (compulsory), SC / ST / OBC / EWS certificate, Experience, Aadhaar Card & PwBD Certificate (if applicable) for availing age relaxation, passport size photograph along with one set of photocopies of the certificates duly attested (can be self-attested) for verification.
  • Qualifications should be achieved from recognized Institutions / Universities only. Experience certificate should clearly state the nature of work during the period of employment with dates. Experience in the relevant discipline / field should be from a reputed institution / organization recognized by the relevant authority.
  • Age relaxation will be admissible in respect of SC / ST / OBC candidates, retrenched Government Employees, Departmental Candidates (including projects) and Ex-servicemen etc. in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government / DoPT / ICMR from time to time. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects will also be admissible for experienced and skilled persons. SC / ST / OBC will be given age relaxation in respect of the project positions reserved for them only and not for UR positions.
  • The conditions of reservations for EWS shall be governed by the norms of DoPT OM No. 336039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 19.01.2019 and 31.01.2019. Candidates applying in the EWS category should submit an “Income and Asset Certificate”.
  • The Director, ICMR-NIIRNCD reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of project positions or cancel the recruitment or re-advertise the project positions at any time, without assigning any reasons thereof. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Date of Interview / written test may be changed due to administrative reasons. Hence, candidates are advised to check website before appearing for Interview / written test.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible candidates for project human resource positions under various projects at ICMR-NIIRNCD, Jodhpur. Applications will be received from the individuals by hand on the date of Walk-in-interview / written test as mentioned below.
  • The Candidates may download the application form from http://niirncd.icmr.org.in / https://www.icmr.gov.in.
  • Candidates are required to submit the application form duly filled along with one set of photocopies of all certificates. All the original certificates for verification must be brought failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • After verification of the applications, the eligible candidates will attend Walk-in-interview / written test.
  • The applicants are advised to visit the websites https://www.icmr.gov.in and http://niirncd.icmr.org.in regularly for any updates and changes in the recruitment process.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC

Selection Process

  • Phase I: Two objective type written papers (3 hours each, 100 marks each)
    • Paper 1: General Knowledge, Daily Science and Mathematics
    • Paper 2: General Hindi and English
  • Phase II: Computer Typing Test (For non-disabled candidates only)
    • Hindi Typing on Computer: Speed Test (10 min - 25 marks) + Efficiency Test (10 min - 25 marks)
    • English Typing on Computer: Speed Test (10 min - 25 marks) + Efficiency Test (10 min - 25 marks)
  • Disabled candidates will be awarded average marks obtained in Phase I
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks (Phase I): 40% in each paper (35% for SC/ST candidates - 5% relaxation)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks (Phase II): 36% in each test (31% for SC/ST candidates - 5% relaxation)
  • Only candidates scoring minimum 40% in both papers of Phase I and ranking within 3 times the number of vacancies will be called for Phase II
  • Final merit will be based on combined marks of Phase I and Phase II
  • Exam will be conducted in offline (OMR based) mode
  • Normalization process will be applied if exam is conducted in multiple shifts
  • Negative marking: 1/3 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens or persons of Nepali, Bhutanese origin, or Tibetan refugees who came to India before 01-01-1962, or persons of Indian origin from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries who migrated permanently to India
  • Candidates must have good mental and physical health
  • Character certificate from Principal/Educational Officer of last educational institution attended is mandatory
  • Two character certificates from responsible persons (not relatives) issued not earlier than 6 months from application date are required
  • Police verification certificate regarding conduct must be submitted at the time of appointment
  • Medical fitness certificate from competent authority must be submitted at the time of appointment
  • Marriage registration certificate is mandatory as per Government circular dated 22-05-2006
  • Candidates already in government service must submit No Objection Certificate from their employer
  • Pension scheme will be applicable as per State Government rules
  • Disqualifications:
    • Male candidates having more than one living wife
    • Female candidates who married a person having a living wife
    • Married candidates who accepted dowry at the time of marriage
    • Candidates having more than 2 children after 01-06-2002 (with certain exceptions)
  • Special facilities for visually impaired, locomotor disability candidates: Scribe facility and compensatory time as per rules
  • UDID Card is mandatory for Divyang candidates
  • Debarred candidates cannot apply during the debarment period
  • The Rajasthan Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2022 will be strictly enforced with stringent punishments including imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to Rs. 1 lakh for candidates, and up to 10 years imprisonment and fine up to Rs. 10 crore for others involved in unfair means

How to Apply

  • Applications will be accepted ONLY through Online mode via SSO Portal (http://sso.rajasthan.gov.in)
  • Step 1: Login to SSO Portal with SSO ID
  • Step 2: Select Citizen Apps (G2C) and choose Recruitment Portal
  • Step 3: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not done already by paying prescribed fee
  • Step 4: Enter CET (Senior Secondary)-2024 Application Number for verification
  • Step 5: Fill the online application form carefully with all required details
  • Step 6: Upload required documents:
    • Live photograph (captured during OTR - auto-fetched)
    • Scanned signature in Hindi and English
    • Left hand thumb impression
    • Educational qualification documents
  • Step 7: Preview the application and verify all details
  • Step 8: Final Submit the application
  • Step 9: Note down the Application ID for future reference
  • Offline applications will NOT be accepted under any circumstances
  • Candidates must carefully read the detailed notification and help documents available on Board's website before filling application
  • Information in OTR cannot be changed except through RPSC for educational qualification
  • Correction facility will be provided for 3 days after application closing date (fee: Rs. 300/-)
  • One more final correction opportunity will be given approximately 1 month before examination (fee applicable)
  • Mobile number and email ID registered should be candidate's own and must not be changed till appointment process is complete
  • For any issues during application: Contact Helpdesk at 0141-2922241/2922238, Email: [email protected] or [email protected]

General Information/ Instructions

  1. Candidates are requested to read the instruction carefully before filling up the online application.   2. Applicants are requested to go through all the instructions carefully and ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions. Their admission to all stages of the recruitment will be purely provisional and the final selection is subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions. If at any subsequent stage, the information provided/claim made by the applicant is found to be false, his/ her candidature will be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process and if appointed, services will be terminated without any notice or compensation.
  3. Candidates should carefully fill up all the required details in the online application including age, education qualification, SC/ ST/ OBC-NCL/ EWS/ PwD certificates, experience certificate, the details of the pay scale, if applicable etc. If any of their claims is found to be incorrect, it will lead to rejection of their candidature.

  7. The institute reserves the right to set additional criteria for shortlisting and any other criteria deem fit by the Institute to restrict the number of candidates to be called for written/skill test/ interview to a reasonable limit based on the experience and its relevance, qualifications and level higher than the eligibility criteria prescribed in the advertisement. The Institute reserves the right not to fill up the posts, cancel the advertisement in whole or in part without assigning any reason and the decision of the institute in this regard shall be final and binding on the applicants. No correspondence and personal inquiries shall be entertained.
  8. Incomplete applications or application without relevant enclosures or without fee will be outrightly rejected. No Interim correspondence will be entertained and replied to.
  9. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification for the post and cancellation of candidature.
  10. No TA/DA will be paid for attending written test/ interview.
  11. The candidates applying against the vacancies reserved for EWS must upload the Income and Asset Certificate valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of online application. The OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025 shall be treated as a valid certificate for this purpose. Further, these candidates are also required to produce the valid EWS/OBC-NCL Certificates during document verification. The caste/category certificate should be submitted as per the Central Govt. format. The candidates claiming for OBC-NCL, SC and ST should note that reservation will be applicable only if the caste is available in the Central List notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India.
  12. Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies will have to be produced at the time of test / interview for verification.

How to Apply

The online application should be supported by uploading the scanned copies of all ORIGINAL educational and experience certificates or else the application will not be considered. The closing date of submission of online application is 28th February, 2026 up to 11:59 PM. Any difficulties relating to submission of online application may be sent to [email protected].
  • Application Fee Payment through SBI Collect: Applicants must pay the application fee through SBI Collect at https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm. While making the payment, Applicant should choose “Educational Institutions” → “Indian Institute of Information Technology” → “Jharkhand” → “Recruitment”. After entering the required details, complete the payment and take a printout of the payment receipt. Finally, enter the transaction details on the Samarth portal to complete the final submission.
  • The duly signed hard copy of the generated online application form, along with self-attested photocopies of certificates, testimonials, generated fee payment details and other relevant documents etc., should reach to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Ranchi, ARTTC BSNL Campus, Getlatu, Near Jumar River Bridge, P.O.: Neori Vikas Vidyalaya SO, Hazaribagh Road, Ranchi - 835217 (Jharkhand) by Speed Post/ Registered Post/ Courier/ Hand on or before 10th March, 2026 up to 5:00 PM super scribing on the cover “Application for the post of:_____ vide advt. no.____”. All applications which are not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures / received after the last date will be outrightly rejected. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard. Interim correspondence will also not be entertained. The Institute shall not be responsible under any circumstances for any sort of postal delay. Application received after due date will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected.

NMDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name NMDC Limited (NMDC)
Post Name Shift Manager, Welfare Officer, Assistant Shift In charge, Assistant Colliery Engineer, Assistant Safety Officer, Overman Coal
No of Posts 22
Advt No 01/2026

Post Name Grade No. of Posts
