Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit

Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit

Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification for All Posts: Hindi or Sanskrit as one of the subjects in Matric or Higher Education
  • Age Limit: 18 to 42 years (as on closing date)
  • Age Relaxation: As per Haryana Government instructions for DSC/OSC/BC-A/BC-B/PWD/ESM and other reserved categories
  • Group 1 - Forester: Intermediate in Arts/Science or 10+2 in Science/Art/Commerce with Matriculation having Science/General Science as one subject. Must meet specified Physical Standards (Height, Chest, Race requirements)
  • Group 2 - Draftsman (Civil): Matriculation or equivalent with Three Years Diploma in Engineering (Civil) OR Two Years Certificate in Draftsmanship (Civil) from recognized institution
  • Group 3 - Electronics Posts: Graduate/Diploma in Electronics & Communications or equivalent with relevant experience/certifications
  • Group 4 - Mechanic Posts: Matric with ITI certificate in relevant trade (Diesel Mechanic/Motor Vehicle/Electronics/Mechanical) with 2 years experience in relevant field
  • Group 5 - Fitter Posts: Matric with ITI certificate in Fitter trade or Diploma in relevant mechanical/electrical trade
  • Group 6 - Draftsman (Electrical): Matriculation with 3 years Diploma in Engineering (Electrical) or 2 years Certificate in Draftsmanship (Electrical)
  • Group 7 - Draftsman (Mechanical): Matriculation with 3 years Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical) or 2 years Certificate in Draftsmanship (Mechanical)
  • Group 8 - Archaeological Posts: 2nd Class Master's Degree in Ancient Indian History/Archaeology/Medieval Indian History or relevant subjects with Postgraduate Diploma in Archaeology
  • Group 9 - Motor Vehicle Inspector: Matriculation with Diploma in Automobile/Mechanical Engineering (3 years), valid driving license, 1 year workshop experience, computer knowledge
  • Group 10 - Assistant Draftsman (Civil): Certificate course in Civil Draftsman/3 years Diploma in Civil Engineering with certified courses in AutoCAD and related software

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Publication 09/01/2026

Application Fee

  • No fee is required to be deposited by any candidate for applying against any post(s)

Selection Process

  • Recruitment will be made strictly in accordance with CET Policy for Group C dated 31.12.2024 and its amendment dated 11.07.2025
  • Candidates must have qualified Common Eligibility Test (CET) for Group C posts
  • Out of candidates applying for the post, maximum 10 times the total number of advertised posts will be eligible for skill and/or written examination
  • Pattern of Examination: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), Total Marks: 100, Duration: 1 Hour 45 Minutes
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General Category - 50%, Reserved Category - 40%
  • Offline (OMR based) written examination will be held
  • No negative marking for wrong answers, but minus one mark for unattempted questions
  • Selection based on marks obtained in written/skill examination
  • Final allocation on merit-cum-preference basis

Salary/Stipend

  • Group 1 - Forester: Fixed Pay Level-5 (FPL-5)
  • Group 2 - Draftsman Posts: Fixed Pay Level-6 (FPL-6) for most posts, FPL-3 for Tracer
  • Group 3 - Electronics Posts: FPL-4 to FPL-6 depending on post
  • Group 4 - Mechanic Posts: FPL-2 to FPL-6 depending on post
  • Group 5 - Fitter Posts: FPL-4 to FPL-5 depending on post
  • Group 6 - Electrical Draftsman: Fixed Pay Level-6 (FPL-6)
  • Group 7 - Mechanical Draftsman: Fixed Pay Level-6 (FPL-6)
  • Group 8 - Archaeological Posts: Fixed Pay Level-6 (FPL-6)
  • Group 9 - Motor Vehicle Inspector: Fixed Pay Level-6 (FPL-6)
  • Group 10 - Assistant Draftsman: Fixed Pay Level-6 (FPL-6)
  • Exact salary structure as per Haryana Government pay scales and 7th Pay Commission recommendations

Age Limit (as on Closing Date 15/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Age Relaxation for Scheduled Castes: 5 years (Maximum 47 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Backward Classes (BC-A/BC-B): 5 years (Maximum 47 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Economically Weaker Section (EWS): As per government instructions
  • Age Relaxation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years for Group C & D posts (Maximum 52 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Actual military service period plus 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for Widowed/Legally Divorced Women: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for Unmarried Women: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for Adhoc/Contract/Work-charged employees: Equal to number of completed years (Maximum 52 years)
  • Upper age limit shall not exceed 52 years with all relaxations combined (except Ex-Servicemen)

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates who have applied earlier against Advt. 04/2024, 08/2024, 09/2024 & 11/2024 must apply afresh for this advertisement
  • Commission reserves right to increase or decrease number of posts anytime till date of recommendation
  • Candidates must read complete advertisement carefully and ensure all eligibility conditions are met
  • Only online applications will be accepted through URL: https://adv022026.hryssc.com
  • Hard copy of online application along with uploaded documents must be brought when called by HSSC
  • Documents not uploaded with application form will not be entertained later
  • Answer key will be published on website after examination for objections
  • Objection fee: Rs. 250/- per objection (non-refundable)
  • All notices will be displayed on official website www.hssc.gov.in only
  • Commission's decision on all matters will be final and binding
  • Biometric data (thumb and facial) will be captured during examination
  • Use of mobile phones and electronic devices strictly prohibited in examination hall
  • Candidates involved in malpractices will be debarred for specified periods (2-5 years depending on severity)
  • Criminal proceedings may be initiated under The Haryana Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2021

How to Apply

  • Visit the official application portal: https://adv022026.hryssc.com
  • Register/Login using your CET Registration Number obtained after qualifying Common Eligibility Test
  • Fill the online Detailed Application Form (DAF) carefully with all required details
  • Upload scanned copies of all mandatory documents including:
    • All educational qualification certificates from Matriculation onwards
    • Latest colored photograph with white background with date and name clearly mentioned
    • Scanned signature of candidate
    • Scanned copy of Aadhar Card
    • Haryana Bonafide Resident Certificate (if applicable)
    • Category certificates (DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/EWS) as applicable with valid dates
    • Ex-Serviceman certificates (if applicable)
    • PwD certificate (if applicable)
    • Experience certificates (if applicable)
    • Undertaking as per Annexure IX
  • Give post preferences carefully as they cannot be changed later
  • No application fee is required for any candidate
  • Submit the application form before last date: 15/02/2026 (11:59 PM)
  • Take printout of finally submitted application form for future reference
  • Keep all original documents ready for verification when called
  • Download admit card from HSSC website when announced

Haryana.contentHtml:
Haryana state AIDS Control Society (HSACS) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 04 ICTC Lab Technician, FIART Counselor and More Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official HSACS website. The last date to submit the application form is 10-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the HSACS ICTC Lab Technician, FIART Counselor and More Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

HSACS Recruitment  2026 – Important Details

Advertisement
Details Information
Organization Name Haryana state AIDS Control Society 
Post Name ICTC Lab Technician, FIART Counselor and More
Total Vacancies 04 Posts
Salary/Pay Scale Rs. 21,000/- Per Month (Consolidated)
Educational Qualification B.A, B.Sc, BSW, M.A, M.Sc, MSW
Advt No 01/2026
Application Start Date 02/02/2026
Application End Date 10/02/2026 (by 04:00 PM)
Official Website www.nhmharyana.gov.in

  • Maharashtra Police Bharti Physical Test Hall Ticket 2026
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026

  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026

Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for HSACS Bhiwani ICTC Counselor, FIART Counselor, ICTC Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 is 04 posts. Post-wise vacancy distribution is as follows:

Name of the Post Total Vacancies
ICTC Counselor 02
FIART Counselor 01
ICTC Lab Technician 01
Total 04

Eligibility Criteria 

1. ICTC Counselor - Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Essential Qualification:
    • Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 3 years of experience in counselling/educating under National Health programme
    • OR
    • Post-graduate in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing
  • For PLHIV candidates: Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 1 years of experience in counseling/educating under National Health Programmes

2. FIART Counselor - Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Essential Qualification: Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 1 years of experience in counseling/educating under National Health Programmes
  • Desirable: Experience of working under National AIDS and STD Control Programme(NACP) facility or community settings
  • Knowledge and Skill:
    • Computer literate with working knowledge of MS Office, usage of internet and electronic mail
    • Familiarity with government health policies and related programmes
    • Ability to work in teams, and flexible ways of working as per the need of programme

3. ICTC Lab Technician - Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Essential Qualification: B.SC in Medical Laboratory Technology(BMLT) or BMLS, Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology(DMLT) or DMLS with the course duration of at least 2 years recognised by State Government/Central Government
  • Essential Experience:
    • Two years of experience of working in diagnostic laboratory for those with B.Sc/Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (course duration of 2 years)
    • One year experience for those working in diagnostic laboratory for candidates having M.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology
    • Candidates with experience of working in accredited labs or those labs who have applied for accreditation will be preferred
  • Desirable: M.Sc In Medical Laboratory Technology/MMLS

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected based on the following criteria:

  • Essential basic qualifications: 30 marks (30x Percentage/100)
  • Post qualification relevant work experience in same field: 10 marks (02 marks for each completed year, maximum 10 marks)
    • In State Govt./Semi Govt./UT/any Govt. Board/Corporation/NHM /SACS shall be considered
    • OR
    • In private hospitals/Labs, which are JSI/NABH/NABL accredited /ISO certified and any other nationally accredited Health Institution only will be considered/admissible at par with Govt. Facilities
  • Local area Weightage: 10 marks
    • For Haryana applicants: 10 marks for the candidate be a bonafide resident of Haryana (Haryana resident certificate/Domicile)
    • For out of the State applicants: Zero (0) marks
  • Total Marks: 50
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce all original testimonials at the time of document verification

How to Apply 

Eligible candidates can apply offline for HSACS Bhiwani ICTC Counselor, FIART Counselor, ICTC Lab Technician 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.nhmharyana.gov.in
  2. Download the application form from the website
  3. Fill the application form in your own handwriting in capital letters with self-attested one set of all the testimonials
  4. Attach all required documents (Educational certificates, Experience certificates, Caste certificate, Address proof, etc.)
  5. Submit the application form in person only in offline mode by 10.02.2026 till 04.00PM in room no. 224 O/o Civil Surgeon, Bhiwani
  6. Applicants must have to produce all original testimonials before the document verification committee at the time of document verification
  7. If any candidate fails to produce their original documents at the time of Document Verification, their candidature will be cancelled immediately and no any other chance will be provided to candidate for Document Verification

Important Dates 

Event Date
Notification Release Date 30/01/2026
Application Start Date 02/02/2026
Application End Date 10/02/2026 (by 04:00 PM)
Date of Form Submission From 02.02.2026 to 10.02.2026 by 04.00 PM in room no. 224 O/o Civil Surgeon, Bhiwani
Date of Document Verification for ICTC Counselor 12/02/2026
Date of Document Verification for FIART Counselor 12/02/2026
Date of Document Verification for ICTC Lab Technician 13/02/2026
Venue of Document Verification Conference Hall O/o Civil Surgeon, Bhiwani

Instructions

  • Interested candidates are advised to visit website www.nhmharyana.gov.in for details of post, eligibility and selection criteria, important instructions (corrigendum/result etc) and the application form
  • No individual correspondence (By Phone Call, message, email, letter etc) will be made by District Authorities
  • Applicant should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric
  • Applicant must be permanent resident of Haryana (Bonafide domicile certificate from Executive Magistrate should be furnished)
  • Age as per Haryana Govt. Policy
  • These posts are district specific and non transferable
  • Reservation Policy as per Haryana Govt. Reservation Policy and Advertisement is as per backlog of reservation in District Bhiwani
  • Candidates should submit latest Caste/Category certificate as per Haryana Government Reservation Policy
  • NHM Bye-laws are not applicable to this post
  • The applications received through post/courier/mail or by any other mode will not be entertained
  • Selected candidate shall disclose to this Haryana State AIDS Control Society any business or professional employment or activity in which he may be engaged prior to or at any time in the course of present agreement. These activities shall not be incompatible with the performance of the services
  • Waiting list of three candidates per post will be kept so that post need not to be re-advertised again & again and posts may not remain vacant. This waiting list will be valid for one year
  • UDID card is compulsory to claim the benefit of Person with Disability(Pwd) reservation. No reservation benefit will be granted in absence of UDID card
  • Experience Certificate should be supported with proper dispatch number, stamp and sign of issuing authority with salary mentioned in experience certificate. Candidate to produce last month Salary slip (if salary is not mentioned in Experience Certificate) with Relevant Post qualification Experience and terms and conditions. Post qualification relevant work experience in same field in any State Govt./Semi Govt./UT/any Govt. Board/Corporation/NHM /SACS shall be considered
  • Post Qualification relevant work experience in same field in private hospitals/Labs, which are JSI/NABH/NABL accredited /ISO certified and any other nationally accredited Health Institution only will be considered/admissible at par with Govt. Facilities
  • No TA/DA will be paid to participate in recruitment process at any stage
  • The selected candidate's engagement shall be governed by the terms and conditions of the contract, shall be engaged purely on contractual basis under the relevant guidelines and the candidate shall not have any claim whatsoever for regular appointment, permanent absorption, seniority of any other service benefits
  • The service conditions shall be governed according to National AIDS Control Organization(NACO), MOHFW, Govt. of India and Haryana State AIDS Control Society, Panchkula guidelines issued from time to time
  • The work and conduct will be assessed and in case of unsatisfactory performance the contract shall be terminated by the appointing authority without any notice
  • Applications are invited to fill up the post under National AIDS Control Programme purely on contractual basis on behalf of Haryana State AIDS Control Society District Bhiwani initially up to 31/03/2026 which may be renewed on year to year basis on assessment of performance
  • Further renewal of contract will be based on the satisfactory performance as assessed from time to time
  • Person Having any criminal case/FIR against them or convicted by court, are not eligible
  • Candidate should not be expelled/terminated from any Government/Semi-government Services/Department, should not be convicted by any court/department and there should be no FIR/Charge-Sheet pending against the candidate
  • No document will be accepted after last date of submission of application form (10.02.2026 till 04.00PM)
  • Posts can be increased/decreased/abolished or amended at any time by competent authorities. District authorities have right to amend any clerical mistake found at any stage of recruitment process. No claim will be entertained in this regard
  • While due care has been taken in drafting the advertisement but possibility of inadvertent/technical/clerical error cannot be ruled out. Civil Surgeon Bhiwani reserves the right to rectify the same at any stage of recruitment process

Salary/Stipend

  • ICTC Counselor: Rs. 21,000/- Per Month (Consolidated)
  • FIART Counselor: Rs. 21,000/- Per Month (Consolidated)
  • ICTC Lab Technician: Rs. 21,000/- Per Month (Consolidated)
  • Note: The remuneration for above said posts is consolidated and no other allowance is admissible

HPSC Lecturer (Financial Management) and Lecturer (Information & Technology) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Name of Posts and Department Gen/UR Total
Lecturer (Financial Management) in Development & Panchayats Department 01 01
Lecturer (Information & Technology) in Development & Panchayats Department 01 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Financial Management: Post-Graduation in Commerce or Chartered Accountant from recognized University/ Institute with atleast 55% marks.
  • Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard or higher education.
  • Two years experience in Financial Management.
  • For Information & Technology: Master of Technology in Computer Science or Information Technology from recognized University with at least 55% marks.
  • Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric standard or higher education.
  • Two years experience in Teaching or research in Information & Technology.

Salary/Stipend

  • (Pay Band-2- 9300-34800+4600 G.P) FPL-7

Age Limit (as on 16-02-2026)

  • Candidate should not be less than 18 years and not more than 42 years, on or before 16.02.2026 (closing date) and as per the Service Rules.
  • Relaxation in maximum age as per Government Instructions dated 25.03.2022, for various categories is available as under:
  • Schedules Castes of Haryana: 5 years
  • Backward Classes of Haryana: 5 years
  • Disabled persons who are covered under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016: 5 years (+5 years if PwBD applicant belongs to S/Castes, S/Tribe, B/Classes, EWS category (subject to maximum of 52 years) for Group A & B posts where recruitment is made through open competitive examination.
  • Wife of military personnel who are disabled while in military service: 5 years
  • Widowed or legally divorced woman: 5 years
  • Judicially separated woman residing separately for more than two years from the date as prescribed for the purpose of age for applicants of other categories: 5 years
  • Unmarried woman: 5 years
  • Ex-serviceman including Short Service Commissioned Officers and Emergency Commissioned Officers: Relaxation in age to the extent of his military service added by three years provided – (a) he has rendered continuous military service for a period of not less than six months before his release; and (b) he was released otherwise than by way of dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency.
  • Persons who have already worked or presently working on ad hoc/contract/work-charged/ daily wages basis in any Department / Board / Corporation of Haryana Government including Government-aided Institutions under Haryana Government: Relaxation in age equal to the number of completed years only on equivalent post on ad hoc/ contract/ work-charged/ daily wages basis excluding the period of break, if any, including any other age relaxation admissible, If any, subject to maximum age of 52 years and also subject to the condition that if once a person has been appointed on regular basis in any Department / Board / Corporation etc. of Haryana Government with the benefit of relaxation in age he will not be entitled to avail the same again for any subsequent appointment.

Application Fee

Categories of candidates Fee (Rs.)
For all Persons of Haryana with Benchmark Disabilities (Pwbd) (with at least 40% disability). NIL
Candidates belonging to OSC, DSC, BC-A (Non Creamy Layer), BC-B (Non Creamy Layer), ESM, EWS and women candidates of Haryana 250/-
DESM Candidates of Haryana belonging to their vertical category i.e. OSC, DSC, BC-A (Non Creamy Layer), BC-B (Non Creamy Layer), ESM, EWS of Haryana 250/-
DESM Candidates of Haryana belonging to UR Category 1000/-
All remaining candidates 1000/-

Important Dates

Date Description Date
Date of publication 13.01.2026
Opening date for submission of online applications (Opening Date) 15.01.2026
Closing date for submission of online applications (Closing Date) 16.02.2026 (upto 05:00 PM)
Closing date for deposit of Fee 16.02.2026 (upto 05:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • In the event of number of applications being large, Commission may adopt one of the following modes for shortlisting the candidates for the next stage of the recruitment process:- (a) On the basis of percentage of marks of the candidates in the minimum educational qualification prescribed in the advertisement. (b) On the basis of percentage of marks of the candidates in different educational qualifications, with weightage as decided by the Commission. (c) On the basis of desirable qualifications or any one or all of the desirable qualifications, if more than one desirable qualification is prescribed. (d) On the basis of higher educational qualifications than the minimum/essential qualification prescribed in the advertisement. (e) On the basis of higher experience in the relevant field than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. (f) By counting experience before or after the acquisition of minimum/essential qualifications (g) By holding a Screening test and/or Subject Knowledge Test.
  • Generally, the Commission has a three stage recruitment process i.e. Screening Test followed by Subject Knowledge Test and interview. The Commission can decide to hold a Screening Test and then a Subject Knowledge Test or it may directly hold a Subject Knowledge Test without holding a Screening Test.

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of post is liable to variation.
  • The qualifications of each post are as per the relevant Service Rules. The candidates should ensure that they possess the qualifications mentioned in the advertisement.
  • The online Applications can be submitted up to the Closing Date i.e. 16.02.2026 till 05:00 P.M.
  • The eligibility of the candidate with regard to age, educational qualifications, experience etc. shall be determined on the Closing Date fixed for submission of online application forms.
  • All applicants must fulfil the essential requirements of the post and other conditions stipulated in the advertisement on the Closing Date.
  • No certificate or document issued after the Closing Date will be accepted by the Commission at any stage of the selection process.
  • The improvement in marks done by a candidate after the Closing Date shall not be considered for any purpose in this recruitment.
  • Fees once paid will not be refunded.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee (unless remission of fee is claimed) shall be summarily rejected.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
  • The candidates will be issued an e-Admit Card, on the basis of information filled by them in their online application form, well before the commencement of the written test/Exam, if any.
  • The e-Admit Card will be made available on the website https://hpsc.gov.in/en-us/ for downloading by the candidates. No Admit Card will be sent by post separately.
  • Mere issuance of an e-Admit Card does not entitle the candidate to be eligible in all respects for the advertised post.
  • The admit cards would be issued on the basis of particulars filled by the candidates in their online application form and the candidature of candidates would be considered in the category mentioned by them in their online application form. No change of category will be allowed at a later stage.
  • Relaxation in the maximum age to the candidates belonging to the DSC/OSC/BC-A (Non Creamy Layer)/BC-B (Non Creamy Layer)/EWS/ESM category candidate of Haryana shall be admissible only where the posts are reserved for this category.
  • The upper age limit for an applicant of any category (except Ex-servicemen) shall not exceed 52 years who is entitled to avail the benefit of relaxation in age of one or more of the categories mentioned above.
  • For the candidates at Sr. No. (ix) above, for getting age relaxation, the experience certificate(s) of equivalent post issued by the Appointing Authority of Respective Department / Board / Corporation / Govt. Aided Institution only shall be valid.
  • The Matriculation certificate or equivalent academic certificate thereto is the only acceptable document for evidence of age/date of birth.
  • In case of any guidance/information/clarification regarding their applications, candidature etc. candidates can contact over Helpline No (Technical) – 1800-180-0431, Helpdesk Email ID (Technical Queries) [email protected] on any working day, between 10.00 hrs and 16.00 hrs.
  • The Recruitment for the post of (i) Lecturer (Financial Management) (ii) Lecturer (Information & Technology) in Development & Panchayats Department will be made strictly in accordance with the relevant Service Rules Haryana Development & Panchayats (Group-B) Service Rules 2016 as amended from time to time and as per existing Govt. instructions issued by the Govt. upto the date of issuance of this Advertisement. The relevant Service Rules are available on the website of www.harpanchayats.gov.in
  • In cases where it is decided by the Commission to hold a Screening Test using OMR Sheets, the candidates should ensure that they have mentioned their Name, Roll Number, Booklet Series etc. correctly in the OMR Sheet. In case the candidate fails to darken the appropriate circles corresponding to their Name, Roll Number, Booklet Series etc. their OMR sheet would be automatically rejected as there is no provision for manual checking of OMR Sheets.
  • No claim for re-checking or manual checking of OMR sheets would be entertained.
  • In cases where Subject Knowledge Test is held by the Commission, no request for re-checking or re-evaluation of answer sheets would be considered.

How to Apply

  • Candidates will have to compulsorily register online by visiting http://hpsc.gov.in, for submitting their online application form. Detailed instructions for filling up online applications are available on the above mentioned website. No other means / mode of submission of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates can register online by using their Mobile Number & Aadhar Number. In case the data in Aadhar Card is not updated the candidate should apply through Mobile Number.
  • After registration, a login ID would be created.
  • The candidates can apply against the advertisement, as per their qualifications, by using their login ID.
  • In case the candidates are applying using their Aadhar Number., their data would be verified from the relevant site. Hence the candidates should ensure that the data of their Aadhar Card is updated.
  • Aadhar Number/Virtual ID (VID) is required for Aadhar authentication during Biometric attendance.
  • After filling up the application form, the candidates would have to submit the same by making payment of requisite fee.
  • After making payment, the candidate must take a printout of his/her application form and upload the same after duly checking & signing it.
  • In case a candidate does not upload a signed copy of downloaded application form, his/her application would be considered incomplete, and candidature of such candidate would be automatically rejected.
  • The candidate should carefully enter his/her particulars and details in the online application form because after submission of the online application form, no change in any particular/detail would be allowed.

How to Apply

Team Leader (Civil) - CP/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA Projects with experience in handling engineering aspects including interface coordination

Team Leader (MEP) - CP/03/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in handling engineering and overall coordination
  • Essential: Should have a good knowledge in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in the field of quality control
  • Essential: Shall possess experience in quality assurance/control, auditing design projects, developing QMS, and inspection/testing/product conformity. The concerned should be a Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full Time Diploma in Engineering in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics

Stage 2: Main Written Examination

Total Marks: 600

Paper Subject Marks Duration

Paper-VI General Studies-IV 100 3 hours

Key Points:

  • Conventional (essay) type papers
  • Duration: 3 hours each
  • Answers in Hindi or English (except language papers)
  • General Studies papers: Either Hindi OR English (not both in same paper)
  • Candidates must write in own hand (scribe allowed for VH/OH with permission)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • 45% aggregate in all papers (35% for PwBD candidates if sufficient candidates not available)

  • Candidates 3 times the advertised posts (including bracketed) will be called for Personality Test

Marks: 75

  • Candidates 3 times advertised posts called for interview
  • Assessment of suitability for public service career
  • Qualities judged: Mental alertness, critical powers, clear exposition, judgment balance, social traits, current affairs interest, leadership ability, intellectual and moral integrity
  • Natural, directed, and purposive conversation (not strict cross-examination)

Final Merit & Selection

  • Total Marks: 675 (Main Written: 600 + Viva-voce: 75)
  • Final selection based on total marks and preference of services exercised by candidates
  • If candidates have equal marks: Higher marks in Main Written papers considered, then older age
  • No rechecking/revaluation of answer sheets

  • Issuance of e-Admit Card is provisional and does not by itself confer any right of eligibility; candidature remains subject to fulfillment of all conditions and verification of documents.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must carefully read all terms and conditions of the advertisement, including essential qualifications, age limit and nature of experience, before applying.
  • All essential requirements of the post must be fulfilled on the closing date; no certificate or document issued after the closing date will be accepted at any stage of selection.
  • Only documents uploaded with the application form will be considered for assessing eligibility; documents produced later but not uploaded earlier may not be entertained.
  • Application forms submitted without uploading the duly filled and signed copy of the application form or without uploading relevant certificates/documents will be treated as incomplete or defective and summarily rejected.
  • Candidates are advised to fill their particulars (name, parents’ names, date of birth, category, Aadhaar number, qualification, marks, photo, signature, fee details etc.) carefully; no change in category or particulars will be allowed after final submission.
  • The use of mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, programmable devices or any electronic equipment capable of communication is strictly prohibited in the examination; violation may attract penalty including debarment and criminal action.
  • The Commission may impose penalties, including disqualification from the examination and debarment from future examinations, for acts such as impersonation, use of unfair means, submission of fabricated documents, or providing false information.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature after submission of application will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only by visiting the Commission’s website www.hpsc.gov.in; no other means/mode of submission of application will be accepted.
  • The application process involves four stages: (i) Registration of the candidate, (ii) Filling up particulars in the application form, (iii) Payment of fee, and (iv) Final submission of the signed application form.
  • Candidates can register online using their Mobile Number and Aadhaar Number; if Aadhaar data is not updated, they should apply using their Mobile Number.
  • After registration, a Login ID will be created, using which candidates can apply against the advertisement as per their qualifications.
  • After filling the application form and making payment of the requisite fee, candidates must take a printout of the application form, check, sign it and upload the duly signed copy along with relevant documents.
  • If a candidate does not upload a signed copy of the downloaded application form, his/her application will be considered incomplete and automatically rejected.
  • The online application can be submitted up to the closing date 09/02/2026 till 05:00 PM; eligibility regarding age, educational qualifications and experience is determined with reference to this date.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Assistant General Manager (Finance): MBA (Fin.) / equivalent e.g. MFC/CA/ICWA having atleast 6 years relevant post qualification experience in Banking/Financial Institutions, out of which atleast 3 yrs. should be in an executive position. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Senior Manager (Finance): MBA (Fin.) / equivalent e.g. MFC/CA/ICWA having atleast 6 years relevant post qualification experience in Banking/Financial Institutions, out of which atleast 3 yrs. should be in an executive position. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Manager (P&A): MBA (Personnel) or equivalent degree with atleast 2 yrs. relevant post qualification experience in handling personnel & general administration in Corporate environment. Preference will be given to a person holding an additional degree in law. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Senior Manager (IA): 1st class B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering Preferably MBA as Additional qualification with minimum 6 yr. relevant post qualification experience in development/creation and maintenance of Industrial Infrastructure., out of which atleast 3yrs. should be in an executive position. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Manager (IA): 1st class B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering Preferably MBA as Additional qualification with minimum 2 yr. relevant post qualification experience in development/creation and maintenance of Industrial Infrastructure. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Manager (Accounts): CA/ICWA with atleast 2 years relevant post qualification experience in Industry/Financial Institution/Banks in the Accounts Stream. MBA will be an added advantage. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Manager (Legal): Graduate (2nd Division), LL.B Professional (2nd Division) with atleast 2 years relevant post qualification experience in Govt./Commercial organizations/Financial Institutions/Banks in drafting of deeds/ agreements/terms/conditions/examinations of legal documents and pursuing of legal cases. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Assistant Town Planner: A post graduate degree or diploma in urban and regional planning/urban planning/regional planning/M.Tech in Planning (urban, Traffic and Transport, Housing, Infrastructure), or equivalent making the holder eligible for Associate Membership of the Institute of Town Planners, India. OR B.Tech degree in planning from a recognized institute/university with two years experience in the field of Town Planning under a qualified Town Planner. The incumbent should be well conversant with AutoCAD. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Senior Manager (Estate): 1st Class B.E/B.Tech or MBA or both having minimum 6 years relevant post qualification experience in a Public Undertaking or an organization of repute, out of which atleast 3 years experience should be in an executive position. LLB will be an added advantage. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Manager (Estate): 1st Class B.E/B.Tech or MBA or both having minimum 2 years relevant post qualification experience in a Public Undertaking or an organization of repute, LLB will be an added advantage. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.

Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.
  • Jr. System Analyst/Programmer: 1st Class B.E./ B.Tech. in information Technology/ Computer Science/MCA from a recognized University/ Institute, with minimum 2 yrs. relevant post qualification experience in a Public Sector Undertaking/ Financial Institution/ Bank. Candidate should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit upto Matric Standard.

Age Limit 

  • Candidate should not be less than 18 years and not more than 42 years.
  • Schedules Castes of Haryana - 5 years
  • Backward Classes of Haryana - 5 years
  • Disabled persons who are covered under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. - 5 year's relaxation in age (+5 years if PwBD applicant belongs to S/Castes, S/Tribe, B/Classes, EWS category (subject to maximum of 52 years) for Group A & B posts where recruitment is made through open competitive examination.
  • Wife of military personnel who are disabled while in military service; - 5 years
  • Widowed or legally divorced woman; - 5 years
  • Judicially separated woman residing separately for more than two years from the date as prescribed for the purpose of age for applicants of other categories. - 5 years
  • Unmarried woman. - 5 years
  • Ex-serviceman including Short Service Commissioned Officers and Emergency Commissioned Officers. - Relaxation in age to the extent of his military service added by three years provided – (a) he has rendered continuous military service for a period of not less than six months before his release; and (b) he was released otherwise than by way of dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency.
  • Persons who have already worked or presently working on ad hoc/contract/work-charged/ daily wages basis in any Department / Board / Corporation of Haryana Government including Government-aided Institutions under Haryana Government. - Relaxation in age equal to the number of completed years only on equivalent post on ad hoc/ contract/ work-charged/ daily wages basis excluding the period of break, if any, including any other age relaxation admissible, if any, subject to maximum age of 52 years and also subject to the condition that if once a person has been appointed on regular basis in any Department / Board / Corporation etc. of Haryana Government with the benefit of relaxation in age he will not be entitled to avail the same again for any subsequent appointment.

Application Fee

  • All Persons of Haryana with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) (with at least 40% disability) - NIL
  • Candidates belonging to OSC, DSC, BC-A (Non Creamy Layer), BC-B (Non Creamy Layer), ESM, EWS and women candidates of Haryana - 250/-
  • DESM Candidates of Haryana belonging to their vertical category i.e. OSC, DSC, BC-A (Non Creamy Layer), BC-B (Non Creamy Layer), ESM, EWS of Haryana - 250/-
  • DESM Candidates of Haryana belonging to UR Category - 1000/-
  • All remaining candidates - 1000/-

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Opening date for submission of online applications 15/01/2026
Closing date for the submission of online applications 16/02/2026 upto 05:00 PM
Closing date for deposit of Fee 16/02/2026 upto 05:00 PM

Selection Process

  • In the event of number of applications being large, Commission may adopt any one of the following modes for shortlisting the candidates for the next stage of the recruitment process.
  • On the basis of percentage of marks of the candidates in the minimum educational qualification prescribed in the advertisement.
  • On the basis of percentage of marks of the candidates in different educational qualifications, with weightage as decided by the Commission.
  • On the basis of desirable-qualifications or any one or all of the desirable qualifications, if more than one desirable qualification is prescribed.
  • On the basis of higher educational qualifications than the minimum/essential qualification prescribed in the advertisement.
  • On the basis of higher experience in the relevant field than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement.
  • By counting experience before or after the acquisition of minimum/essential qualifications.
  • By holding a Screening test and/or Subject Knowledge Test.
  • Generally, the Commission has a three stage recruitment process i.e. Screening Test followed by Subject Knowledge Test and interview. However the Commission can decide to hold a Screening Test and then a Subject Knowledge Test or it may directly hold a Subject Knowledge Test without holding a Screening Test.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates will have to compulsorily register online by visiting http://hpsc.gov.in for submitting their online application form. Detailed instructions for filling up online applications are available on the above mentioned website. No other means / mode of submission of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates can register online by using their Mobile Number & Aadhar Number. In case the data in Aadhar Card is not updated the candidate should apply through Mobile Number.
  • After registration, a login ID would be created.
  • The candidates can apply against the advertisement, as per their qualifications, by using their login ID.
  • In case the candidates are applying using their Aadhar Number., their data would be verified from the relevant site. Hence the candidates should ensure that the data of their Aadhar Card is updated.
  • Aadhar Number/Virtual ID (VID) is required for Aadhar authentication during Biometric attendance.
  • After filling up the application form, the candidates would have to submit the same by making payment of requisite fee.
  • After making payment, the candidate must take a printout of his/her application form and upload the same after duly checking & signing it.
  • In case a candidate does not upload a signed copy of downloaded application form, his/her application would be considered incomplete, and candidature of such candidate would be automatically rejected.
  • The candidate should carefully enter his/her particulars and details in the online application form because after submission of the online application form, no change in any particular/detail would be allowed.
  • The eligibility of the candidate with regard to age, educational qualifications, experience etc. shall be determined on the Closing Date fixed for submission of online application forms.
  • All applicants must fulfil the essential requirements of the post and other conditions stipulated in the advertisement on the Closing Date.
  • No certificate or document issued after the Closing Date will be accepted by the Commission at any stage of the selection process.
  • The improvement in marks done by a candidate after the Closing Date shall not be considered for any purpose in this recruitment.
  • Fees once paid will not be refunded.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee (unless remission of fee is claimed) shall be summarily rejected.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
  • The candidates should ensure that they possess the qualifications mentioned in the advertisement.
  • The online Applications can be submitted up to the Closing Date i.e. 16.02.2026 till 05:00 PM.
  • For more information, log on to https://hpsc.gov.in
  • Relaxation in the maximum age to the candidates belonging to the DSC/OSC/BC-A (Non Creamy Layer)/BC-B (Non Creamy Layer)/EWS/ESM category candidate of Haryana shall be admissible only where the posts are reserved for this category.
  • The upper age limit for an applicant of any category (except Ex-servicemen) shall not exceed 52 years who is entitled to avail the benefit of relaxation in age of one or more of the categories mentioned above.
  • For the candidates at Sr. No. (ix) above, for getting age relaxation, the experience certificate(s) of equivalent post issued by the Appointing Authority of Respective Department / Board / Corporation / Govt. Aided Institution only shall be valid.
  • The candidate should read the advertisement carefully before filling in the online application form and ensure that he/she fulfils all the eligibility conditions mentioned therein including the essential qualifications required for the post for which the candidate wants to apply, age limit, nature of experience required etc.
  • The candidate should start the process of filling in the online application form well in time so that he/she is able to complete the same before the closing date.
  • Application forms of the candidates who do not fulfill the essential qualifications, age and experience, if any, requirements would not be accepted by the portal.
  • Admission to the recruitment examination, if any, would be provisional and would not confer any right on the candidates to be considered eligible in all respects for the advertised post.
  • For this recruitment, a candidate must be either: - (a) a citizen

How to Apply

  • Visit http://hpsc.gov.in and register using Mobile Number & Aadhar Number.
  • Create login ID.
  • Apply against the advertisement using login ID.
  • Verify data if using Aadhar.
  • Fill the application form and make payment of fee.
  • Take printout, sign, and upload the application form.
  • Ensure signed copy is uploaded, else application incomplete.
  • No changes after submission.

THSTI Project Assistant, Lab Attendant And More Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Company Name BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI)
Post Name Project Assistant, Lab Attendant And More Posts
No of Posts 13
Salary Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 75,000/-
Qualification B.Sc, B.Tech/B.E, 12TH, M.Pharma, M.E/M.Tech, DMLT
Age Limit 30 to 50 Years
Walk in date 05-02-2026 to 13-02-2026
Official Website https://thsti.in

Vacancy Details

Post Name No. of Posts
Project Assistant 01
Lab Attendant 01
Project Technical Support-III 01
Research Officer 01
Technical Officer-II 02
Quality Assurance Associate 01
Technical Officer-I 01
Documentation Officer 01
Senior Lab Assistant 01
Lab Technician 03

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification

  • Project Assistant: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University
  • Lab Attendant: 12th from a recognized board
  • Project Technical Support-III: M.Sc. / M.Tech. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognised university OR B.Sc. / B.Tech. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognised university
  • Research Officer: M.Sc. in Clinical Research, M.Pharm/ M.Tech/ M.Sc. in Life Sciences with focus on Clinical Research/ MPH or Health & Hospital Management, and M.Sc. in Epidemiology/ Pharmacology, Nursing/ Allied Health Sciences with research methodology exposure
  • Technical Officer-II: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university
  • Quality Assurance Associate: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences
  • Technical Officer-I: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university
  • Documentation Officer: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university
  • Senior Lab Assistant: B.Sc. from a recognized university OR Three years’ DMLT
  • Lab Technician: B.Sc. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university OR Three years’ DMLT

Essential Qualification

  • Project Assistant: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University with at least one (1) year of post-qualification work experience in a research or academic laboratory
  • Lab Attendant: 12th from a recognized board with atleast two (2) years’ of post-qualification experience in relevant field
  • Project Technical Support-III: M.Sc. / M.Tech. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognised university OR B.Sc. / B.Tech. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognised university with two (2) years of post-qualification experience
  • Research Officer: M.Sc. in Clinical Research, M.Pharm/ M.Tech/ M.Sc. in Life Sciences with focus on Clinical Research/ MPH or Health & Hospital Management, and M.Sc. in Epidemiology/ Pharmacology, Nursing/ Allied Health Sciences with research methodology exposure
  • Technical Officer-II: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university with at least four (4) years’ of post- qualification experience in vaccine development, recombinant protein purification, assays for serology, virus neutralization, pseudovirus generation etc
  • Quality Assurance Associate: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences with three (3) years’ of post- qualification experience in implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems (QMS) in clinical trial sample testing, bioanalytical, or diagnostic laboratories, with working knowledge of GCP, GLP, NABL/ISO standards, and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Technical Officer-I: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university with atleast two (2) years’ of post- qualification experience in vaccine development, recombinant protein purification, assays for serology, virus neutralization, pseudovirus generation etc
  • Documentation Officer: Master’s degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university with atleast two (2) years’ of post- qualification experience in documentation control and management in clinical trial, bioanalytical, or diagnostic laboratories, including preparation, review, issuance, version control, archival, and retrieval of SOPs, manuals, formats, and records as per QMS requirements
  • Senior Lab Assistant: B.Sc. from a recognized university with atleast three (3) years’ of post qualification experience in a research lab OR Three years’ DMLT with five (5) years’ of post qualification experience in a research lab
  • Lab Technician: B.Sc. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university OR Three years’ DMLT with one (1) year of post qualification experience in the relevant field in a research/diagnostic laboratory or a biotech company

Desirable Qualification

  • Project Assistant: Familiarity with laboratory Instruments and consumables
  • Project Technical Support-III: Proficiency in bioinformatics analyses for metagenomes, whole genomes (with nanopore) and Nanostring
  • Research Officer: Three (3) years of experience in clinical research and development
  • Technical Officer-II: Proficiency in ELISA and cell based assays
  • Technical Officer-I: Proficiency in ELISA and cell based assays
  • Documentation Officer: Working knowledge of GCP, GLP, GDP, and regulatory documentation practices

Experience

  • Project Assistant: at least one (1) year of post-qualification work experience in a research or academic laboratory
  • Lab Attendant: atleast two (2) years’ of post-qualification experience in relevant field
  • Project Technical Support-III: two (2) years of post-qualification experience
  • Research Officer: Three (3) years of experience in clinical research and development
  • Technical Officer-II: at least four (4) years’ of post- qualification experience in vaccine development, recombinant protein purification, assays for serology, virus neutralization, pseudovirus generation etc
  • Quality Assurance Associate: three (3) years’ of post- qualification experience in implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems (QMS) in clinical trial sample testing, bioanalytical, or diagnostic laboratories, with working knowledge of GCP, GLP, NABL/ISO standards, and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Technical Officer-I: atleast two (2) years’ of post- qualification experience in vaccine development, recombinant protein purification, assays for serology, virus neutralization, pseudovirus generation etc
  • Documentation Officer: atleast two (2) years’ of post- qualification experience in documentation control and management in clinical trial, bioanalytical, or diagnostic laboratories, including preparation, review, issuance, version control, archival, and retrieval of SOPs, manuals, formats, and records as per QMS requirements
  • Senior Lab Assistant: atleast three (3) years’ of post qualification experience in a research lab OR five (5) years’ of post qualification experience in a research lab
  • Lab Technician: one (1) year of post qualification experience in the relevant field in a research/diagnostic laboratory or a biotech company

Salary/ Stipend

  • Project Assistant: Rs. 30,000/-
  • Lab Attendant: Rs. 25,000/-
  • Project Technical Support-III: Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA
  • Research Officer: Rs. 45,000/-
  • Technical Officer-II: Rs. 75,000/-
  • Quality Assurance Associate: Rs. 60,000/-
  • Technical Officer-I: Rs. 60,000/-
  • Documentation Officer: Rs. 60,000/-
  • Senior Lab Assistant: Rs. 45,000/-
  • Lab Technician: Rs. 30,000/-

Age Limit

  • Project Assistant: 30 years
  • Lab Attendant: 50 years
  • Project Technical Support-III: 35 years
  • Research Officer: 35 years
  • Technical Officer-II: 35 years
  • Quality Assurance Associate: 30 years
  • Technical Officer-I: 30 years
  • Documentation Officer: 30 years
  • Senior Lab Assistant: 30 years
  • Lab Technician: 30 years

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 21 January 2026
Walk-in Interview for Project Assistant and Lab Attendant 5 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Project Technical Support-III 9 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Quality Assurance Associate and Documentation Officer 10 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Research Officer and Technical Officer-II 11 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Technical Officer-I and Senior Lab Assistant 12 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Lab Technician 13 February 2026

Selection Process

  • written test/skill test/interview

General Information / Instructions

  • These are the short-term positions, and extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbents and tenure of the project for which they are selected. Those appointed to these positions will not have any claim for regularization of their employment. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University.
  • The experience requirement specified above shall be the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications specified for the post. The candidates are required to satisfy themselves, before applying /appearing for the selection process, that they possess the minimum eligibility criteria as laid down in the recruitment advertisement.
  • No query will be entertained with regard to eligibility criteria. The date of Interview of the respective post will be the CRUCIAL DATE for determining eligibility with regard to age, experience, essential qualification etc.
  • Age and other relaxations for direct recruits and departmental candidates: 1. By five years for candidates belonging to SC/ST communities. 2. By three years for candidates belonging to OBC communities. 3. For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) falling under the following categories: (i) UR - ten years, ii) OBC - 13 years (iii) SC/ST - 15 4. Age is relaxable for Central Government servants up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government, from time-to-time. 5. Institute employees will get the age relaxation to the extent of the service rendered by them as on closing date of advertisement. 6. For Ex-servicemen upto the extent of service rendered in defense forces (Army, Navy & Air force) plus 3 years provided they have put in a minimum of 6 months attested service. All results/notifications will only be published on our website. Therefore, the candidates should essentially visit THSTI website, regularly.
  • All communications will only be made through email. In case many candidates appear for the walk-in interview, screening will be done to limit the number of candidates to those possessing higher/relevant qualification and experience.
  • The no. of vacancy indicated above may change subjected to the actual requirement at the time of Written test/skill test/interview. With regard to any provisions not covered in this notification, the bye laws of THSTI / Govt. of India rules / guidelines shall prevail. Canvassing wrong information in any form will be a disqualification. Government strives to have a work force which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply

How to Apply

  • For posts mentioned above, interested candidates fulfilling the criteria as mentioned above may walk-in for written test/skill test/interview at 9:00 am on the date mentioned against each positions at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001
  • The candidates must bring their latest CV/resume, one set of photocopy of documents in support of their educational qualification and experience along with their originals and a valid ID card for verification
  • Candidates coming after the time slot mentioned will not be entertained
  • All the candidates coming for written test/skill test/interview at THSTI are mandatorily required to deposit their mobile phone along with valid Identity proof at the reception and the same will only be returned back on completion of the entire selection process

DSJ Palwal Peon Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Peon 10

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: The applicant should have passed middle standard examination and possess knowledge of Hindi/Punjabi. The applicant should fulfill the condition of qualification on the last date of receipt of application.
  • Essential qualifications: Passed middle standard examination and possess knowledge of Hindi/Punjabi.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 16,900/- per month, being the minimum of the pay scale of the post of Peon.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is admissible to the reserved categories as per instructions of the Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh and / or Haryana Government.

Important Dates

Notification Date 23.01.2026
Last Date for Receipt of Applications 09.02.2026 up-to 05:00 p.m.

Selection Process

  • The applicants who full-fill the above-said qualifications for the above-said posts will have to appear for interview in the Judicial Court Complex, Kuslipur, Palwal as per schedule, which will be uploaded on the official website of this Sessions division later.
  • List of eligible candidates showing the roll numbers and date of interview will be uploaded on the website of District Courts, Palwal well before commencement of the interview, however, no separate call letters for interview will be sent/issued to the eligible candidates.

General Information/Instructions

  • The selection for the aforesaid posts shall be made strictly in accordance with the Rules of the Haryana Subordinate Courts Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1997.
  • As per Rule 7 (xi), essential qualification for the post is: The applicant should have passed middle standard examination and possess knowledge of Hindi/Punjabi. The applicant should fulfill the condition of qualification on the last date of receipt of application.
  • No person shall be recruited to the service if he/she is less than 18 years or is more than 42 years of age as on 01.01.2026, provided that relaxation in upper age limit is admissible to the reserved categories as per instructions of the Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh and / or Haryana Government.
  • The benefit of reservation is admissible only to bonafide domiciles/residents of State of Haryana, as per Government of Haryana letter No. 22/67/81-3GS III dated 15.07.1985.
  • As per explanation to Rule 7 (iii) of Haryana Subordinate Courts Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1997 ‘Where No candidate of reserved category is available then appointment would be made from unreserved category’.
  • Candidates working in the Government Department, Semi-Govt. Department, any Government Corporation/Board/Institution are required to apply through proper channel.
  • One latest passport size colored photograph self-attested must be affixed on the application form in the given space and self attested photocopies of the educational documents and certificates regarding category (caste), experience etc. must be attached with the application form. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) shall mention their category in their application and shall annex certificate regarding disability. The candidates are required to bring their original testimonials and proof of identity at the time of interview/reporting time.
  • The applicants should disclose all their educational qualifications and other declaration/certificate in the application form. Non-disclosure thereof may disqualify the concerned candidate for appointment and may also render him/her liable for prosecution under relevant provisions of law.
  • Incomplete applications or applications received without requisite documents shall be rejected straight-way without assigning any reason whatsoever. No correspondence, whatsoever shall be entertained in respect of incomplete applications or those which are refused by this office for receipt after expiry of the last date i.e. 09.02.2026. However, rejection list would be uploaded on the website of this office.
  • Any candidate belonging to General or reserved category can submit only one application for a particular category. In case a candidate submits more than one application, then last application will be considered.
  • The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per enclosed performa.
  • The certificate for the claim of reservation must be issued by the Competent Authority.
  • A candidate seeking appointment on the basis of backward class reservation must ensure that he/she possesses the latest BC certificate and does not fall in ‘Creamy Layer’. Application should be accompanied by requisite certificate and an affidavit to the effect that candidate does not fall in ‘Creamy Layer’ as per enclosed performa.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances
