  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview

Vacancy Details

Position 1: Dental Consultant Specialist

  • Number of Posts: 1
  • Upper Age Limit: 62 years (as on last date of receipt of application)
  • Salary: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Engagement Nature: 1 Year (Extendable)
  • Selection Mode: Walk-in Interview

Essential Qualifications

  • MDS in Oral Medicine and Radiology, OR
  • MDS in Public Health Dentistry
  • From a Dental Institute recognized and registered by Dental Council of India

Desirable Qualifications

  • 5 years experience in relevant field post MDS
  • Diploma in Tobacco Control
  • Preferably having experience in tobacco control

Job Description

  • Involvement with Tobacco Cessation Centre (TCC) in diagnosis and treatment of tobacco-related oral diseases.
  • Interdepartmental referral and consultation for related systemic conditions.
  • Professional services, initial patient identification and preliminary counselling.
  • Identification of community sites, planning and coordination of tobacco de-addiction and awareness programmes in schools, institutes, health centres.
  • Prescription of Pharmacotherapy (NRT or relevant medications) as per patient needs.
  • Staff training for capacity building.
  • Performance of various administrative tasks under general supervision.

Position 2: Consultant (Psychiatry)

  • Number of Posts: 1
  • Upper Age Limit: 62 years (as on last date of receipt of application)
  • Visiting Schedule: Twice a week on working days
  • Salary: Rs. 6,000/- per visiting day (subject to ceiling limit of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month)
  • Engagement Nature: 1 Year (Extendable)
  • Selection Mode: Walk-in Interview

Essential Qualifications

  • MD in Psychiatry from NMC (National Medical Commission) recognized and registered medical institute

Desirable Qualifications

  • 2 years experience in relevant field post MD
  • Relevant experience in counselling patients in academic institution/hospital setting or mental health clinic
  • Excellent communication skills

Job Description

  • This certificate should be in the prescribed format and issued by the Competent Authority authorized to issue such certificates, such as the SDO, District Magistrate, or Deputy Commissioner, as specified by the Government of India.   • The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificates must also meet the Non-Creamy Layer criteria for appointment to posts under the GoI as laid down by the GoI and not for appointment in any of the States of Union bearing references to those States Govt. orders.
  • Candidate belonging to OBC (NCL) must upload a scanned copy of Latest OBC (NCL) Certificate valid as on last date of submission of online application.

Post Name Total Posts

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • The candidate must be a Law Graduate (before taking up the assignment as Law Clerk) having a Bachelor Degree in Law (including Integrated Degree Course in Law) from any School/College/University/Institution established by law in India and recognized by the Bar Council of India for enrolment as an Advocate
  • The candidate studying in the fifth year of the Five-Year Integrated Law Course or the third year of the Three-Year Law Course after graduation in any stream will also be eligible to apply, subject to furnishing proof of acquiring Law qualification before taking up the assignment as Law Clerk-cum-Research Associate
  • The candidate must have research and analytical skills, writing abilities, and knowledge of computer, including retrieval of desired information from various search engines/processes such as e-SCR, Manupatra, SCC Online, LexisNexis, Westlaw, etc.

Important Note

  • The engagement as Law Clerk-cum-Research Associate is a full time assignment, purely contractual in nature
  • It will not confer any right on the selected candidates to claim regular appointment/continuance in service in the Supreme Court of India
  • Such engagement may be terminated by the Registry at any point of time with prescribed notice
  • A Law Clerk will not accept any other assignment during their assignment term as Law Clerk
  • They shall not practise as an Advocate in any Court of Law during the course of their assignment term as Law Clerks

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated Remuneration: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month
  • Assignment Term: 2026-2027
  • Nature of Engagement: Purely contractual assignment on short-term basis
  • Working Hours: Candidates will be required to work even at odd hours and on holidays, in exigency of work
  • Posting: The Registry reserves the right to utilize the services of the Law Clerks and they can be posted at any place in the Registry/Courts/Chambers/Residential Office of Hon'ble the Chief Justice of India/Hon'ble Judges, according to administrative exigency

Age Limit (as on 07-02-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 20 years (The candidate must not be below the age of 20 years)
  • Maximum Age: 32 years (The candidate must not be above 32 years)
  • Age Calculation Date: Age limit will be calculated as on 07.02.2026

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
All Candidates Rs. 750/- plus bank charges (if applicable)

Payment Mode

  • Non-refundable Application/Test Fee of Rs. 750/- plus bank charges, if applicable
  • Fee shall be paid online through Payment Gateway provided by UCO Bank
  • Fee payment through online mode only
  • Fee shall not be accepted in any other form
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances

Last Date for Online Objections 09/03/2026 till 11:59 PM

Selection Process

  • Part I - Multiple Choice Based Questions: Testing the candidates' ability to understand and apply the law, and comprehension skills
    • Test will be conducted in online mode
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 60 per cent
    • Negative marking of 0.25 mark for each incorrect answer
  • Part II - Subjective Written Test: Covering writing and analytical skills
    • Question paper will be visible on Computer Screen
    • Candidates have to write answers in pen-paper mode
  • Part III - Interview: Candidates who successfully qualify both Part-I and Part-II Tests will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:3 as against the number of tentative vacancies
  • Evaluation Ratio: In case large number of candidates qualify Part-I Test by securing minimum qualifying marks of 60 per cent, based on the merit list, the answer sheets of Part-II Test will be evaluated following the ratio of 1:10 as against the number of tentative vacancies
  • Model Answer Keys: Will be uploaded on the website on 08.03.2026 and will be available till 11:59 p.m. on 09.03.2026, for inviting online objections, if any, from the candidates relating to Part-I Test, subject to payment of fee of Rs. 100/- per objection, which will be refunded in case the objection is found to be valid
  • Details of the Pattern of Examination, Minimum Qualifying Standards, Terms and Conditions are available in the "Scheme of Engaging Law Clerk-cum-Research Associates on Short-Term Contractual Assignment in the Supreme Court of India-January 2024, as amended"

Test Centres

  • Part I and Part II Tests shall be conducted on the same day (07.03.2026) in two sessions
  • A break shall be provided to the candidates between the conducting of Part-I and Part-II Tests
  • Test Centers (23 cities): Ahmedabad, Ambala, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Imphal, Jodhpur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Patna, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Srinagar, Thiruvananthapuram and Visakhapatnam
  • The number of Test centers may be increased or decreased, subject to the number of applications received, as per the directions of the Hon'ble Chief Justice of India or the Committee of Hon'ble Judges on Law Clerks
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for appearing in the Written Test

General Information/Instructions

  • The applicants would be admitted to the Written Tests on the basis of the information furnished by them in their application form. They are advised to ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions before applying
  • If any candidate is found to have given false information or does not fulfill any of the eligibility conditions, the candidature of such applicant would be cancelled and no correspondence in this regard would be entertained
  • Issuance of Admit Card for the examination will NOT confer any right for selection
  • The candidate will be required to upload the scanned copy of his/her recent photograph and signature on the online application form in accordance with the instructions displayed on the link
  • Candidates should ensure that the particulars filled in the online application form are correct in all respects before final submission of application form
  • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified
  • On submitting application online, the candidate will get a preview of application with Application Number. The candidate is advised to get a printout of the filled-up application for his/her record
  • The candidate should retain his/her Application Number carefully for generation of admit card/call letter and for any other information regarding Written Test/Interview etc.
  • Information sent on the registered e-Mail ID and through SMS on the registered mobile number of the candidate shall be deemed to have been received by the candidate
  • In case any candidate submits more than one application form, he/she must note that the application last submitted will only be entertained by the Registry
  • Applications which do not comply with the instructions shall be summarily rejected
  • Any attempt on the part of a candidate to obtain support for his candidature by any unfair means will disqualify him and legal action will also be taken against him
  • Final engagement will be subject to the candidate(s) fulfilling the eligibility conditions, verification of their academic certificates and other required formalities
  • The Registry reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection process, if needed, without issuing any notice
  • In case of any dispute(s), legal jurisdiction will be Delhi
  • All rights regarding the contractual engagement of Law Clerks are reserved with the Hon'ble Chief Justice of India or any Authority authorized in that behalf

Facility for PwD Candidates

  • The facility of scribe can be availed of by a PwD candidate by filling up the proforma Annexure-I or Annexure-IA, as the case may be, on production of certificate(s), which entitles him to avail such facility

  • Such candidates must produce relevant documents for the eligibility of scribe/compensatory time at the time of Examination and document verification
  • Failure to produce supporting documents will disentitle them the facility of scribe and will lead to cancellation of their candidature for the Examination
  • No attendant, other than the scribe for the eligible candidate, will be allowed to enter the Examination Hall

How to Apply

  • Fill the online application form with all required details carefully

  • Pay the non-refundable Application/Test Fee of Rs. 750/- plus bank charges through online mode using Payment Gateway provided by UCO Bank
  • After successful submission, take a printout of the filled-up application with Application Number for your record
  • Retain the Application Number carefully for generation of admit card/call letter and other information
  • Complete the online registration before the last date: 07.02.2026
  • In case of any technical or other query, call at Helpline numbers available on the weblink
  • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature

  • The recruitment methodology is structured into a two-stage process: a Computer based online written test, called Computer Based Test (CBT) and a Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • The final composite weightage in the recruitment methodology shall be 60% for the Coaching Ability Test and 40% for the Computer based online written test.

  • The candidates appearing in the written examination i.e CBT shall be shortlisted for the Coaching Ability Test (CAT) in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test will be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.

Educational Qualification for CSIR-NPL Vacancy 2026

For TA01 - Mechanical Engineering (5 Posts):

  • Marks: Minimum 60%
  • Experience: 2 years in relevant area/field

For TA02 - Electronics/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Instrumentation Engineering (6 Posts):

  • Qualification: Diploma in Electronics/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Instrumentation Engineering (3 years full-time OR 2 years lateral admission)

  • Experience: 2 years in relevant area/field

For TA03 - Civil Engineering (2 Posts):

  • Qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering (3 years full-time OR 2 years lateral admission)
  • Marks: Minimum 60%
  • Experience: 2 years in relevant area/field

For TA04 - Computer Science/Information Technology (1 Post):

  • Qualification: Diploma in Computer Science/Information Technology (3 years full-time OR 2 years lateral admission)
  • Marks: Minimum 60%
  • Experience: 2 years in relevant area/field
  • OR
  • Qualification: B.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology) or equivalent
  • Marks: Minimum 60%
  • Experience: 1 year in relevant discipline

For TA05 - Physics/Applied Physics (3 Posts):

  • Qualification: B.Sc. (Physics/Applied Physics) or equivalent
  • Marks: Minimum 60%
  • Experience: 1 year in relevant discipline from recognized Institute/Organization

For TA06 - Chemistry (1 Post):

  • Qualification: B.Sc. (Chemistry) or equivalent
  • Marks: Minimum 60%
  • Experience: 1 year in relevant discipline from recognized Institute/Organization

Important Notes:

  • All qualifications must be from Government recognized Universities/Institutes
  • Final results should be declared on or before 27-02-2026
  • Experience on part-time/daily wages/visiting/guest faculty basis will NOT be counted
  • Period of experience counted only after acquiring minimum essential educational qualification
  • Specific subject mentioned must be a main/core subject in B.Sc.

Post Maximum Age

Application Fee for CSIR-NPL Online Form 2026

Candidates applying for CSIR-NPL vacancy 2026 need to pay the following fee:

Category Application Fee
General/UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS ₹500/- (Five Hundred Rupees)
SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Ex-Servicemen NIL (Exempted)

  • E-receipt of payment must be uploaded in online application portal
  • Applications without prescribed fee (for non-exempted categories) will be summarily rejected
  • Fee once paid cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment

Selection Process for CSIR-NPL Recruitment 2026

The selection for CSIR-NPL vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Stage 1 - Screening by Committee

  • Applications will be scrutinized by duly constituted Screening Committee
  • Committee will adopt its own criteria for shortlisting candidates
  • Only shortlisted candidates called for Trade Test

Stage 2 - Trade Test (Qualifying Nature)

  • Trade test in relevant trade/discipline
  • Schedule: May/June 2026
  • Nature: Qualifying test
  • Minimum threshold marks to be determined by Selection Committee
  • Only candidates qualifying in Trade Test will be called for Written Examination

Stage 3 - Competitive Written Examination

Mode: OMR Based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination

Medium: Questions in both English and Hindi (except English Language questions)

Standard: Diploma/Graduation Level

Total Questions: 200

Total Time: 3 hours

Examination Pattern:

Paper-I (Mental Ability Test) - 1 Hour, Qualifying

  • Questions: 50
  • Maximum Marks: 100 (2 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: None
  • Topics: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgement

Paper-II - 30 Minutes

  • General Awareness: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • English Language: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • Total: 50 questions, 150 marks

Paper-III (Concerned Subject) - 90 Minutes

  • Questions: 100
  • Maximum Marks: 300 (3 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: 1 mark per wrong answer
  • Topics: Concerned subject as per post code applied

Merit List Preparation:

  • Paper-I is qualifying in nature
  • Paper-II and Paper-III evaluated only for candidates securing minimum threshold marks in Paper-I
  • Final merit based on performance in Paper-II and Paper-III combined
  • Minimum threshold marks (Cut-off) will be notified before written exam

Tie Resolution (in order of precedence):

  1. Higher marks in concerned subject/trade papers
  2. Lesser negative marks in concerned subject/trade
  3. Lesser negative marks in all evaluated papers
  4. Older candidate (Date of Birth)
  5. Earlier acquisition of Essential Degree
  6. Alphabetical order of first names

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience

A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency

  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Physics and Mathematics from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English in Vocational Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation, if English is not a subject in Vocational Course).

For Other than Science Subjects:

  • Passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent Examination in any stream/subjects from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.

  • Refund Policy: Application fee and other charges once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and neither the same be held reserved for any other recruitment or selection process.

Event Date/Time
Online Registration Start Date 12 January 2026 at 1100 Hr
Online Registration End Date 08 February 2026 at 2300 Hr
Phase-I Online Exam Date 30 March 2026 / 31 March 2026
Admit Card for Phase-I 48-72 hours prior to examination
Provisional Select List Display 14 November 2026
Enrolment List Publication 01 December 2026
Validity of Provisional Select List Six months from date of display (Only for Intake 01/2027)

Selection Process

  • Phase-I - Online Test: Objective type test (bilingual - English & Hindi except English paper)
    • Science Subjects: 60 minutes - Physics, Mathematics and English as per 10+2 CBSE syllabus
    • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes - English and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA)
    • Both (Science & Other than Science): 85 minutes - Physics, Mathematics, English and RAGA
    • Marking Pattern: +1 mark for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -0.25 for wrong answer
  • Normalisation of Marks: Marks will be normalised to account for variation in difficulty levels across different sessions
  • Phase-II Testing at ASC: State-wise shortlisted candidates will be called for:
    • Document Verification
    • Physical Fitness Test (PFT-I & PFT-II)
    • Adaptability Test-I (Objective type written test)
    • Adaptability Test-II (As per policy in vogue)
  • Physical Fitness Test Details:
    • PFT-I: 1.6 Km run (Male: within 7 minutes, Female: within 8 minutes)
    • PFT-II for Male: 10 Push-ups (1 min), 10 Sit-ups (1 min), 20 Squats (1 min)
    • PFT-II for Female: 10 Sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 Squats (1 min)
  • Phase-III - Medical Examination: Conducted by Air Force Medical Team as per IAF medical standards including baseline investigations (Blood tests, Urine tests, X-Ray, ECG, USG for females, etc.)
  • Appeal Medical Board: Available for candidates declared medically unfit (Fee: ₹40/-)
  • Final Selection: Based on state-wise merit, medical fitness, availability of vacancies, and meeting all eligibility criteria

General Information/Instructions

  • Marital Status: Only unmarried candidates (male & female) are eligible. Candidates shall undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period. Marriage during service will result in discharge.
  • Pregnancy Policy: Female candidates shall undertake not to get pregnant during engagement period. Pregnancy will result in discharge and debar from Regular Cadre selection.
  • Medical Standards:
    • Height: Minimum 152 cms for male and female (relaxation for North East/hilly regions/Lakshadweep)
    • Weight: Proportionate to height and age
    • Chest: Male - minimum 77 cms with 5 cms expansion; Female - minimum 5 cms expansion
    • Vision: 6/12 each eye correctable to 6/6, Colour Vision: CP-II
    • Hearing: Normal - able to hear forced whisper from 6 meters
    • Dental: Minimum 14 dental points with healthy gums
    • No history of LASIK/PRK surgery
  • Body Tattoo: Permanent body tattoos not permitted except on inner forearms, back of hand/palm, and tribal tattoos as per custom. Offensive tattoos prohibited.
  • NDPS Policy: Zero tolerance to consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances. Consumption is a reject criterion.
  • Domicile Categories: Permanent Domicile, COAFP-I (Children of Serving Air Force Personnel), COAFP-II (Children of Retired/Discharged/Deceased Air Force Personnel)
  • Engagement Period: Four years under Air Force Act 1950
  • Regular Cadre Opportunity: Up to 25% of each batch may be enrolled in regular cadre based on performance and organisational requirements
  • Leave Entitlement: 30 days annual leave per year plus sick leave as per medical advice
  • Medical & CSD Facilities: Available at Service Hospitals during engagement period
  • No ESM Status: Agniveervayu will not be eligible for Ex-Servicemen status after completion of four years
  • NDA/AFCAT Attempts: Permitted to appear (maximum three attempts) during engagement period subject to conditions
  • Identification Requirements: AADHAAR Card mandatory (exemption for J&K, Ladakh, Assam, Meghalaya candidates)
  • Examination Centres: Candidates to indicate five choices but CASB reserves right to allot any centre
  • No TA/DA: No travel allowance or daily allowance admissible for any stage of selection
  • Mobile Phones Prohibited: Mobile phones/smart watches/electronic devices prohibited in testing areas. Possession will result in permanent debarment.
  • Malpractices: Candidates found indulging in malpractices/unfair means shall be debarred permanently
  • Disclaimer: IAF reserves the right to cancel entire selection process at any stage without assigning any reasons

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: ONLY Online applications accepted
  • Website: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in
  • Registration Process:
    • Step-I: Register with personal details and contact details. User-ID will be email ID and password will be sent via email/SMS
    • Step-II: Re-login to complete personal details, communication details, qualification details, declaration and upload documents
    • Enter OTPs sent to mobile and email for verification
    • Fill all required details carefully
  • Required Documents for Upload:
    • Passport size recent colour photograph (100-200 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) - taken within one month holding black slate with name and date
    • Candidate's signature image (80-150 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) - black ink on white paper
    • Parent's/Guardian's signature (if below 18 years)
    • Left thumb impression image (50-100 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format)
    • Live image capture via web camera during registration
  • Payment: Pay examination fee of ₹550 + 18% GST via Payment Gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI)
  • Print Application: Take printout of submitted application form and retain for future reference
  • Important Notes:
    • Valid email ID and mobile number mandatory
    • Apply only once - multiple applications will result in rejection
    • Data entered during registration will be final - no changes permitted later
    • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn
    • Candidates advised to register at earliest as no extension will be accommodated
  • Admit Card: Will be sent 48-72 hours before exam on registered email ID
  • For Queries: Contact CASB at 011-25694209/25699606, Email: [email protected] or [email protected], Mobile: +91-9513253233 (0900-1800 Hrs, Monday to Saturday)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification for COO: Bachelor’s in Technology/Engineering (or equivalent degree) or Master in Technology/ Engineering/ Science or MBA from a recognized, accredited and reputed institute/university
  • Experience for COO: Minimum 8 years of overall experience in the IT industry, start-up ecosystem as co-founder/founder/CxO and/or as an enabler of Start-up, Innovation & entrepreneurship ecosystem by virtue of managing/leading/scaling reputed Innovation & start-up promoting organizations/ incubators/ accelerators/ centres-of-entrepreneurship/ entrepreneurship development cells / mentoring organization etc

  • Desirable Qualification for Incubation Manager: Post-Graduation in Management
  • Experience for Incubation Manager: 5+ years of work experience including minimum 3 years of experience in incubation management & Incubation Ecosystem, demonstrating ability to cultivate, build and maintain strong working relationships with start-ups, entrepreneurs, mentors, universities, research institutions, industry experts, associations, chamber of commerce & industries, state & central government, angel investors etc.
  • Essential Qualification for Technology Specialist: Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechatronics or related field.
  • Desirable Qualification for Technology Specialist: Post-Graduation in related fields.
  • Experience for Technology Specialist: Should have 4 to 6 Years of experience in IoT and experience preferably in applications in IoT, energy, water, or environmental IoT solutions.

  • COO: Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) per month (relaxation as per industry standards permissible for deserving candidates) subjected to provisions in DPR.
  • Incubation Manager: In the range of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 75,000 per month (relaxation as per industry standards permissible for deserving candidates).
  • Technology Specialist: Rs. 100000/- (Rupees one Lakh only) per month (relaxation as per industry standards permissible for deserving candidates).

  • COO: Below 45 years (relaxation permissible for deserving candidates)
  • Incubation Manager: Below 35 years (relaxation permissible for deserving candidates)
  • Technology Specialist: Below 40 years (relaxation permissible for deserving candidates)

Selection Process

  • Applications received by the last date will be first screened by a duly constituted ‘Screening Committee’. The candidates meeting the educational & other qualifications and experience, as advertised, may be screened-in by the Committee.
  • The ‘screened-in’ shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview before the duly constituted ‘Search-cum-Selection Committee’ or ‘Selection Committee’ on the scheduled date & time. The committee may consider other candidates also fulfilling the eligibility as advertised.
  • Search-cum-Selection Committee or Selection Committee will recommend the candidate/panel of candidates, in order of merit, for appointment.

General Information / Instructions

  • The COO shall report to STPI Jurisdictional Director.
  • The IM shall report to COO or STPI Jurisdictional Director as decided by the STPI Jurisdictional Director.
  • The Finance Executive shall report to the Head of CoE-EA or STPI Jurisdictional Director as decided by the STPI Jurisdictional Director.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any candidate found canvassing for his/her candidature, will be summarily disqualified.
  • Experience in the relevant field shall be calculated after attaining the minimum essential qualification(s).
  • Mere submission of application does not entitle candidates to be called for test and/or interview.
  • Certificate w.r.t. educational qualifications, experience, age etc. will be uploaded by the candidates while submitting online application.
  • If any candidate is found ineligible on any ground post his/her appointment in the company, his/her services will be liable to be terminated without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Submission of any false/misleading information, defective or fabricated document etc. by the candidate in the application form would not only lead for rejection of application of the candidate but other legal action, as deem appropriate, may also be taken by the Company against such candidate.
  • The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience.
  • No TA/DA will be given for appearing in the interview.
  • Contract may be renewed based on performance. Work location can change based on mutual agreement.
  • Any litigation will be subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.
  • STPI reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason as it deems fit.

NeGD SIDH Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility & Roles

1. Data & Analytics Lead

Job Title Data & Analytics Lead
Location New Delhi
Project SIDH
Experience 8+ years (with minimum 3 years leading analytics initiatives)
Budget As per market standards

Educational Qualifications

  • B.Tech./M.Tech/M.S./PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related quantitative field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 8+ years in data analytics, business intelligence, or quantitative research with at least 3 years leading analytics initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement analytics frameworks for platform performance and user behaviour monitoring aligned with SIDH Digital Public Infrastructure objectives.
  • Oversee real-time dashboards on skill acquisition, certification, employment outcomes, and scheme effectiveness across government programmes.
  • Establish data governance protocols ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
  • Drive predictive analytics to forecast skilling demand, optimise resource allocation, and identify emerging skill gaps.
  • Translate complex data insights into policy recommendations for MSDE and stakeholders.
  • Manage data quality assurance across integrated platforms.
  • Develop advanced analytics models for personalised learning pathways and career guidance.
  • Coordinate integration of external systems (Aadhaar eKYC, DigiLocker, PFMS, etc.) into SIDH data lake/warehouse.

Essential Skills

  • Data engineering & orchestration on AWS: Informatica 10.5.4, Airflow, Jenkins, Kafka, PySpark/Spark.
  • Data lakes/warehouses: S3, Redshift/Snowflake, SQL/NoSQL (Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra).
  • BI & Reporting: Power BI.
  • Advanced analytics: Python/R for ML, NLP, forecasting, experimentation.

Desirable Skills

  • Tableau/QuickSight, Elasticsearch; Delta/Iceberg lakehouse, Glue Catalog.
  • MLOps (SageMaker/MLflow), unstructured/NLP analytics.
  • Certifications like AWS Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer, Power BI, and prior public sector analytics experience.

2. UI/UX Lead

Job Title UI/UX Lead
Location New Delhi
Project SIDH
Experience 8+ years in UI/UX with at least 5 years in a senior designer role
Budget As per market standards

Experience & Role

  • 8+ years in UI/UX design with 5+ years in senior role; experience in large corporations or government IT organisations.
  • Lead design strategy, user research, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design for web and mobile platforms.
  • Work closely with product, development, BA, and stakeholder teams to deliver user-centric solutions.
  • Drive user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and adoption of responsive design frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure adherence to accessibility (WCAG), GIGW 3.0, and design system standards.
  • Translate user and business needs into intuitive, consistent interfaces.
  • Mentor junior UI/UX designers and ensure quality control in all deliverables.
  • Create social media posts, newsletters, banners, and digital creatives.
  • Identify and troubleshoot UX problems; create wireframes, prototypes, storyboards, and user flows.

Tools & Skills

  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript for better developer collaboration.
  • Familiarity with testing/analytics tools like Hotjar, Maze.
  • Strong grasp of mobile-first, responsive design and visual style standards.

Educational Qualification & Desirables

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Design, HCI, Fine Arts, Visual Design/Communication, Design Computing, or related field.
  • Desirable: Experience in government/large-scale/citizen-facing platforms; agile environment exposure; tools like ClickUp, JIRA, Confluence, Trello; UI/UX/Interaction Design certifications.

NeGD SIDH Contract Jobs 2026 – General Conditions

  • Candidates already in Central/State Govt., PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at application or interview stage.
  • Posts are purely temporary for NeGD/DIC projects; no claim for permanent appointment in NeGD/DIC.
  • NeGD may fill all/some/none of the positions and may terminate appointments with one month’s notice or salary in lieu.
  • Designation mapping will be as per NeGD’s existing designation policy.

How to Apply Online for NeGD SIDH Recruitment 2026

  1. Check eligibility: Confirm that you meet the required qualifications, experience, and age criteria (not more than 55 years on the closing date).
  2. Visit the online application portal: Go to https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ from a desktop or mobile browser.
  3. Register / Login: Create a new user account (if required) with a valid email ID and mobile number, or log in with existing credentials.
  4. Select the post: Choose the relevant position (Data & Analytics Lead or UI/UX Lead) under NeGD SIDH recruitment and open the online form.
  5. Fill the application form: Enter personal details, academic qualifications, total and relevant experience, and project-specific skills accurately; upload your latest CV/resume if required.
  6. Upload documents: Attach necessary documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, and NOC (if employed in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Body), as per portal instructions.
  7. Submit the form: Review all details carefully and submit the online application before the last date; keep a copy/print of the final submitted form or acknowledgment for future reference.

Important: Screening will be based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience, and NeGD may fix higher cut-offs; only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, and NeGD reserves the right not to select any candidate.

Primary Service Judge Advocate General (JAG) Branch
Commission Type Short Service Commission (NT)
Initial Tenure 10 Years
Extended Tenure Additional 4 Years (Total 14 Years)
PC Option After 10 Years (if eligible and suitable)

Note: Indian Army publishes/notifies combined vacancies for Men and Women based on operational and administrative needs. The application process, SSB shortlisting (cut-off), selection and merit is purely based on notified vacancies and driven by applications received.

Eligibility Criteria for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

Before applying for Indian Army JAG online form 2026, candidates must check the following eligibility requirements:

Nationality Requirements

A candidate must be either:

  1. Citizen of India, OR
  2. Subject of Nepal, OR
  3. Person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka and East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intention of permanently settling in India

Note: Categories (2) and (3) require certificate of eligibility from Government of India. Nepal Gorkha subjects don't need certificate.

Educational Qualification for Indian Army JAG Vacancy 2026

Essential Qualifications:

  1. LLB Degree:

    • Three years professional after graduation, OR
    • Five years after 10+2
    • Minimum Marks: 55% aggregate in LLB Degree
    • Must be from College/University recognized by Bar Council of India

  2. CLAT PG 2025 Score:

    • MANDATORY for all candidates
    • Must have appeared for CLAT PG Exam 2025
    • Applicable to all candidates including:
      • LLM qualified candidates
      • LLM appearing candidates
      • All LLB degree holders

  3. Bar Council Registration:

    • Must be eligible for registration as advocate with Bar Council of India/State

Important Notes:

  • Only candidates holding LLB degree AND mark sheet are eligible
  • CLAT PG 2025 result verification mandatory at Selection Centre before SSB
  • Candidates unable to verify CLAT PG 2025 result will not be eligible for SSB
  • Candidature will be cancelled without representation
  • No provision for offline applications

Document Proof Requirements:

  • LLB Degree or Provisional Degree (not more than 6 months old at joining)
  • All semester/year mark sheets
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree (for 3-year LLB course)
  • Bar Council of India registration OR College/University certificate of BCI recognition
  • CGPA to percentage conversion certificate
  • CLAT PG 2025 Score Card

Age Limit for Indian Army JAG Jobs 2026

Criteria Age Requirement
As on 01 July 2026 21 to 27 Years
Date of Birth Range Born NOT earlier than 02 Jul 1999 AND NOT later than 01 Jul 2005 (both dates inclusive)

Age Proof:

  • Only Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent accepted
  • Date of birth as recorded on application submission date will be final
  • NO subsequent request for change will be considered

Important: No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Marital Status

  • Men: Unmarried only
  • Women: Unmarried only
  • Marriage during training: Strictly prohibited
  • Marriage after application: Candidature will be cancelled even if SSB cleared
  • Marriage penalty: Discharge + refund of all government expenditure

Approximate CTC: ₹17-18 Lakh per annum (including all allowances)

  • Permanent Commission option after 10 years

Note: Pay and allowances subject to revision from time to time. Allowances enhanced by 25% automatically when DA increases by 50%.

Service Terms & Conditions - Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

Tenure of Engagement

Short Service Commission Structure:

  • Initial Period: 10 Years
  • Extended Period: Additional 4 Years
  • Total Maximum: 14 Years

Permanent Commission (PC) Option:

  • Available after completion of 10 years
  • Subject to eligibility and suitability
  • As per policies issued from time to time
  • Not selected for PC = Option to continue as SSC for 14 years total
  • Released from Army after 14 years if not granted PC

Release Options

1. After 5 Years of Service:

  • Application during 5th year of service
  • Army HQ considers on merits
  • Decision final and irrevocable
  • Released on completion of 5 years
  • Exception: Not applicable if undergone specialized course (cost must be recovered)

2. During Extended Tenure (10-14 Years): Release permitted for:

  • Taking up civil job
  • Pursuing higher education
  • Starting own business/joining family business

3. After 10 Years:

  • Can opt for release if not selected for PC
  • Can continue for full 14 years

4. After 14 Years:

  • Compulsory release if not granted PC

Probation & Terms

  • Probation Period: 6 months from commissioning date
  • Termination Rights: Government can terminate commission anytime for:
    • Misconduct or unsatisfactory service
    • Medical unfitness
    • Services no longer required
    • Failure to qualify in prescribed test/course
    • Compassionate grounds (3 months notice, no terminal gratuity)

Reserve Liability

After release, officers carry reserve liability to serve:

  • Duration: 5 years plus 2 years on voluntary basis
  • Age Limit: Up to 37 years (women) / 40 years (men), whichever is earlier

Bond Requirements

  • No advance bond mentioned
  • Specialized course training cost recovery if leaving early
  • Marriage during training = Discharge + refund of all expenses

Training Details - OTA Chennai

Pre-Commission Training

Training Academy: Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai

Training Duration: 49 Weeks (from October 2026)

Training Highlights:

  • Complete government expense
  • No marriage during training
  • No staying with parents/guardians
  • Military training and law-specific subjects
  • Physical fitness requirements mandatory
  • Post-Graduate Diploma awarded

Minimum Physical Standards Required Before Joining:

Activity Men (Officer Cadets) Women (Officer Cadets)

Sit-ups 30 25

Squats 2 sets of 30 repetitions 2 sets of 30 repetitions
Lunges 2 sets of 10 reps each leg 2 sets of 10 reps each leg
Swimming Pass 25 mtr with any stroke Pass 25 mtr with any stroke

Post-Training Qualification

Award: Post-Graduate Diploma in Defence Management and Strategic Studies Issued by: University of Madras Eligibility: All candidates who successfully complete training at OTA Chennai

Training Cost

  • Government Expense: Entire training cost
  • Withdrawal Penalty: If withdrawn for personal reasons (not medical/beyond control):
    • Cost recovery: ₹20,482/- per week (as of 2026)
    • Calculated for period of stay at OTA
    • Subject to periodic revision

Post-Training Allocation

  • Arms/Services Allocation: Made before passing out from OTA
  • Primary Allocation: JAG Branch (as per course)
  • Final allocation based on merit, vacancies, and requirements

Selection Process for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

The selection for Indian Army JAG vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Stage 1: Online Application

Application Period: 27 Jan 2026 (1500 Hrs) to 27 Feb 2026 (1500 Hrs)

Application Steps:

  1. Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  2. Click 'Officer Entry Appln/Login'
  3. Register (if not already registered)
  4. Login and click 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  5. Select 'Officers Selection - Eligibility'
  6. Click 'Apply' for Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course
  7. Fill all segments carefully
  8. Save & Continue after each segment
  9. Review summary
  10. Submit application
  11. Take 2 printouts with Roll Number

Important: Application closure time is 1500 Hrs on 27 Feb 2026. Submit well in advance.

Stage 2: Shortlisting for SSB

Shortlisting Timeline: Second week of March 2026

Shortlisting Criteria:

  • Based on CLAT PG 2025 scores
  • Vacancy to call-up ratio
  • Integrated HQ of MoD (Army) reserves right to shortlist without assigning reasons

CLAT PG 2025 Verification:

  • Mandatory at Selection Centre before SSB
  • Failure to verify = Candidature cancelled
  • No representation entertained

Stage 3: SSB Centre & Date Selection

Selection Period: Two weeks in May 2026

Process:

  • Login to website after shortlisting
  • Select SSB Centre and Date
  • First come, first serve basis
  • Once selected, cannot be changed
  • No request for change entertained

SSB Centres:

  • Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh)
  • Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)
  • Bengaluru (Karnataka)
  • Jalandhar (Punjab)

Stage 4: SSB Interview

SSB Period: May/June 2026

Duration: Up to 5 days

Call-up Letter: Sent on registered email ID and SMS by Selection Centre

SSB Process:

Day 1 - Stage I (Screening):

  • Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) Test
  • Picture Perception & Description Test (PP&DT)
  • Result: Same day
  • Qualified: Proceed to Stage II
  • Not Qualified: Return same day

Days 2-5 - Stage II (for Stage I qualified candidates):

  • Psychological Tests
  • Group Testing Officer (GTO) Tasks
  • Personal Interview
  • Conference
  • Result: Recommended or Not Recommended

Documents Required at SSB:

  • Application printout (signed, with self-attested photo)
  • Matriculation/SSC certificate & mark sheet (DOB proof)
  • 12th Class certificate & mark sheet
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree
  • LLB Degree/Provisional Degree
  • All semester/year mark sheets
  • Bar Council registration/College certificate
  • CGPA conversion certificate
  • CLAT PG 2025 Score Card (MANDATORY)
  • All originals for verification

Note: DIGILOCKER certificates NOT accepted. Only original certificates or authenticated color printouts with school/college certificate.

Stage 5: Medical Examination

Conducted for: Only SSB recommended candidates

Validity: 270 days (SSB to PCTA joining)

Medical Standards: As per www.joinindianarmy.nic.in

Re-examination:

  • Not required if already declared 'Med FIT' for any SSB of any service within 270 days
  • Valid till 01 Oct 2026 (joining date of this course)

Medical Board: Proceedings confidential, not divulged to anyone

Stage 6: Merit List Preparation

Criteria:

  1. Primary: SSB interview marks
  2. Tie-breaker 1: Older candidate ranked higher
  3. Tie-breaker 2: Higher percentage in qualifying exam (if age also same)

Note: Higher educational qualifications, previous performance have NO role

Stage 7: Joining Letter

Issued to:

  • Candidates in merit list
  • Within stipulated vacancies
  • Medically fit
  • Meeting all eligibility criteria

Reporting: Within 7 days of reporting date Late Reporting: Candidature cancelled, next candidate called

How to Apply for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026?

Follow these steps to complete Indian Army JAG online application 2026:

Step-by-Step Application Guide

Step 1: Registration (if not already registered)

  • Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Click 'Officer Entry Appln/Login'
  • Click 'Registration'
  • Fill registration form carefully
  • Submit and note credentials

Step 2: Login

  • Use registration credentials
  • Click 'Apply Online' under Dashboard

Step 3: Select Course

  • Page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' opens
  • Click 'Apply' against 'Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course'

Step 4: Fill Application Form

  • Read instructions carefully
  • Click 'Continue'
  • Fill following segments:
    • Personal Information
    • Communication Details
    • Education Details
    • Previous SSB Details (if any)

Step 5: Save & Continue

  • Click 'Save & Continue' after each segment
  • Don't skip any segment

Step 6: Review & Submit

  • Review 'Summary of your information'
  • Check all entries
  • Edit if required
  • Click 'Submit' only after ascertaining correctness
  • Must click 'Submit' each time for any editing

Step 7: Take Printouts

  • Wait 30 minutes after final closure on last day
  • Download 2 copies with Roll Number
  • One for SSB, one for reference

Important Application Notes

CRITICAL - Read Carefully:

  1. Name/DOB/Parents Name:

    • Must match Matriculation/SSC certificate EXACTLY
    • No variation accepted
    • Mismatch = Candidature cancelled

  2. CGPA Conversion:

    • Convert CGPA/Grades to percentage as per university formula
    • Use for filling 'Marks in Graduation'
    • Discrepancy at any stage = Cancellation

  3. No Changes After Submission:

    • Cannot edit after application closure
    • No representation entertained
    • Fill carefully

  4. Only One Application:

    • Multiple applications = Cancellation
    • No representation entertained

  5. CLAT PG 2025 Mandatory:

    • Must appear for CLAT PG 2025
    • Must verify at Selection Centre
    • Non-verification = Not eligible for SSB

  6. Armed Forces Candidates:

    • Must inform Commanding Officer in writing
    • Application countersigned by CO
    • Carry to SSB with all documents

Documents to Upload/Carry

For Online Application:

  • Recent passport size photograph
  • Signature
  • All educational certificates (scanned copies)

For SSB Interview (Originals + Self-attested Copies):

  1. Application printout (signed, with photo)
  2. Matriculation/SSC certificate & mark sheet
  3. 12th certificate & mark sheet
  4. Graduation degree/provisional degree
  5. LLB degree/provisional degree
  6. All semester/year mark sheets
  7. Bar Council registration OR BCI recognition certificate
  8. CGPA conversion certificate
  9. CLAT PG 2025 Score Card
  10. PAN card/Aadhaar/Passport (if parent name not on SSC certificate)

Provisional Degree Validity: Not more than 6 months old at Academy joining

Travelling Allowance & Entitlements

Entitlement for SSB Interview:

Category Entitlement
First Time Appearing (for this type of commission) AC 3-Tier to-and-fro railway fare OR bus fare (including reservation-cum-sleeper charges) within Indian Geographical Limits
Appearing Again (for same type of commission) NOT entitled to travelling allowance

For Queries: Contact concerned Selection Centre directly

Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF):

  • Coverage: ₹1.25 Crore
  • Monthly subscription: ₹12,500/- (during training)
  • Disability benefits as applicable
  • Ex-gratia for disabilities below 20%

Important Instructions - Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

Eligibility Restrictions

NOT Eligible to Apply:

  1. Candidates debarred from UPSC examination
  2. Withdrawn from NDA/IMA/OTA/Naval/Air Force Academy on disciplinary grounds
  3. Arrested or convicted by criminal court
  4. Involved in any criminal case
  5. Married after application date

Critical Points

1. Marriage Restriction:

  • Unmarried status mandatory
  • Cannot marry during training
  • Marriage after application = Cancellation (even if SSB cleared)
  • Marriage during training = Discharge + refund of expenses

2. Document Verification:

  • Thorough verification at SSB
  • False information = Cancellation at any stage
  • Concealment = Cancellation even after selection

3. SSB Interview:

  • Date/Centre once selected cannot be changed
  • No request for change entertained
  • No representation replied

4. Last Hour Rush:

  • Queries received up to 3 days before closing date only entertained
  • Submit application early
  • Don't wait for last day

5. No Hard Copy:

  • No need to send hard copy to DG Recruiting
  • Keep second printout for reference

6. Information Source:

  • All updates on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Check regularly for:
    • Selection Centre allotment
    • Interview dates
    • Merit list
    • Joining instructions
  • Queries only through 'Feedback/Queries' option on website

7. Constitutional Restrictions:

  • Article 33 of Constitution of India applies
  • Personal restrictions as per Army Act & Rules
  • Applicable from date of joining

8. Language Version:

  • English version prevails in case of discrepancy with Hindi

Disclaimer: Information based on official notification for JAG Entry Scheme 124th Course (Oct 2026). Candidates are advised to refer to the official website for complete and latest information. CLAT PG 2025 mandatory for all applicants.

No of Posts 12

Vacancy Details

Specialization No. of Posts
Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Analysis 01
Pharmacology 04
Drug Regulatory Affairs 01
Pharmaceutical Biotechnology 03
Ayurvedic Pharmacy 03

Eligibility Criteria

  • Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Analysis: First Class in B. Pharm as well as in Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Analysis with Ph. D degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Minimum one year of teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute.
  • Pharmacology: First Class in B. Pharm as well as in Master's degree in Pharmacology /Pharmacology & Toxicology with Ph. D degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Minimum one year of teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute.
  • Drug Regulatory Affairs: Basic degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharm) and Master's degree in Pharmaceutics / Regulatory Affairs along with Ph.D. degree in the appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Minimum one-year experience in Teaching/Industry/Research at the level of Lecturer or equivalent in Drug Regulatory Affairs. Candidates from Industry/ Profession with First Class Master's degree in Pharmaceutics / Regulatory Affairs and professional work which is significant and can be recognized as equivalent to Ph. D degree and with 5 years' experience would also be eligible. Desirable: Research Publications in the relevant field.
  • Pharmaceutical Biotechnology: Basic degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharm) and Master's degree in Pharm. Biotech/Pharmaceutics/IP/QA/RA/Pharm. Tech along with Ph.D. degree in the appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Minimum one-year experience in Teaching/Industry/Research at the level of Lecturer or equivalent in Pharm. Biotech. Candidates with 5 years significant experience from Industry/ Profession and Professional work with first class Master's Degree in pharm. Biotech will be considered in lieu of Ph.D. Desirable: Research Publications in the relevant field
  • Ayurvedic Pharmacy: First Class Bachelor's Degree in Science/ Ayurveda/ Pharma or equivalent. First Class Post Graduate Master's Degree in Ayurveda or allied subject with Ph. D in Ayurveda or allied subjects. Minimum One year of teaching experience from institute of National/ International repute. Subject Preference: Dravyaguna Vigyan, Bhaishajya Kalpana, Rasa Shastra
  • Pharmacognosy: First Class in B. Pharm as well as in Master's degree in Pharmacy (M.Pharm) in appropriate branch of specialization in pharmacy with Ph. D degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Minimum one year of teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute.
  • Executive M. Pharm: Basic degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharm) and Master's degree in Pharmaceutics / Regulatory Affairs along with Ph.D. degree in the appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Minimum three-year experience in Teaching/Industry/Research at the level of Lecturer or equivalent in Drug Regulatory Affairs. Candidates from Industry/ Profession with First Class Master's degree in Pharmaceutics / Regulatory Affairs and professional work which is significant and can be recognized as equivalent to Ph. D degree and with 5 years' experience would also be eligible. Desirable: Research Publications in the relevant field.
  • BBA- Health Care: First class Bachelor's Degree in any discipline preferably in Pharmacy. First Class Post Graduate Master's Degree like M.D./MDH or other equivalent such as Post Graduate Master's Degree in Business Administration/ Management/ PGDM/ CA/ Pharmaceutical Management or equivalent with Ph.D. in relevant field. Minimum one year teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute. Desirable Qualification: Ph.D in subjects related to Pharmaceutical Management. Subject Preference: Operation research/ research methodology.
  • MBA-International Trade Management: First Class Bachelor's Degree in any discipline preferably in Pharmacy. Master's Degree in Business Administration OR Management/PGDM/CA/Pharmaceutical Management with First Class. Minimum one year teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute. Desirable Qualification: Ph. D in subjects related to Pharmaceutical Management. Subject Preference: Insurance and Risk Management in Foreign Trade (Specialized in Finance/ Insurance sector)
  • Computer Applications: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Computer Applications from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Desirable Qualification: Ph.D. desirable, Minimum one year teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute.
  • Environmental Sciences: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph. D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Minimum one year of teaching experience from Institute of National/International repute.

  • Upper age limit for Guest faculty is 69 years subject to maximum engagement of 70 years of age.

Important Dates

Notification Date 28 January 2026
Walk-in Interview for Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Analysis 9 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Pharmacology 9 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Pharmaceutical Biotechnology 9 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Drug Regulatory Affairs 10 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Ayurvedic Pharmacy 11 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Pharma Chemistry 9 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Pharmacognosy 9 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Executive M. Pharm 10 February 2026

Walk-in Interview for BBA-Health Care 11 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for MBA-International Trade Management 12 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Computer Applications 12 February 2026
Walk-in Interview for Environmental Sciences 12 February 2026

Selection Process

General Information / Instructions

  1. Candidates of only Indian Nationality can apply for these posts.
  2. A) Upper age limit for Faculty on Short Term Appointment for UR category: 40 years (Age relaxation will be governed as per GNCTD norms for reserved categories) B) Guidelines relating to recruitment rules shall be followed as per DPSRU Act, 2008 and Statutes as amended from time to time. Reservation policy for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) and EWS shall be as per GNCTD Norms. C) Upper age limit for Guest faculty is 69 years subject to maximum engagement of 70 years of age.
  3. Age will be reckoned on the date of walk-in interview.
  4. Consolidated Salary for Faculty on Short Term Appointment is Rs.89,435/- (not eligible for any other allowance, pension, and gratuity etc).
  5. The Honorarium for Guest Faculty will be as per UGC guidelines (No. F. 25-1/2018(PS/MISC.) dated 28.01.2019 i.e. Rs.1500/- per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs.50,000/- per month. (not eligible for any other allowance, pension, gratuity and leave etc).
  6. Candidates should read carefully the requisite essential qualifications, age, experience criteria, etc., laid down in the advertisement before applying for the relevant post. The candidates must satisfy themselves of the suitability for the position to which they are applying. If at any stage during the recruitment and selection process, if it is found that candidates have furnished false or wrong information, their candidature will be rejected. Only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview.
  7. a) Interested candidates may attend the walk-in interview along with the digitally filled in application form downloaded from the website along with original proof of date of birth, educational qualification, experience certificates and should also bring set and photocopies of all certificates/documents and 2 passport size photographs. b) All columns must be filled in the application form, no column should be left blank. Instead, it should be marked as "N.A" wherever not applicable. Manually written applications (except forwarding note) will not be considered.
  8. Incomplete applications those without relevant supporting documents (self-attested copies of Date of birth/Degrees/Certificates/Mark sheets/Experience Certificates/documents, etc.) will be rejected.
  9. No TA/DA and accommodation shall be provided for attending the Presentation/Personal Interview.
  10. Mode of Selection: The selection process consists of Presentation/Personal Interview or both. Candidates are advised to visit the Website https://dpsru.edu.in/ regularly. A Candidate's admission to the Presentation/Personal Interview and subsequent process is strictly provisional. DPSRU would be free to reject any application, at any stage of the process, cancel the candidature of the candidate in case it is detected at any stage that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information/Certificate/documents or has suppressed any material fact (s). If any of these shortcomings is/are detected after appointment in the DPSRU, their services are liable to be summarily terminated. In case of any dispute the decision of competent authority will be final.
  11. The University reserves the right to: (a) Withdraw the advertisement either partly or wholly at any time without assigning any reason to this effect (b) Fill or not to fill up the post advertised for any reasons whatsoever (c) Increase/Decrease the number of posts without giving any reason. (d) Any addition/deletion and changes in matter of terms and conditions given in this notification of recruitment (e) Hold Presentation and/or Interview for selection, whenever circumstances so warrant.
  12. In case of any corrigendum/addendum pertaining to this advertisement, the same shall be published in the University's website only. Accordingly, all applicants in their own interests are advised to visit regularly the University's Website.
  13. Certificate in support of Experience should be in proper format i.e., it should be on the organization letter head bearing the date of issue, specific period of work (in DD/MM/YY) Name, Designation and Signature of the Administration Authorities alongwith.
  14. No person shall be recruited unless he/she in good mental and bodily health and free from any physical defect that is likely to interfere with the efficient performance of his/her official duties.
  15. After joining the service of the DPSRU, the persons will have to abide by the Rules, Regulations, Ordinances, Statutes and Act of the DPSRU applicable from time to time. He / She may be assigned any duty within or outside the DPSRU depending upon the exigency of the work.
  16. Candidates who have obtained degrees/diplomas/certificates for various courses from any Institution declared fake / de-recognized by the UGC/AICTE/PCI shall not be eligible for being considered for recruitment to the post advertised.
  17. In case any dispute arises on account of interpretation of clauses in any version of this Advertisement other than English, the English version available on the DPSRU Website shall prevail.
  18. Any dispute arising out of this Advertisement including the recruitment process shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Delhi only.
  19. CANVASSING IN ANY FORM MAY LEAD TO DISQUALIFICATION OF THE CANDIDATURE.
  20. Candidates shall have to produce original testimonials at the time of Presentation/Interview, failing which the Presentation/Interview will not be allowed. The original Certificates/Degrees, etc., of the candidate(s) are subject to verification before joining, in case of selection.
  21. Selected candidates have to join the post immediately (within 7 days on receipt of offer of appointment). No extension of joining time is permitted.
  22. Those who are appearing for more than one post are instructed to bring separate application for each post.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may attend the walk-in interview along with the digitally filled in application form downloaded from the website along with original proof of date of birth, educational qualification, experience certificates and should also bring set and photocopies of all certificates/documents and 2 passport size photographs.
