Eligibility Criteria for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026

1. Educational Qualification

General Manager – Credit Monitoring (Regular)

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) / Master of Business Administration (MBA) / Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) / Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM) from a recognized University/Institution.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions/Boards recognized by Government of India/approved by Government Regulatory Bodies.
  • Candidates must possess valid degree/qualification certificates as on 01.01.2026 and indicate percentage as per prescribed conversion rules.

General Manager – Treasury (on contract)

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) / Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) / MBA / PGDM / PGDBM in Management-related fields from recognized Universities/Institutions.
  • Domain knowledge of Banking, Forex, regulatory norms, IT, forecasting and analytical skills is desirable.

2. Experience

General Manager – Credit Monitoring

  • Minimum 20 years’ experience in Banks/All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs)/NBFCs/Housing Finance Companies (HFCs).
  • Out of the above, minimum 10 years’ experience must be in housing finance.
  • Candidates must have headed the credit function as Zonal/National Head during their career, or be holding a regular post of Scale VI/Grade E in a Bank/AIFI.
  • Experience certificates must clearly indicate housing finance experience.

General Manager – Treasury (on contract)

  • At least 20 years’ experience in Banking or Financial Services.
  • Out of this, minimum 10 years in Money Market / Government Securities / Forex / Integrated Treasury Operations.
  • Serving officers in Senior Management of Regulatory Bodies/Banks/AIFIs/NBFCs/HFCs are eligible to apply.

3. Nationality

  • Citizen of India, or
  • Subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or
  • Person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India, with eligibility certificate issued by Government of India where applicable.

Selection Process for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026

The selection will be based on shortlisting and Interview.

  • Preliminary screening of applications may be conducted by a Screening Committee.
  • If required, Group Discussion may be conducted for shortlisting candidates for Interview.
  • Candidates must secure minimum marks in Interview to be considered for the final merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared in descending order of Interview scores; in case of tie, higher age will rank higher.
  • Mere fulfilling of minimum qualifications and experience does not guarantee interview call; the Bank’s decision on shortlisting is final.

Application Fee for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026

  • SC/ST/PwBD: ₹175 (Intimation Charges only) plus applicable GST and bank/transaction charges.
  • Other Categories: ₹850 (Application Fee including Intimation Charges) plus applicable GST and bank/transaction charges.
  • Fee/intimation charges are non-refundable and cannot be reserved for any other recruitment.
  • Payment must be made online only as per the procedure in the advertisement.

How to Apply for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026?

Candidates can apply online only, and no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the official website: www.nhb.org.in.
  2. Go to “Opportunities” → “CURRENT VACANCIES” → “Recruitment of Officers in Various Posts – 2025-26/04”.
  3. Click on “Click here to Apply Online” and choose “Click here for New Registration”.
  4. Enter basic details to obtain a provisional registration number and password.
  5. Fill in personal, educational and experience details carefully and use “Save & Next” to verify entries.
  6. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specified formats and file sizes.
  7. Upload eligibility documents (qualification and experience) as required on the portal.
  8. Preview the application and click “Complete Registration” after verifying all details.
  9. Proceed to pay the application fee/intimation charges online via Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking or IMPS.
  10. On successful transaction, generate and print the e-Receipt and final online application form for future reference.

Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of Young Professionals proposed to be engaged on contract basis in the Ministry of Ayush is 06, subject to changes as decided by the Ministry. These positions form a panel of Young Professionals for various functional areas in the Ministry on a purely contractual basis.

Eligibility Criteria for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must meet the following qualification requirements:

  • Essential: Bachelor degree in a relevant subject or technical qualifications such as B.Tech, MBA or equivalent in relevant field/subject.
  • Desirable: Masters / M.Phil / Ph.D or MD with research experience, published papers and working experience in the relevant field.
  • The candidate should have good command over writing English or Hindi, good working knowledge of technology-based skills on the computer and ability to work on ICT applications.
  • Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.

2. Age Limit

The age conditions for Young Professional engagement are:

  • Maximum Age: Below 32 years of age as on 1st July 2026 (01/07/2026).
  • Age Relaxation: Criteria may be relaxed in exceptional cases based on justification in the interest of Government with the approval of Secretary (Ayush), as per guidelines.
  • Age calculation date: 01 July of the year of advertisement (01/07/2026).

3. Other Eligibility & Attributes

  • Young Professionals are expected to provide high quality professional inputs in areas like AYUSH Systems, Budget, Finance, AYUSH Education, Public Health & Infrastructure, Commerce & Trade, Marketing & Export Promotion of Medicinal Plants, Skill Development, IT, Media and related domains.
  • Candidates must demonstrate proven academic credentials, professional achievements and leadership qualities.

Selection Process for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

The selection of Young Professionals will follow the procedure and guidelines notified by the Ministry of Ayush:

  • Short-listing of applications based on eligibility criteria and requirements of various divisions as per Terms of Reference.
  • Short-listed candidates will undergo the recruitment process as per Ministry guidelines and requirements.
  • Final selection will be based on merit as decided by the Selection Committee.
  • Applications will be scrutinized by a Screening Committee; shortlisted applications will be sent to concerned divisions to recommend a panel (with waitlist, if required).
  • A Performance Appraisal Board (PAB) chaired by Joint Secretary (Admn.) will appraise work and performance for extension beyond the first year.

Note: Ministry of Ayush reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason and to cancel the advertisement at any stage.

Application Fee for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

  • The notification does not mention any application fee for Young Professional engagement.

How to Apply for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible applicants can apply for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Download or use the enclosed application format (Annexure-II) provided with the notification.
  2. Fill the application form strictly in the enclosed format, providing all personal details, educational qualifications and professional experience.
  3. Prepare a CV and attach self-attested copies of relevant documents supporting qualifications and experience.
  4. Place the completed application form, CV and relevant documents in an envelope.
  5. Superscribe the envelope clearly with: “Application for the assignment of Young Professional in Ministry of Ayush”.
  6. Send or submit the application to:
    Establishment-II Section, Ministry of Ayush, Ayush Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi – 110023.
  7. Ensure that the application reaches the above address by 08 February 2026 till 5:30 PM.

Instructions for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

  • Engagement is purely on contract basis and is of the nature of fee-based consultancy; it does not constitute employment or regular appointment.
  • Initial engagement period is one year, extendable subject to functional requirements and satisfactory performance, with one-day break between extensions.
  • Young Professionals will not be entitled to DA, transport facility, residential accommodation, CGHS, medical reimbursement or any other allowance apart from consolidated remuneration.
  • Place of work will be Ministry of Ayush offices at Ayush Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi – 110023 or Office Block 3, NBCC Building, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi – 110023.
  • Working hours will be normal office timings; Young Professionals may be required to work on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays and beyond office hours in case of urgency and must mark attendance in AEBAS.
  • They will be entitled to 12 days leave in a calendar year; un-availed leave cannot be carried forward or encashed, and no remuneration is payable beyond admissible leave.
  • Young Professionals must maintain absolute confidentiality and secrecy of information and sign a non-disclosure undertaking; all IPR and data will remain with the Ministry.
  • They shall not claim any benefit/compensation/absorption/regularization under any Act and must give a bond that engagement does not confer any right for regularization.
  • Engagement is subject to police verification; criteria may be relaxed in exceptional cases with approval of Secretary (Ayush).

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 100 (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Important Dates

Activity Start Date End Date
Notification Date 28/01/2026
Online One-Time Registration 31/01/2026 14/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment 02/02/2026 16/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Corrections in Registration/Application Forms (Edit/Correction Window) 18/02/2026 19/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Physical Verification of Documents Within 15 days from date of shortlisting
Joining Formalities Within 30 days from offer of provisional engagement
Process of Engagement Closes 30/06/2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

Odisha.contentHtml:
Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of RI, ARI and ICDS Supervisor and Other Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official OSSSC website. The last date to submit the application form is 15-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the OSSSC RI, ARI and ICDS Supervisor and Other Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

OSSSC Combined Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)
Post Name Revenue Inspector (RI), ICDS Supervisor, Village Agricultural Worker (VAW), Junior Assistant (JA), Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI), Amin & Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS)
No of Posts 3250
Salary Revenue Inspector, ICDS Supervisor: Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01
Village Agricultural Worker: Pay Scale ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01
Junior Assistant, Assistant Revenue Inspector: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01
Amin, Statistical Field Surveyor: Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01
Qualification Post-wise educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions as prescribed in the Detailed Advertisement for CRE-2025.
Age Limit 42 years as on 1st January, 2025 (post-wise as specified with admissible relaxations).
Start Date for Apply  07.01.2026
Last Date for Apply  15.02.2026 (online application submission)
Official Website www.osssc.gov.in
Trending Govt Jobs
  • Maharashtra Police Bharti Physical Test Hall Ticket 2026
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026

OSSSC Combined Posts Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Group Department Total Posts
Revenue Inspector (RI) Group B Revenue & Disaster Management Department 165
ICDS Supervisor Group B Women & Child Development Department 286
Village Agricultural Worker (VAW) Group C Agriculture & Farmers’ Empowerment Department 520
Junior Assistant (JA) Group C Finance, Revenue & Disaster Management, A & FE, W & CD Departments 1237
Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI) Group C Revenue & Disaster Management Department 422
Amin Group C Revenue & Disaster Management Department 378
Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS) Group C Planning & Convergence Department 242
Total 3250

Eligibility Criteria

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline or equivalent from a recognized University with knowledge in computer application. Age: over 20 years and below 42 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Bachelor’s Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce or its equivalent. Only women candidates; age not less than 21 years and not more than 42 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Passed +2 Science or +2 Vocational course in Agriculture related subject in Crop Production (CP) / Horticulture (HORT) / Repair and Maintenance of Power Driven Farm Machinery (PDFM) from a recognized Board/Council/Institution; Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic under OUAT is desirable and carries 5% extra marks in Written Test.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Passed +3 in Arts / Science / Commerce or equivalent with knowledge of Computer Skill.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, having knowledge in computer application.
  • Amin: Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, with knowledge in computer application (as per detailed table text).
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Passed 10+2 examination conducted by CHSE, Odisha or CBSE or CISCE or any other examination equivalent thereto.
  • Odia language: Must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed ME School Exam with Odia as language subject, or Matriculation with Odia as medium in non-language subjects, or passed Odia as a language subject in Class VII or above, or passed Odia language test in ME School Standard conducted by School & Mass Education Department.
  • Other criteria: Must be a citizen of India, of good character, and if married must not have more than one spouse living except as exempted under personal law.
  • Junior Assistant-specific: Must have registered name in an Employment Exchange of the concerned district (or State/Special Employment Exchange with Resident Certificate of concerned district) on or before the date of submission of online application.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Must possess Permanent Disability Certificate / UDID card with not less than 40% disability in the category and sub-category suitable for the post, as per Annexures I to VII.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Must possess Identity Card/Discharge Certificate/documents in support of defence service and furnish an undertaking about non-availment of earlier re-employment under Government of Odisha.

Salary/Stipend

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01 under W & CD Department.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Pay Scale ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01 under A & FE Department.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Finance, R & DM, A & FE, W & CD Departments.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • Amin: Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01 under Planning & Convergence Department.

Age Limit

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Not less than 21 years and not more than 42 years; Anganwadi Workers get additional 5 years relaxation for ICDS Supervisor only, besides general relaxation.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • Amin: As per post-wise age and educational qualification table, within 21–42 years.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • SC/ST/SEBC: Upper age relaxed by 5 years.
  • Women (for RI, ARI, VAW, JA, Amin & SFS): Upper age relaxed by 5 years; for ICDS Supervisor (women-only post) this additional 5 years is not applicable, except for Anganwadi Workers as stated.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Upper age relaxed by 10 years; PwDs of SC/ST/SEBC entitled to cumulative age relaxation over category relaxation as per Odisha Civil Service (Fixation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 1989.
  • Ex-Servicemen: For RI & ICDS Supervisor, upper age relaxed by 5 years; for other posts, relaxation by total period of defence service rendered, subject to conditions mentioned.
  • RI, ARI & Amin: Age relaxation up to five years for candidates having actual work experience in settlement/consolidation organisations.

Application Fee

  • As per Odisha Payment of Recruitment Examination Fees and Refund Rules, 2025.
  • Candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) shall pay Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- using Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI through Payment Gateway during online application.
  • SC, ST and PwDs candidates are exempted from payment of Examination Fee.
  • Examination fee of ₹ 500/- shall be refunded to applicants who actually appear in the examination, after verification of attendance records, to the same bank account / payment method used at registration.
  • No refund is admissible to applicants who fail to appear in the examination for any reason.
  • If Confirmation Page is not generated after fee payment, transaction will be cancelled and refund credited within 48 hours; applicant must make another payment for successful application in such cases.

Important Dates

Event Start Date End Date
Online Registration (Fresh candidates – New User who have not registered earlier) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Re-registration (Registered User who already have User ID for any previous post) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Submission of Online Application (after Registration / Re-registration) 07.01.2026 15.02.2026
Last date of receipt of online applications - 22.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Stage-I: Written Test – 100 marks, MCQ type in OMR/CBRE mode, of minimum standard of High School Certificate Examination.
  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (20, 20), English (20, 20), Odia (15, 15), Computer (15, 15), Logical Reasoning (10, 10); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks assigned to a question deducted for each wrong answer; multiple answers treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwDs, Ex-Servicemen and Sportspersons; 35% for others. VAW candidates with Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic (OUAT) get 5% extra marks (capped at total marks).
  • Stage-II: Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills – 50 marks, 1 hour; qualifying in nature with minimum 40% for all candidates.
  • Number of candidates shortlisted for Practical Skill Test: not less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category/special category wise, as per merit and availability; Commission may vary as per requirement.
  • Merit Lists: Provisional Master Merit List based on marks / normalized score in Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Practical Skill Test; Provisional Merit List of Practical Skill Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Provisional Select Lists post-wise / district-wise.
  • Document Verification & Counselling: Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification by District Level Board and then counselling for choice of post and Department/District/Range; allotment based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • Commission reserves right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Skill Test, reschedule tests, and cancel part or whole of recruitment at any stage.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online only through OSSSC website; applications other than online / incomplete shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions (except age) must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • No Admission Letter shall be issued to candidates whose application is incomplete or who do not fulfil prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Provisional Admission Letters / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Practical Skill Test shall be uploaded on www.osssc.gov.in only; no hard copy will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must regularly visit the Commission’s website to track notices, exam dates, and download Admission / Intimation Letters using User ID and Password.
  • Information uploaded on website will not be supplied separately under RTI Act, 2005 and will remain available for a specific period only; candidates should download and preserve it.
  • Candidature remains purely provisional and is liable to rejection at any stage for deficiency / misrepresentation / use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not permitted and will lead to cancellation of result and other penalties as per rules.
  • In CBRE mode, appearing in more than one shift/date by furnishing false information is treated as unfair means and penalised.
  • Commission’s decision on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalties, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allotment, preparation of merit list, allocation of post, and debarment is final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and click on “Apply Online”.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any recruitment of OSSSC must complete Registration by providing required details and uploading full specimen signature and passport-size photograph in prescribed formats and sizes.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post must login using existing User ID and select “Re-registration” option for this post.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not mean filing of online application; candidates must login again and fill and submit the detailed Online Application Form as per instructions on the screen.
  • Fill in all data and information as per certificates/records, upload required documents, and make Examination Fee payment (if applicable) through available online payment modes.
  • Ensure that the photograph and signature uploaded are clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise registration/application is liable to rejection.
  • Use own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment process for receiving Activation Key, alerts, and for downloading Admission Letters; do not share or change this contact during the process.
  • Submit online application well in advance without waiting for the last date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • Take printout of Confirmation Page after successful submission and fee payment (where applicable).

No of Posts Not Specified

Salary Rs. 80,000/- per month (with 3% annual increment) OR Pay minus Pension for retired Govt. doctors

OPTCL Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts Location
Medical Officer (Contractual) Not Specified Power Hospital, OPTCL Colony, Bhoinagar, Bhubaneswar

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Essential Educational Qualification: Must possess qualification of MBBS from the university recognized by Medical Council of India
  • The candidate must have a valid registration certificate under the Odisha Medical Registration Rule 1965
  • The candidate must be a citizen of India

Essential Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a university recognized by Medical Council of India is mandatory
  • Valid registration certificate under the Odisha Medical Registration Rule 1965 is compulsory
  • All educational qualifications from HSC/10th onwards must be supported by original certificates for verification
  • Medical registration certificate must be produced at the time of personal interview

Experience

  • Candidate should have worked at least 15 years in a Government Hospital/Corporate hospital of SPSU/CPSU or equivalent hospital
  • The hospital should have multiple specialization with minimum 20 beds facility
  • The hospital must have proper diagnostic center and pharmacy
  • Details of work experience shall be clearly mentioned and supported by relevant documentary evidence
  • Retired doctors must furnish Last Pay Certificate (LPC) from the last Hospital/Organisation from which they have been retired
  • Experience certificates must be produced in original at the time of personal interview for verification

Desirable

  • Experience in hospital administration and management would be preferred
  • Knowledge of standard treatment protocols and hospital guidelines is desirable
  • Experience in conducting medical boards, health camps and awareness activities would be an added advantage

Salary/Stipend

  • For Retired Government Doctors: Fixed consolidated remuneration equal to "Pay minus Pension"
  • For Others: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 80,000/- (Rupees Eighty Thousand only) per month
  • Annual Increment: 3% annual increment applicable for non-retired doctors
  • The selected candidate shall not be entitled for any other allowance or special pay over and above the consolidated remuneration
  • Mobile SIM Facility: Mobile SIM facility will be provided
  • Travelling Allowance: During the period of contractual engagement, candidate will be entitled to get Travelling Allowance for approved tours in line with the Corporation's prevailing norms
  • No other benefits, allowances or special pay will be provided apart from the consolidated remuneration mentioned above

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • Maximum Age: 67 years as on 01/01/2026
  • Age Relaxation: Age relaxation may be considered for deserving candidates at the discretion of the management
  • The candidate must be an Indian national
  • Age proof must be submitted through HSC/10th standard certificate or equivalent examination certificate
  • Self-attested copy of age proof certificate must be attached with the application

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Number MPP&R-07/2025-26
Notification Date 30/01/2026
Application Start Date 30/01/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 27/02/2026 (5:00 PM)
Age Calculation Date 01/01/2026
Mode of Interview Personal Interview (Date to be notified)

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made through personal interview by a Selection Committee
  • Candidates are required to produce original certificates towards proof of age, experience, qualification and marks from HSC/10th onwards for the purpose of verification prior to personal interview
  • Medical registration certificate must be produced in original at the time of interview
  • Retired doctors must furnish Last Pay Certificate (LPC) from the last Hospital/Organisation from which they have been retired
  • Filling-up of vacancies is solely at the discretion of the Management based on suitability of candidates
  • No claim will arise for appointment, if vacancies are not filled due to un-suitability/insufficient number of candidates
  • Final selection of the candidates shall be subject to medical fitness
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to having sound health and being physically and mentally fit in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination to be conducted as per the norms and standards of Medical Fitness

General Information/Instructions

  • Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Ltd. (OPTCL) is one of the largest State owned Power Utilities in the country, engaged in the business of Transmission of electricity in the State
  • The Corporation operates a well-equipped dispensary, known as 'Power Hospital' located at OPTCL Colony, Bhoinagar, Bhubaneswar
  • The Power Hospital provides health care services to the employees of OPTCL as well as employees of OHPC, GRIDCO and the community in and around the OPTCL colony including the underprivileged at a very affordable cost
  • The candidate should be free from any vigilance/criminal cases and must have a good character
  • Candidates working in State/Central Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies of Government shall produce a "No Objection Certificate (NOC)" at the time of Personal Interview
  • While applying for the above post, the applicant shall ensure that she/he fulfills the eligibility and other norms as mentioned, as on the specified dates and the particulars furnished are correct in all respects
  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment/selection that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that she/he has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will automatically stand cancelled
  • If any of the above shortcoming(s) are detected even after appointment, services are liable to be terminated without any notice
  • OPTCL Management reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process or change any term and condition if need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereof at any stage
  • Details of work experience shall be clearly mentioned and supported by relevant documentary evidence, failing which the application may be liable to be rejected
  • Applications without supporting documents/incomplete/not fulfilling the prescribed criteria in any respect shall be rejected outright
  • This is a full time contractual appointment, hence the appointee shall not accept any other paid appointment or otherwise
  • Candidates are required to visit the OPTCL website www.optcl.co.in for any relevant information from time to time
  • For any guidance on filling up the Application and information regarding Advertisement and Application, the candidate may contact the Mobile Number: 9124153088 on all working days between 11 AM to 5 PM

Job Description & Responsibilities

  • Medical Officer shall be in charge of hospital administration and will be responsible for day to day functioning of the "Power Hospital" along with the duty of consultation/treatment of patients
  • Ensure timely procurement of medicines and other clinical items through coordination with the HR Department of OPTCL
  • Monitor procurement of new equipment for Power Hospital and make recommendations as and when required to augment healthcare facilities
  • Assignment and coordination of duties of hospital staff, supervision of nursing and paramedical staff during clinical duties, maintenance of discipline and duty rosters
  • Ensuring adherence to standard treatment protocols and hospital guidelines
  • Convene the Medical Board as and when required for comprehensive medical examination, disability assessment and verification for other service related benefits or any other medical opinion sought for by the organization
  • Responsible to conduct health camps and awareness activities in consultation with HR Department
  • Issue medical certificates, fitness reports as and when required
  • Ensure proper up keeping and maintenance of existing facilities in "Power Hospital"
  • Any other assignment entrusted from time to time

Tenure, Terms & Conditions

  • Initial Contract Period: The tenure of contract is initially for a period of 1 year, which is extendable on yearly basis up to 3 years based on performance and requirement of the organisation
  • Leave Entitlement: 10 days leave in a calendar year. In case of engagement during mid of the calendar year, leave will be reduced proportionately
  • Termination by Corporation: The engagement can be terminated at any time by the Corporation giving one month notice, if performance found to be unsatisfactory
  • In cases of any misconduct including but not limited to misappropriation, negligence or causing loss to the Corporation, engagement can be terminated without any prior notice
  • Resignation by Medical Officer: Medical Officer shall give one month notice/payment in lieu of notice period if intending to resign from the services of corporation
  • This is a full time contractual appointment, hence the appointee shall not accept any other paid appointment or otherwise
  • Mobile SIM facility will be provided apart from salary
  • Travelling Allowance for approved tours will be provided in line with the Corporation's prevailing norms
  • Final selection shall be subject to medical fitness
  • Appointment will be subject to having sound health and being physically and mentally fit in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination

How to Apply

  • Candidates are requested to download the application form from OPTCL website - www.optcl.co.in
  • The application form is available as Annexure-I in the official notification
  • The application superscribed as "Application for the post of Medical Officer" should be sent along with Bio-data
  • Attach attested recent passport size photograph to the application form
  • Include attested copies of certificates in support of date of birth, qualification and experience
  • Send the complete application to: GM (HRD) MPPR, 6th floor, OPTCL Tech Tower, Janpath, Saheed Nagar, Bhubaneswar-751007
  • Applications must reach before 27/02/2026 (5:00 PM)
  • Applications without supporting documents/incomplete/not fulfilling the prescribed criteria in any respect shall be rejected outright
  • The application format requires the following information:
    • Advertisement Number
    • Post applied for
    • Name of the candidate (In Capital letters)
    • Father's/Husband's Name
    • Marital Status
    • Date of Birth (As recorded in HSC or equivalent exam)
    • Communication Address and Permanent Address
    • Mobile No./Landline No. and E-Mail id
    • Educational Qualification (MBBS onwards) with self-attested copy of Certificates
    • Details of experience with self-attested copy of experience certificates
    • Declaration regarding Civil/Criminal/Vigilance cases or disciplinary proceedings
    • Recent colour Passport Size Photograph to be affixed
    • Signature of the Candidate with Date and Place
  • Candidate must provide details of educational qualifications from MBBS onwards including Name of Board/University/Institute, Duration of course, Year of Passing, and Area of Specialization
  • Experience details must include Name of Organization, Post Held, Period (From-To), Basic Salary, and Details of supporting documents
  • A solemn declaration must be signed stating that all information provided is true and correct to the best of knowledge and belief
  • For any guidance on filling up the Application and information regarding Advertisement, contact Mobile Number: 9124153088 on all working days between 11 AM to 5 PM

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

In this article, you’ll find the OSSC Specialist Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

OSSC CPGL Recruitment 2026 Overview

Eligibility Criteria

  • Post-Graduation Degree in Education/Philosophy/Sociology/Psychology with minimum 50% marks and B.El.Ed or B.Ed. or D.El.Ed with 50% marks or M.Phil. or Ph.D. in Education for Teacher Educator in Foundation Course.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in Science (Physics/Chemistry/Botany/ Zoology/ Mathematics/ Geography / Geology) with Minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with Minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in Science.
  • M.A. in History with minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with Minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in History.
  • M.A. in Geography with Minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in Geography.
  • M.A. in Economics with minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in Economics.
  • M.A. in Political Science with Minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in Political Science.
  • M.A. or M.Sc. in Mathematics with minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in Mathematics.
  • M.A. in Odia with minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in Odia.
  • M.A. in English with minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in English.
  • Master Degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed) with minimum 50% marks for Physical Education Instructor.
  • Master Degree in Fine Arts(Visual Arts with minimum 50% marks) or Master Degree in Performing Arts(Music/Dance/Theatre) with minimum 50% marks for Art Education Instructor.

Salary/Stipend

  • 35,400-1,12,400 Level-9, Cell-1 (as per ORSP Rules, 2017)

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • However, the upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to SEBC, SC, ST and all Women candidates, 10 years for candidates belonging to PwD category and the total period of service rendered in defence service in case of Ex-servicemen. PwD candidates in the ST and SC category shall be entitled to cumulative age relaxation of ten years over and above the normal relaxation specified for the category. However, a candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of age relaxation as per rule which will be most beneficial to her/him.

Application Fee

  • The candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall deposit the examination fee amounting to Rupees Five hundred (₹ 500/-) only through online mode in Odisha Treasury portal linked with the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD: Exempted

Preliminary examination During March/April, 2026

Selection Process

  • Stage - I: Preliminary Examination- 150 marks
  • Stage - II: (a) Main Written Examination: Technical paper(s)- 200 Marks.
  • Stage - III: Certificate Verification

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must possess a valid e-Mail ID and Mobile number while applying for the post and keep the same active till the completion of this recruitment process to receive important messages from the Commission.
  • The appointment will be only against one of the posts carrying the corresponding pay as indicated in the above table and candidates need to give option for the posts/services.
  • The candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay the Examination fee of Rupees Five Hundred (₹ 500/-) only. The examination fee paid shall be refunded to the candidates who actually appear in the recruitment examination.
  • Appointments shall be on a regular basis, carrying the level of pay as mentioned in the table above.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill all the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post as laid down in the advertisement. Admission of a candidate to the written examination and other tests shall be provisional and based on the information furnished by her/him in the Online Application Form.
  • Online applications submitted to OSSC found to be incomplete in any respect are liable for rejection without entertaining any correspondence with the applicants on that matter.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or thereafter, it is found that any information furnished by the candidate in her/his Online Application Form is false/incorrect or the candidate has suppressed any relevant information or the candidate otherwise does not satisfy the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post, her/his candidature for the posts shall be cancelled. She/ He may further be debarred either temporarily or permanently from the recruitment examination(s) conducted by the Commission.
  • Commission will adopt a “Normalisation Formula” published in Commission’s website vide Notice No.2444/ OSSC dated 02.09.2021 for processing the result if any examination is conducted through CBRE (Computer Based Recruitment Examination)/OMR in multiple batches using different sets of question papers so as to offset the difficulty level that may arise in such use of multiple sets of question papers in the said examination, and such normalized score will be used to determine the last selection marks of different categories. The Commission at its discretion will conduct the examination either through OMR or through CBRE mode.
  • No Admission Letter for recruitment at any stage shall be sent by post. The candidates are therefore advised to be in touch with the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in regularly to know updates regarding the status of application, downloading of Admission Letter and the date of examination etc.
  • The candidates are advised to submit the Online Application Form well in advance without waiting for the closing date to avoid the last-hour rush.
  • As regards the candidates applying for more than one post/ service as per their eligibility, the Commission will make the final allotment to a post/ service on the basis of merit-cum-preference of post/ service given by the candidate. Once a post is allotted, no change of posts will be made by the Commission due to non-fulfilment of any post-specific requirements of Physical/medical/educational standards, etc. Candidates thus must ensure that they fulfil all the requirements of the posts before giving their preference/options for any post/ service.
  • The candidate has to fill/confirm in the OMR answer sheet or CBRE Screen, as the case may be, correct Roll Number and other data as required in the place(s) indicated therein and darken the appropriate circles properly in Blue or Black Ball Point Pen only in case of OMR-based examination. If the information so furnished is incomplete or different from the application form or if appropriate circle is not darkened properly, then zero marks will be awarded.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/ re-checking of scores in the Examination. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Sharing of marks with the candidates: Marks obtained by an applicant in Preliminary Examination and Main Examination are proposed to be shared with her/him after final merit list is published.
  • All the posts are State Cadre posts. The candidate, on selection, may be asked to serve anywhere in Odisha.
  • If a candidate scoring more than the last selection mark at any stage of the examination is not qualified for the subsequent stage/ final selection due to any reason, he must represent to the Commission within 05 days of the declaration of the said result through e-mail [email protected].
  • Applicants who are Government servants or working under PSUs of the State Govt. or Central Govt. should obtain a “No Objection Certificate” from their controlling authority and upload the same with the Online Application form. In case a standing order of NOC is issued by any Department of Govt the same should be uploaded. At the certificate verification stage they must produce the “No Objection certificate” or “Standing order of NOC issued by the concerned Department of Govt.”. Those who are not Government Servants/working in PSUs at the time of submission of application but became Government Servants subsequently should have to submit “No Objection Certificate” or “Standing order of NOC” at the stage of certificate verification. If any candidate hides her/ his Govt. servant/PSU Employees status, and found to be a Govt. servant or a PSU Employee during Certificate Verification may not be considered for recommendation.

How to Apply

  • The applicants should go through the detail advertisement before filling up the online application form.
  • The candidate may apply for the post as per her/his eligibility as per terms of the advertisement.
  • All eligible candidates have to register themselves by clicking on "APPLY ONLINE" button on the home page of the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in.
  • Those candidates who are applying for the first time have to register for the post by clicking on "NEW USER" button shown on the screen. On submitting the registration form a User Id and Password will be generated.
  • On clicking "New user" or "Registered User", instruction for filling up the Online Registration/ Re-registration and Application Forms shall appear on the computer screen. These instructions should be read carefully before proceeding with filling up the Application Form.
  • Step-by-step procedure for registration/ re-registration can be viewed by clicking on "Instruction to fill up Online Application Form".

In this article, you’ll find the IISER Berhampur Non Teaching Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

Eligibility Criteria

Post-wise Qualifications, Experience & Age Limits

  • Deputy Registrar (Group A, Level 12, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 50 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade.
    • Experience: 5 years administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in Level 10 or equivalent in Govt./Govt. research establishments/universities/statutory organizations/organizations of high repute.
  • Private Secretary (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: I. Master’s Degree with 50% marks with excellent command over English. II. Computer key depression speed equivalent to 60 wpm. III. One-year Diploma/Proficiency Certificate in Computer and office applications from recognised institution.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant experience in Govt. organisations in Pay Level 6. Desirable: English stenography/shorthand speed 100 wpm.
  • Junior Assistant (Multi Skill) (Group C, Level 3, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 30 years.
    • Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree with 50% marks in any discipline with excellent computer proficiency in office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
    • Experience: 3 years relevant experience in office practices / hospitality and catering services.
  • Senior Superintendent (Group B, Level 7, UR-01) – Deputation
    • Upper Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years (as per DoPT OM).
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade.
    • Experience: At least 5 years in Pay Level 6 or above as Junior Superintendent or equivalent, handling Admin/Finance & Accounts/Academic/Legal/Statutory/Audit/Stores & Purchase/Establishment in Central/State Govt., funded institutes, universities or comparable institutions.
  • Senior Technical Officer (IT) (Group A, Level 11, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 50 years.
    • Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in relevant field with first class or equivalent (6.5/10 CGPA) and consistently excellent academic record.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant ICT experience in a post carrying Pay Level 10 or equivalent.
  • Technical Officer (Lab) (Group A, Level 10, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 40 years.
    • Qualification: M.Sc./BS-MS Degree in Instrumentation/Physical Science with first class or equivalent (6.5/10) and consistently excellent academic record.
    • Experience: 5 years proven research/laboratory experience in operation of scientific/technical equipment and support to academic/research framework in premier institutes, with total 5 years post-master’s lab/research experience.
  • Junior Technical Assistant (Lab) (Group C, Level 5, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 33 years.
    • Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Geology with at least 55% marks.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant experience in laboratory/academic/research establishments of national/international repute, handling equipment related to Earth & Environmental Sciences labs.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil) (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering with first class and 3 years relevant experience in Level 6 as Junior Engineer or above in institutional building construction/maintenance/design & planning as per CPWD norms. OR Diploma in Civil Engineering with first class and 5 years relevant experience in Level 6 as Junior Engineer or above in similar CPWD-norm based works.
  • Junior Engineer (Electrical) (Group B, Level 6, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/HVAC Engineering with first class and at least 5 years field experience in electrical/HVAC construction/maintenance works, preferably as per CPWD/PWD/Govt. norms. OR Diploma in Electrical/HVAC Engineering with first class and at least 8 years similar field experience.
  • Medical Officer (Group A, Level 10 + NPA, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 40 years.
    • Qualification: MBBS or equivalent included in any Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, registered in State/Indian Medical Register.
    • Experience: At least 5 years post-qualification experience after internship in a recognised large/multi-speciality hospital of good repute. Desirable: MD in General Medicine or equivalent, registered in State/Indian Medical Register.
  • Nurse (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree with 50% marks in Nursing from recognised University/Institution OR First Class B.Sc. (Nursing) 4-year Degree from recognised University/Institute, registered as Nurse & Midwife with Indian/State Nursing Council.
    • Experience: 5 years clinical experience in minimum 50-bedded hospital recognised by Central/State Govt./MCI.
  • Junior Library Superintendent (Group B, Level 6, 01 post reserved for PwBD – OA/OL/HH)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree in Library Science/Library & Information Science with 55% marks OR First class Bachelor’s Degree in Library Science/Library & Information Science.
    • Desirable: Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application/Digital Library Management/Library Automation or sufficient experience in library digitisation and networking.
    • Experience: 5 years in Library & Information Science in digital library management/automation/networking in Central/State Govt., autonomous bodies, universities, or higher education institutes.
  • Physical Education Instructor (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: I. Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports/Sports Science with first class or 50% marks. II. Diploma in Coaching from NIS or equivalent. III. Must qualify prescribed physical fitness test as per UGC regulations.
    • Experience: I. 5 years in Central/State educational institutes/organisations of repute. II. Demonstrated meritorious performance in national/international events (at least twice in past 4 years). III. Representation at University/College/State/National level competitions. IV. Evidence of organising competitions and coaching camps of at least 2 weeks. V. Evidence of having produced good team/athlete performances at State/National/Inter-University level.
  • Junior Translator (Rajbhasha) (Group B, Level 6, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree from recognised University in:
      • Hindi with English as compulsory/elective or medium at degree level, OR
      • English with Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium at degree level, OR
      • Any subject with Hindi medium and English as compulsory/elective or medium, OR
      • Any subject with English medium and Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium, OR
      • Any subject with both Hindi and English as compulsory/elective or one as medium and other as compulsory/elective at degree level.
    • Experience: At least 5 years office environment experience with Hindi/English typing skills, excellent computer skills for correspondence/files, and knowledge of translation (Hindi–English and vice versa).

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: Rs. 500 per post (non-refundable) to be paid online.
  • Exempted Categories: Women, SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, PwD and Transgender candidates (on uploading relevant self-attested certificates/ID).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Separate applications and separate fees are required for each post applied.

How To Apply

  • Applications must be submitted online only through IISER Berhampur website: www.iiserbpr.ac.in (online link under recruitment section).
  • No hard copy of application is required to be sent at the time of online submission.
  • During online application, candidates must upload legible self-attested copies (where applicable) of:
    • Educational qualifications and marksheets.
    • Experience certificates.
    • Caste/Community certificate, PwD/Transgender certificate, Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, etc.
    • Valid ID proof issued by State/Central Government.
  • Scan and upload photograph and signature as per specified guidelines:
    • Photo: Recent colour passport size, 200x230 px, 10–100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg, light background.
    • Signature: On white paper with black/blue pen, 140x60 px, 10–100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg; signature in CAPITAL letters not accepted.
  • All communication, including recruitment schedule, shortlist/rejection lists and updates, will be made via email and institute website; candidates must provide an active email ID and check the website regularly.
  • Candidates currently in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous/PSU service must upload NOC-cum-Vigilance-cum-Experience Certificate in prescribed format at online submission stage.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 31/12/2025
Opening date for online application 31/01/2026 – 09:00 hrs
Closing date for online application 02/03/2026 – 17:30 hrs
Crucial date for age, qualification & experience 02/03/2026

Instructions

  • IISER Berhampur promotes gender equality and encourages women applicants.
  • Eligibility regarding age, qualification and experience is reckoned as on 02/03/2026; degrees must be from recognised universities/institutes.
