  • Ex-Servicemen: Upper age relaxable by total period of defence service rendered, subject to not having more than six months of service remaining on last date of online application and conditions related to prior re-employment.
  • A candidate coming under more than one category is eligible for only one relaxation, which is most beneficial, except PwDs under SC/ST/SEBC who are entitled to cumulative 10 years relaxation over normal category relaxation as per Odisha Civil Service (Fixation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 1989.

Application Fee

  • As per Odisha Payment of Recruitment Examination Fees and Refund Rules, 2025.
  • Candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) shall pay Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- using Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI through Payment Gateway during online application.
  • SC, ST and PwDs candidates are exempted from payment of Examination Fee.
  • Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- paid shall be refunded to applicants who actually appear for the examination after conduct of examination and verification of attendance records.
  • Refund shall be credited to the bank account or payment method used at the time of registration; applicants are advised to use their own account to avoid inconvenience.
  • No refund shall be admissible to applicants who fail to appear in the examination for any reason whatsoever.
  • If Confirmation Page is not generated after payment, the transaction will be cancelled and amount refunded within 48 hours; applicants then need to make another payment/transaction to complete the application.

Important Dates

Event Start Date End Date
Online Registration (Fresh candidates – New User) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Re-registration (Registered User) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Submission of Online Application (after Registration / Re-registration) 07.01.2026 15.02.2026
Last date of receipt of online applications - 22.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Stage-I: Written Test – 100 marks, MCQ type in OMR/CBRE mode, of minimum standard of High School Certificate Examination.
  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (25 questions, 25 marks), English (20 questions, 20 marks), Odia (15 questions, 15 marks), Computer (20 questions, 20 marks); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks for each question deducted for every wrong answer; more than one option marked is treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwD, Ex-Servicemen and Sportsperson categories; 35% for all other candidates.
  • Questions and answer options of all segments will be bilingual (except English and Odia language subjects); in case of any confusion in Odia version, English version shall prevail.
  • In CBRE mode, examination may be held on multiple dates/shifts using multiple question sets; normalization formula will be adopted to convert raw scores into normalized scores.
  • Candidates may select maximum three preferred districts for test centre; Commission may allot another district depending on infrastructure / capacity.
  • For Excise Constable, bonus marks are awarded to candidates possessing NCC certificates: NCC ‘B’ Certificate – 01 mark; NCC ‘C’ Certificate – 02 marks.
  • Stage-II: Physical Test – Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for all three posts; number of candidates shortlisted for Physical Test shall not be less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category-wise, subject to Commission’s discretion.
  • Physical Standard Measurement – Forester/Forest Guard: Minimum Height and Chest as prescribed by category and gender (e.g., Men UR/SEBC/SC: 168 cm height, chest 81 cm unexpanded with up to 5 cm expansion; Men ST: 158 cm height; Women UR/SEBC/SC/ST: 153 cm height). Color blindness is disqualification.
  • Physical Standard Measurement – Excise Constable: Category-wise minimum Height, Weight and Chest (e.g., Men UR/SEBC: 168 cm height, 55 kg weight, chest 79–84 cm; Men SC/ST: 163 cm, 50 kg, 76–81 cm; Women UR/SEBC: 158 cm, 47.5 kg; Women SC/ST: 153 cm, 45 kg). Minimum 5 cm difference between unexpanded and expanded chest.
  • Physical Efficiency Test – Forester/Forest Guard: Male (all categories): Walking Test 25 km in 4 hours; Female (all categories): Walking Test 16 km in 4 hours.
  • Physical Efficiency Test – Excise Constable: Male: Running 1.6 km in 7 minutes and Long Jump 3.66 m in 3 attempts; Female: Running 1.6 km in 9 minutes and Long Jump 2.75 m in 3 attempts.
  • Failure to qualify in any PSM/PET event leads to disqualification from recruitment for the concerned post.
  • Merit Lists & Further Stages: Provisional Master Merit List of Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Physical Test; Provisional Merit List of Physical Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Document Verification by District Level Board; Counselling for post and district/circle/division choice; Post-wise, District/Circle/Division-wise Provisional Select Lists based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • OSSSC reserves the right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Physical Test, reschedule tests, cancel part or whole of recruitment, and decide all matters of eligibility, selection and debarment.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited online through OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in; applications other than online mode or incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions except age must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • Provisional Admission / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Physical Test will be uploaded on the Commission’s website well before examination dates; dates of tests will also be advertised in local newspapers.
  • Candidates must download Admission / Intimation Letters from www.osssc.gov.in using their User ID & Password; no printed letters will be sent by post or any other mode.
  • Candidates should visit the Commission’s website at regular intervals for notices, exam schedules, results and other updates.
  • Information uploaded on the website will not be supplied under the RTI Act, 2005 and will remain there only for a specific period; candidates should download and keep necessary documents.
  • Candidature is purely provisional and liable to rejection at any stage for inadequacy, deficiency, misrepresentation, suppression, wrong information or use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not allowed; such cases will lead to cancellation of result and will be treated as unfair means.
  • Candidates who fail to appear/qualify at any stage of the recruitment process shall not be considered for final selection.
  • The Commission shall sponsor exactly the same number of candidates as total vacancies advertised, category-wise, for each post as per merit and availability.
  • The decision of the Commission on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalty, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allocation, preparation of merit lists, post allocation and debarment shall be final and binding; no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and refer to “How do I register/re-register/apply” on the Home page for step-by-step procedure.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any OSSSC recruitment must register by clicking “Apply Online” on the Home page and filling the Registration Form.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post with a User ID must login and select the “Re-registration” option under the Applicant Menu for this recruitment.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not constitute submission of Online Application; candidates must login again, furnish all required data and submit the Online Application Form as guided by the system.
  • Incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected; no Admission Letter will be issued to candidates with incomplete applications or who do not fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Pre-requisites: Payment of ₹ 500/- Examination Fee (for non-SC/ST/PwDs); scanned full specimen signature in jpg/jpeg/png (20–50 KB); scanned recent passport size colour photograph in jpg/jpeg/png (20–100 KB); certificates and mark sheets for entering educational details.
  • Photograph and signature must be clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise Registration / Application is liable to rejection.
  • Applicants must use their own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment for receiving Activation Key, alerts and Admission Letters; they should not share/change these details.
  • Submit Online Application well before the last date to avoid last-hour rush in the online application system.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

  • Out of Total marks of 100, 70 marks will be assigned for short-listing the eligible candidates:
    • Base Career: 50 Marks (10th / HSC onwards)
    • Higher Education: 10 Marks - 02 (two) marks shall be given for every additional relevant higher qualification subject to a maximum of 10 (ten) marks
    • Additional Experience: 10 Marks - 02 (two) marks shall be given for every year of additional experience beyond the minimum prescribed years of overall experience subject to a maximum of 10 (ten) marks
  • Out of total marks of 100, 30 marks will be assigned for Personal Interview
  • Shortlisted eligible candidates will be called for personal interview in the ratio of 1:10 for each vacancy
  • The departmental candidates of OMC shall apply through online mode only
  • All the departmental candidates belonging to same cadre and fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted & called for Personal Interview beyond the above ratio
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original mark sheets, certificates & testimonials/ documents towards proof of age, qualification and marks from HSC / 10th onwards, Experience certificate(s) along with photo copies thereof, for the purpose of verification prior to the personal interview
  • Failing to produce the required documents shall lead to disqualification of candidature

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online through the concerned website https://omcltd.in/en/people/career/employment-opportunities
  • The Candidates are advised to submit the online application form well in advance without waiting for the closing date to avoid the last hour rush
  • Percentage of marks in the essential qualification(s) shall be considered as per rules/ norms of the concerned Institute/ University
  • Wherever, CGPA/ OGPA or Grade in a degree is awarded, equivalent percentage of marks should be indicated in the application as per norms adopted by University/ Institute. The percentage conversion formula should be uploaded in case Grade/CGPA/ OGPA is awarded
  • Experience details along with industry type, period served, position(s) held, pay scales & job responsibilities must be filled in carefully against the relevant field while applying online
  • On successful submission of online application, candidate will receive an auto generated application number, which will be sent through their registered e-mail id
  • After submitting online application, candidate is required to download the application form generated by the system with unique application number for future reference
  • Candidates are required to visit Corporation website https://omcltd.in/en/people/career/employment-opportunities at regular intervals for any notification, news, updates, results etc. relating to this recruitment
  • At any stage of this recruitment process, if it is found that the candidate has furnished false or incorrect information, then the candidature /appointment of the candidate is liable to be cancelled
  • If the online application submitted, found to be incomplete in any respect, then the candidature is also liable for rejection without any notice
  • Canvassing in any form and at any stage will be viewed adversely & may lead to disqualification
  • Application once submitted cannot be altered / resubmitted, under any circumstances
  • The candidates are advised to submit only one Application for each post. In case a candidate submits multiple applications against a particular category of post, then the latest application submitted by the candidate shall be considered
  • Finally selected candidates shall have to produce the required documents at the time of joining at respective places of posting as per provisions of OMC R&P Rules, 2012
  • The decision of OMC Management will be final & binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the application / candidature, selection of candidate, cancellation of the recruitment process, etc.
  • Any dispute arising in this connection will be subject to jurisdiction of appropriate courts of Odisha
  • Filling up of vacancies is solely at the discretion of the Management based on the suitability of candidates & no claim will arise for appointment, if vacancies are not filled due to unsuitability/ insufficient number of candidate(s)
  • No T.A./ D.A. will be paid for appearing Personal Interview
  • Please do not send hard copy of the application form or any documents to the office of OMC. Application received through any other mode would not be accepted and summarily rejected
  • OMC reserves the right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the recruitment process, if required, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereof
  • After appointment, the executive shall be kept under probation for a period of 01 (one) year. This period will be counted towards normal increment, leave & seniority
  • On successful completion of probation, the executive shall be confirmed in the grade as indicated above. The probation period can be extended for a further period of six months, if necessary
  • The number of vacancies shown above are indicative in nature and may either increase or decrease at the discretion of Management
  • Candidate after recruitment can be posted in any establishment of OMC
  • OMC Service is not pensionable

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Registration: Candidates must register on the online application link: https://career.odishamining.in/login, which shall be made go-live from 02:00 P.M of 21.01.2026 till 11:59 P.M of 11.02.2026
  • Step 2 - Fill Personal Details: Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number. Fill up all the desired information i.e., personal details, contact details, qualification details, experience details etc. correctly
  • Step 3 - Login: Once registration is successful, the candidate will receive an auto generated user ID. Candidates can log in using either their email ID with corresponding OTP or mobile number with corresponding OTP
  • Step 4 - Complete Application Form: After logging in, the candidate shall click the Apply button for the post. Fill in Eligibility Details, Personal Details, Qualification Details and Experience Details
  • Step 5 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned photograph (JPG/JPEG format, up to 1 MB), signature (JPG/JPEG format, up to 1MB), and all relevant certificates (JPG, JPEG, or PDF format, up to 2MB each)
  • Required Documents:
    • 10th Certificate and Mark Sheet
    • 12th /Intermediate/Diploma Certificate and Mark Sheet
    • Graduate/Degree Certificate and Mark Sheet
    • Postgraduate Degree/Diploma Certificate and Mark Sheet (if applicable)
    • Experience Certificate(s)
    • Enrolment certificate issued by the Bar Council {applicable for DGM(Legal)}
    • IMS Lead Auditor certificate {Must for Sr. Manager (Business Excellence)}
    • Percentage Conversion Formula (if Grade/CGPA/OGPA is awarded)
  • Step 6 - Submit Application: Once the application form is filled up and documents uploaded, submit the application. Once submitted, application cannot be withdrawn/altered/resubmitted
  • Step 7 - Download Application Form: After successful submission, candidate will receive an auto generated application number through registered e-mail id. Download and keep a print out for future reference
  • For Technical Help: Contact [email protected] or call 0674-2377400/ 0674-2377401 from 21.01.2026 to 11.02.2026 (10 A.M to 5.30 P.M on working days only)

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

  • Officer-in-Charge Polyclinic: Graduate. Only retired service officers from Indian Army, Indian Navy and Indian Air Force drawing pension from Defence estimates through CDA with minimum 5 years work experience in Health care institution or managerial positions.
  • Gynaecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned / DNB with minimum 03 years experience in the specialty.
  • Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Recognized Post Graduate qualification in the concerned specialty with requisite post-PG experience as specified in the notification.
  • Radiologist: Recognized medical qualification as per Indian Medical Council Act 1956 with Post Graduate degree in Radiology as per Central Health Service Regulations 1996 and minimum 05 years experience in the specialty after Post Graduation.
  • Medical Officer: MBBS with minimum 03 years experience after internship; preferable additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery.
  • Dental Officer: BDS with minimum 03 years work experience after internship.
  • Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hygiene / Class 1 DH / DORA Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in dental lab.
  • Radiographer: Diploma / Class 1 Radiographer Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Physiotherapist: Diploma / Class 1 Physiotherapy Course (Armed Forces) with minimum five years experience.
  • Nursing Assistant: Class 1 Nursing Assistant Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Pharmacist: B Pharm from a recognized institute OR 10+2 with Science stream (Physics, Chemistry and Biology) and approved Diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India, registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act 1948, with minimum 03 years experience.
  • Laboratory Assistant: DMLT / Class-1 Lab Tech Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in Lab.
  • Laboratory Technician: B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology) OR 10+2 with Science and Diploma in Medical Lab Technology from recognized institution with minimum 03 years experience as Lab Assistant in medical Lab.
  • Driver: 8th Class / Class 1 MT Driver (Armed Forces) possessing a civil driving license (LMV) with minimum 05 years experience as driver.
  • Safaiwala: Literate with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Female Attendant: Literate with minimum 05 years experience in Civil / Army Health Institutions.
  • Chowkidar: Class VIII or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel.
  • Peon: Class VIII / GD Trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years service as mentioned in the notification.
  • Clerk/Data Entry Operator: Graduate / Class-I Clerical trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years service.

  • Officer-in-Charge Polyclinic: Rs 95,000/- per month.
  • Gynaecologist: Full Time (5 hrs) Rs 1,30,000/- per month.
  • Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Part Time 4 hrs Rs 4670/- per day.
  • Radiologist: 3 hrs Rs 3500/- per day; 2 hrs Rs 2330/- per day. Per day payment will change in case monthly payment will be revised.
  • Medical Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month.
  • Dental Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month.
  • Dental Hygienist: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Radiographer: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Physiotherapist: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Nursing Assistant: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Pharmacist: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Laboratory Technician: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Driver: Rs 25,600/- per month.
  • Safaiwala: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Female Attendant: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Chowkidar: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Peon: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Clerk/Data Entry Operator: Rs 29,200/- per month.
  • Tax will be deducted at source as applicable.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age for selection is 68 years for Specialist categories such as Gynaecologist, Medical Specialist, Radiologist and similar posts as specified in the vacancy tables.
  • Maximum age for Medical Officer is 66 years.
  • Maximum age for selection is 63 years for Officer-in-Charge Polyclinic and Dental Officer.
  • Maximum age for technical and support staff such as Dental Hygienist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, Laboratory Assistant, Laboratory Technician is 56 years.
  • Maximum age for Driver, Safaiwala, Female Attendant, Chowkidar, Peon, Clerk/Data Entry Operator and similar support staff categories is 53 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last date for receipt of application 10 Feb 2026
Written test and interview for shortlisted candidates To be informed telephonically / through e-mail after scrutiny of applications received on or before 10 Feb 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized at ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters Thiruvananthapuram based on eligibility, mandated qualifications and experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will only be called for written test and interview.
  • Written test will be conducted prior to interview except for Peon, Chowkidar, Female Attendant and Safaiwala.
  • Eligible candidates will be informed telephonically/through e-mail regarding written test and interview schedule.
  • Appointing authority reserves the right to reject/cancel applications based on incomplete applications/certificates/mandated qualifications/experience without assigning reasons.
  • Employment will be purely contractual for 11/12 months and at the discretion of the appointing authority. Contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month notice.
  • Hiring duration of the vacancy reserved for ESM/Civilian is 12 months. Civilian selected in lieu of Ex Servicemen vacancy will be for a period of 11 months only.

  • Selected Officers (Officer in Charge, Medical Officer, Medical Specialists, Radiologist, Gynaecologist and Dental Officer) will undergo 10 days On Job Training (OJT); this duration will remain unpaid and is mandatory before assuming contractual appointment.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications received by post after 10 Feb 2026 will not be considered.
  • Candidates may preferably apply for only one post/vacancy in two ECHS Polyclinic locations.
  • Candidates earlier selected in last one year but declined to join duty need not apply.
  • Employment terms and conditions are subject to change arising out of unforeseen circumstances at any stage of employment without compensation at the discretion of appointing authority.

  • Coordinate budget management and operational efficiency.
  • Allocate resources to meet productivity and quality objectives.

Team Leadership and Supervision

  • Lead a team of technicians and academicians.
  • Ensure smooth collaboration among team members.
  • Facilitate effective task delegation and team coordination.
  • Foster a positive workplace environment and culture.

Recruitment and Human Resource Coordination

  • Oversee the complete recruitment process for relevant roles.
  • Identify staffing needs and competency requirements.
  • Manage onboarding procedures for new hires.
  • Coordinate personnel development and capacity building.

Technical Coordination

  • Coordinate all technical aspects of pre-production, production, and post-production activities.

Operational Excellence

  • Minimum 3 years of teaching experience at higher education level or relevant professional experience.

Desirable Qualifications

  • MBA or other Master's level qualification in management/business.
  • Prior experience in Human Resource Management.
  • Prior experience in Project Management.
  • Knowledge of online courses and digital learning programmes.
  • Experience in educational technology or e-learning platforms.

Age Limit

  • Age relaxation may be given to exceptionally brilliant candidates at the discretion of MGUIF.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Ability to lead and manage diverse teams.
  • Proficiency in delegating responsibilities and coordinating work.
  • Experience in building high-performance teams.

Interpersonal and Conflict-Resolution Skills

  • Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
  • Conflict resolution and mediation skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments.

English Language Proficiency

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent communication skills with grammatical accuracy.
  • Ability to adapt language to different professional contexts.
  • Technical writing and documentation skills.

Technical and Operational Skills

  • Familiarity with online learning platforms and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
  • Project coordination and management abilities.
  • Data management and reporting proficiency.
  • Quality assurance and process improvement mindset.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Employment Contract: 3 years on contractual basis.
  • Renewal: Based on superior performance and organizational requirements.
  • Performance Appraisal: Annual performance review.

Important Dates

Date Type Date

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on the evaluation of qualifications carrying 40% weightage, based on gradings or percentage of marks obtained, and weightage for over and above each extra completed year of experience, subject to maximum of 30% weightage. Cochin Port Reserves the right to fix qualifying cut-off marks and limit the number of candidates for shortlisting, if deemed necessary. Candidates shortlisted or scoring above the prescribed cutoff marks at this stage will be required to make a presentation before a Board of Selectors on a topic given by them, which will carry 20% weightage. Thereafter, an interview carrying the 10% weightage will be held and selection will be based on the cumulated weightage score.
  • An evaluation committee will be constituted by the Port under the Chairmanship of an appropriately high ranked officer, for selection of the functionaries. The Committee will first shortlist the applications on the basis of the criteria decided by it. Thereafter, the Committee will hold a personal interaction/interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Duration: The tenure of contract is for a period of 3 years from the date of joining, which may be extended by another 2 years based on the performance of the candidate/ necessity of engagement.
  • He/ She will be allowed to avail weekly day off, closed holidays, national holidays & Casual Leave as applicable to regular officers with prior permission of reporting HoD. Failure to report for duty will entail deduction of wages on pro-rata basis.
  • Working days/ hours would be on par with regular employee/ officer. This includes overstay beyond normal working hours in case of exigencies.
  • He/ She should not leave the headquarters without prior permission.
  • The Port will reserve the right to terminate the contract at any time on the ground of misconduct or otherwise, without any notice.
  • He/ She has to give 3 months advance notice prior to leaving the contract engagement. If he/ she leaves without notice, or without acceptance of notice of termination, the amount due i.e. consolidated pay payable will be forfeited.
  • The engagement is purely on contract basis and will not confer any right to claim regular appointment, etc.
  • He/ She cannot claim any right/ title/ interest at par with the regular employees of the Port on similar or any other post doing similar work or otherwise.
  • He/ She will be entitled for medical treatment in the Port hospital to the extent the facilities are available in house, for self only. No medical claims for treatment in any other hospital/facility will be entertained.
  • He/ She may be provided with residential quarters of the Port as per availability, upon mutual agreement, and on payment of user charges as applicable to regular employees/officers.
  • The contractual appointment will be subject to verification of antecedents by the Police. If any adverse report is received from the Police, his/her services are liable to be terminated.
  • He/ She will not be permitted to take any other assignment during the period of contract with the Port.
  • On official tour outside the headquarters, he/she will be the entitled to draw TA/DA as applicable.
  • The contractual appointment will be subject to the candidate being found medically fit, as per requirement of the Port.
  • He/ she will maintain absolute integrity and devotion to duty and will be liable for penal action for misconduct or causing loss to Port property attributable to him/her during the period of contractual engagement.
  • He/ She will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, as amended from time to time and will not disclose any information/data available during their engagement to any unauthorized person(s).
  • It is advised that the Employees working in Central State Government/Semi-Govt. Autonomous Bodies/CPSEs shall get approval from their competent authority to apply. They shall be required to submit No Objection Certificate, if shortlisted.
  • The crucial date for determining the qualification and age shall be 16.02.2026 (closing date of on-line registration in the OAP). Vacancy advertised can be cancelled at the discretion of Cochin Port Authority without assigning any reasons thereof. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate(s).
  • The date and schedule of interview, if any, will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates through email ID only provided in the applications by the candidates. For any enquiries, candidates may contact the office of Secretary, Cochin Port Authority (Ph.No.0484-258-2113) or email ID provided herein during office hours (0930 hrs to 1700 hrs).
  • Candidates are advised to complete their online application process well in advance to avoid any difficulties caused due to internet traffic surges towards the closing date.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing candidates have to submit their applications through the online application portal (OAP) in the link mentioned below, and which is published in career page of website of Cochin Port Authority (www.cochinport.gov.in), which will be opened from 16.01.2026 Link :- https://career.itiltd.in/careers_cochin_port/login_form.php?id=MTg=
  • This online application process is the only valid method. No other application modes will be accepted.
  • Online registration on the portal will close on 16.02.2026 at 17:00 hrs. Candidates are advised to regularly check the website/ OAP for any updates regarding the selection process. Candidates are advised to keep the essential documents ready by the time of start of online registration. CoPA shall not be responsible for any omission on part of the candidates to keep themselves informed of the updates provided through the website/ portal/e-mail.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned above. In case, it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and /or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will stand rejected. If any of the above shortcoming(s) is/are detected even after contract engagement, his/her services are liable to be terminated without any notice.

  • Work Experience: Minimum 2 years of work experience (in research, industrial, field, or other relevant areas)

Project Assistant - Key Responsibilities

  • Project Management: Overall management of the project to ensure smooth execution and timely completion
  • Administrative Support: Provide comprehensive administration and organizational support to the project
  • Coordination: Coordinate with internal teams, other departments, and external stakeholders (government agencies, NGOs, community groups)
  • Project Goals: Ensure successful execution of project objectives and deliverables within the designated timeline
  • Documentation: Maintain project records, progress reports, and administrative documentation
  • Liaison: Act as liaison between the Principal Investigator, team members, and external parties
  • Planning: Assist in planning and organizing project activities and field visits
  • Finance & Accounts: Support in project financial management and accounting (basic)

Candidates can submit applications through any of the following modes:

  1. By Email: Submit complete application to [email protected]
  2. By Post: Submit to Principal Investigator's office, Department of Architecture and Planning, IIT Roorkee
  3. In Person: Produce application at the time of interview

Application Format & Required Documents

Application should include the following:

  • Cover Letter/Application: Written on plain paper addressing the Principal Investigator with expression of interest
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV): Detailed CV including:
    • Personal information (Name, Date of Birth, Contact details)
    • Chronological discipline of degrees and certificates obtained
    • Complete work experience (research, industrial, field, or other)
    • Technical skills and proficiencies
    • Any relevant projects or research work

  • Experience Details: Detailed description of work experience including:
    • Name of organization and project/role
    • Duration of employment (From - To dates)

    • Key achievements and learnings
  • Attested Copies: Attested/certified copies of:
    • Degree certificates (10th, 12th, Bachelor's, any Master's, etc.)
    • Experience certificates from previous employers
    • Any relevant certifications or training completion certificates

  • Complete Application: Incomplete applications may not be considered for shortlisting
  • No TA/DA: No Travel Allowance (TA) or Dearness Allowance (DA) is admissible for attending the interview

Selection Process

Selection Stages

  1. Stage 1: Application Review and Shortlisting
    • Submitted applications will be reviewed based on qualifications, experience, and fit for the project
    • Shortlisted candidates will be identified for interview rounds
  2. Stage 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview
    • Interview Venue: VR Lab, Amex-01, Department of Architecture and Planning
    • Date and time of interview will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates
    • Interview will assess technical knowledge, project understanding, communication skills, and overall fit
  3. Stage 3: Final Selection and Document Verification
    • Selected candidate will be notified
    • Original documents will be verified before joining
    • Appointment letter will be issued upon successful verification

Selection Criteria

  • Academic qualifications and relevance to the project
  • Relevant work experience in research, project management, or related fields
  • Technical skills, especially MS Office proficiency
  • Communication and interpersonal skills
  • Project management and coordination abilities
  • Understanding of rural development, energy, or environmental topics (preferably)
  • Preference to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience

Terms & Conditions

Employment Terms

  • Nature of Employment: Contract-based project position
  • Duration: 12 months (may be extended based on project requirements and performance)
  • Basis: Project-based employment, contract will be co-terminus with the project or 12 months, whichever is earlier
  • Location: IIT Roorkee, Department of Architecture and Planning, Roorkee, Uttarakhand
  • Reporting: Will report to Principal Investigator, Prof. Avlokita Agrawal

General Terms

  • Eligibility for Indian Nationals Only: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply
  • Preference to SC/ST: Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience
  • No Travel Allowance: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview
  • Joining Date: To be decided by the Principal Investigator based on selection and availability of candidate
  • Document Verification: All submitted documents are subject to verification with issuing authorities
  • Decision Final: The decision of the Principal Investigator regarding selection, rejection, or any other matter will be final and binding

Special Conditions

  • Project-Based: This is a temporary project-based position, not a regular IIT position
  • No Permanent Claim: Completion of contract will not create any claim for permanent or regular position
  • At-Will Employment: Either the candidate or IIT can terminate the contract with appropriate notice
  • Confidentiality: Candidate will be bound by confidentiality agreements for project-related information
  • Field Work: Position may involve field visits to rural areas of Uttarakhand; candidate should be willing to travel

  • Physical verification of equipments and documents will be done.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Local coverage of duration of 6 hours: Rs. 1500 per coverage (inclusive of transportation and delivery charges).

  • Interview.
  • Verification of equipment and documents (physical verification).
  • Final panel based on assessment scale, interview, and test coverage quality.
  • Selected Stringers to sign contract.

General Information/ Instructions

  • Stringers expected to service news coverages, short features on news, current affairs, sports, business etc.
  • Stringers to provide raw footage, dope sheet, press material and script for each coverage.
  • Panel revised every two years.
  • Stringers removed on grounds including: refusal to cover assigned coverages (two or more occasions), poor content/technical quality, delay in providing coverage, sub-contracting, cartel system, incorrect information, any act causing embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.
  • First default communicated in writing for improvement.
  • Show Cause Notice issued before removal; appeal to Director General, Doordarshan possible within 30 days.
  • Removed Stringers ineligible for empanelment at any other Kendra.

How to Apply

  • Applications in prescribed format (Annexure ‘A’) submitted in triplicate.

  • Enclose attested copies of certificates for qualifications, experience, equipment etc.

The persons selected through empanelment process shall have no claim, either implicit or explicit, for absorption or regularization in RNU DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati.

Assignments will be provided to empanelled candidates by RNU DDK Dehradun on an ‘as and when required’ basis. Candidates cannot demand assignments as a right and will have no claim to receiving assignments from RNU DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati.

Applications should be addressed to the Head, Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Post – Prasar Bharati Building, Near Rispana Bridge, Haridwar Bypass, Dehradun-248001, and sent by Speed Post only. The envelope must be clearly marked with the heading “Empanelment of (Name of the category) for RNU, DDK, Dehradun.”
  • Applications must be received by RNU, DDK Dehradun by 15th February 2026. Applications submitted in person, by hand, or by any other mode will not be accepted. RNU shall not be held responsible for any delays in postal delivery.
  • A separate detailed CV may also be submitted along with the prescribed application format (Annexure I-A), if candidates wish to provide additional information about their academic and professional skills and achievements. However, the prescribed application format (Annexure I-A) must be submitted without exception.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Secondary School Examination (SSE) pass certificate of 10th standard with passing marks in Mathematics and English conducted by any recognized Board of School Education by the Government of India, State Governments, or Union Territories in India.
  • The applicant should have studied the local language at least up to 10th Standard from a recognized board. Post-wise local language details are given in Annexure-III.
  • Special provisions apply for engagement in Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, and Sikkim regarding local language requirements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Knowledge of computers
  • Knowledge of cycling
  • Adequate means of livelihood

Desirable

  • Candidates applying for BPM posts must be able to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • Ability to work in rural areas
  • Ability to use smartphones, laptops, or computer devices

Salary/Stipend

GDS are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carry an annual increase of 3 percent, subject to fulfillment of conditions. They are also entitled to Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time.

  • Branch Postmaster (BPM): Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380 per month
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM): Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month
  • Dak Sevak: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month

Additional Benefits:

  • Dearness Allowance on TRCA
  • GDS Gratuity
  • Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to National Pension System)

Age Limit (as on 16/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe) 5 years
OBC (Other Backward Classes) 3 years
EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) No relaxation
PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) 10 years
PwBD + OBC 13 years
PwBD + SC/ST 15 years

Note: Age will be determined as on the last date of submission of applications (16/02/2026).

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 100 (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Important Dates

Activity Start Date End Date
Notification Date 28/01/2026
Online One-Time Registration 31/01/2026 14/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment 02/02/2026 16/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Corrections in Registration/Application Forms (Edit/Correction Window) 18/02/2026 19/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Physical Verification of Documents Within 15 days from date of shortlisting
Joining Formalities Within 30 days from offer of provisional engagement
Process of Engagement Closes 30/06/2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.
