Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Stage Marks

Final Merit Calculation

Important Notes

  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.

  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Rigger): NAC/NTC/STC in Rigger (or) Class X or equivalent Board Examinations with minimum of 02 years’ experience in loading and unloading.
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Heat Treatment Operator): NAC/NTC/STC in Forger and Heat Treater
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Fitter Auto Electric): NAC/NTC/STC in Auto Electrician
  • Junior Technician (Contract) (Sand & Shot Blaster): Class X or equivalent Board Examinations with minimum of 02 years’ experience in Shot Blasting in an industry.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Basic Pay – Minimum Basic Pay of Rs. 21,000/-
  • Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) as applicable
  • Special Allowance @ 5% of Basic Pay
  • Annual increment at the rate of 3% on the Basic Pay during the tenure only on successful completion of the previous tenure.

Age Limit

  • The Upper Age Limit prescribed for all the posts shall not exceed 35 years for Candidates without any relaxation as on the closing date of offline Application.
  • The Upper Age Limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Candidates in the posts reserved for them.
  • The Upper Age Limit is relaxed by 10 years for Person with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) (plus 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and plus 3 years for OBC (NCL) Candidates)
  • Ex-Apprentice Trainees: The Upper Age Limit is relaxed to the extent of the period for which the Apprentice had undergone training in line with Apprentice Act 1961. (plus 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and plus 3 years for OBC (NCL) Candidates)
  • Ex-Serviceman: The Upper Age Limit shall not exceed 35 years plus 3 years after deducting the period of service from the present age (plus 5 years for SC/ST Candidates and plus 3 years for OBC (NCL) Candidates). However, he should be less than or equal to 55 years of age as on the closing date of offline Application.
  • Work Experience: Relaxation in upper age limit will be given to the Candidates having relevant work experience. The upper age limit is relaxable for the Candidates with relevant post qualification experience, to a maximum extent of 7 years. Relaxation in age would be one year for every completed year of relevant post qualification experience.
  • The Maximum Age Limit after inclusive of all eligible relaxations for any category shall not exceed 55 years of age as on the closing date of offline Application.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee of Rs.300/- (Rupees Three Hundred only) to be paid through Online -> SBI Collect -> PSU -> ARMOURED VEHICLES NIGAM LTD TAMIL NADU -> Payment category -> Heavy Vehicles Factory-RECRUITMENT FEES.
  • (SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM/Female Candidates are exempted from payment of application fees).

Selection Process

  • Preference will be given in the following order: 1) Heavy Vehicles Factory Ex-Trade Apprentices, failing which 2) Erstwhile OFB Ex-Trade Apprentices, failing which 3) Other NTC/NAC holders.
  • The Candidates of Heavy Vehicles Factory Ex- Trade Apprentices will be shortlisted based on Month/Year of passing NAC (within which NAC Mark wise out of 400) in the respective trades.
  • The Candidates of erstwhile OFB Ex- Trade Apprentices will be shortlisted based on Month/Year of passing NAC (within which NAC Mark wise out of 400) in the respective trades.
  • For other NTC/NAC Holders: Marks obtained in the final examination of NTC/NAC. [In case of possessing both NTC and NAC, then the marks of NTC will only be considered for shortlisting.
  • For Non-NAC/NTC/STC holders, Candidates possessing only Class 10th with relevant experience will be shortlisted based on years of experience possessed. In case, candidates possess same number of years of experience, then selection will be based on mark of Class 10th.
  • Trade Test (Practical) shall be only qualifying in nature without any marks.
  • Candidates shortlisted shall be subject to Document Verification and those Candidates clearing Document Verification shall be subject to Trade Test.
  • Trade Test shall be conducted only at Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi and Chennai.
  • Selection will be based on the order of merit mentioned in Para 8.1 above. If 2 or more candidates has same merit, then Date of Birth will be criteria where older person shall get preference over the younger Trade Apprentices. If the Date of Birth is also same, then the criteria will be Name in alphabetical order of English.

General Information / Instructions

  • Detailed instructions are available in the website www.ddpdoo.gov.in Candidates should read these instructions carefully before making any entry or selecting options for filling up of offline applications.
  • The Candidates applying should ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions for the post/trade applied for.
  • Their admission for Trade Test will be purely provisional subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions at the time of Trade Test after due verification of their original certificates/documents.
  • Mere issue of Admit Card to the Candidate for Document Verification/Trade Test will not imply that his/her candidature has been finally accepted by Heavy Vehicles Factory/AVNL for Contractual Engagement.
  • Verification of eligibility conditions with reference to the original certificates/documents will be done only before Trade Test in Heavy Vehicles Factory/Chennai.
  • Candidates are advised to bring Self Verified Online Police Verification Report (PVR) and Medical Fitness Certificate (Blank Format is enclosed as Annexure-5) during the time of Document Verification.
  • The Competent Authority has right to revise either by increasing or decreasing the advertised number of vacancies at any point of time.
  • In case, Candidates are willing to apply two or more posts, they are advised to apply separate application for each post.
  • Persons with disability can apply against an unreserved vacancy, provided the post is identified suitable for the persons with disabilities of the relevant category.
  • Individual who have attended trade test at Heavy Vehicles FactoryTS/Heavy Vehicles Factory during July 2025 to December 2025 are not eligible to apply. Hence, need not apply.
  • NTC/NAC would mean Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) and STC would mean Certificate issued by State Council for Vocational Training.
  • All the Qualifications possessed by the Candidates and also Qualifications / Courses being pursued by them at the time of submitting the Application for engagement, are to be clearly indicated in the Application. In other words, all the qualifications already possessed and Qualifications / Courses which are being pursued / currently undergoing are to be indicated in the Application while submitting the same for notified posts in Heavy Vehicles Factory.
  • Candidates shall possess minimum pass marks in the required educational qualification.
  • Candidates seeking age relaxation shall enclose the relevant certificates issued by Competent Authority, which will be verified by Heavy Vehicles Factory. In the event of suppression of information or forged Certificate submitted, the candidature of the Candidate will be cancelled and will be debarred for all posts in Heavy Vehicles Factory.

How to Apply

  • Interested Indian Citizens shall forward physical applications only in prescribed format. (Refer Annexure –A attached herewith)
  • Candidate must forward the following copy of documents along with the manual application: i. SSLC/ Matric/Xth Certificate. ii. National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) with National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) Mark Sheets issued by NCVT of the relevant trade, If any. iii. National Trade Certificate (NTC) with National Trade Certificate (NTC) Mark Sheets issued by NCVT of the relevant trade (or) State Trade Certificate (STC) with State Trade Certificate (STC) Mark Sheets issued by SCVT of the relevant trade, If any. iv. Valid Community Certificate (SC/ST/OBC[NCL]) obtained in the prescribed format for Central Govt. jobs. (Format of Certificate is enclosed as Annexure -1 & Annexure - 2) v. EWS Certificate valid for the year 2025-26. (Format of Certificate is enclosed as Annexure - 3) vi. Discharge Book/Certificate for Ex-Servicemen. vii. Experience Certificate(s), if any. viii. Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Member Pass Book, if any. ix. Bank Pass Book x. Aadhar Card xi. PAN Card xii. Driving License, wherever applicable. xiii. Payment receipt for Rs.300/- wherever applicable.

Ex servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 172 DEO, Clerk and Other Posts. In this article, you’ll find the ECHS DEO, Clerk and Other Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

ECHS Thiruvananthapuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) Polyclinics under Station Headquarters Thiruvananthapuram (ECHS Thiruvananthapuram)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Officer-in-Charge Polyclinic: Graduate. Only retired service officers from Indian Army, Indian Navy and Indian Air Force drawing pension from Defence estimates through CDA with minimum 5 years work experience in Health care institution or managerial positions.
  • Gynaecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned / DNB with minimum 03 years experience in the specialty.
  • Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Recognized Post Graduate qualification in the concerned specialty with requisite post-PG experience as specified in the notification.
  • Radiologist: Recognized medical qualification as per Indian Medical Council Act 1956 with Post Graduate degree in Radiology as per Central Health Service Regulations 1996 and minimum 05 years experience in the specialty after Post Graduation.
  • Medical Officer: MBBS with minimum 03 years experience after internship; preferable additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery.
  • Dental Officer: BDS with minimum 03 years work experience after internship.
  • Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hygiene / Class 1 DH / DORA Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in dental lab.

  • Physiotherapist: Diploma / Class 1 Physiotherapy Course (Armed Forces) with minimum five years experience.
  • Nursing Assistant: Class 1 Nursing Assistant Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience.
  • Pharmacist: B Pharm from a recognized institute OR 10+2 with Science stream (Physics, Chemistry and Biology) and approved Diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India, registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act 1948, with minimum 03 years experience.
  • Laboratory Assistant: DMLT / Class-1 Lab Tech Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 05 years experience in Lab.
  • Laboratory Technician: B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology) OR 10+2 with Science and Diploma in Medical Lab Technology from recognized institution with minimum 03 years experience as Lab Assistant in medical Lab.

  • Medical Specialist (Gen Med): Part Time 4 hrs Rs 4670/- per day.
  • Radiologist: 3 hrs Rs 3500/- per day; 2 hrs Rs 2330/- per day. Per day payment will change in case monthly payment will be revised.
  • Medical Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month.
  • Dental Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month.

  • Physiotherapist: Rs 36,500/- per month.

  • Safaiwala: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Female Attendant: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Chowkidar: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Peon: Rs 21,800/- per month.
  • Clerk/Data Entry Operator: Rs 29,200/- per month.
  • Tax will be deducted at source as applicable.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age for selection is 68 years for Specialist categories such as Gynaecologist, Medical Specialist, Radiologist and similar posts as specified in the vacancy tables.
  • Maximum age for Medical Officer is 66 years.
  • Maximum age for selection is 63 years for Officer-in-Charge Polyclinic and Dental Officer.
  • Maximum age for technical and support staff such as Dental Hygienist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, Laboratory Assistant, Laboratory Technician is 56 years.
  • Maximum age for Driver, Safaiwala, Female Attendant, Chowkidar, Peon, Clerk/Data Entry Operator and similar support staff categories is 53 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized at ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters Thiruvananthapuram based on eligibility, mandated qualifications and experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will only be called for written test and interview.
  • Written test will be conducted prior to interview except for Peon, Chowkidar, Female Attendant and Safaiwala.
  • Eligible candidates will be informed telephonically/through e-mail regarding written test and interview schedule.
  • Appointing authority reserves the right to reject/cancel applications based on incomplete applications/certificates/mandated qualifications/experience without assigning reasons.
  • Employment will be purely contractual for 11/12 months and at the discretion of the appointing authority. Contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month notice.
  • Hiring duration of the vacancy reserved for ESM/Civilian is 12 months. Civilian selected in lieu of Ex Servicemen vacancy will be for a period of 11 months only.
  • All those candidates who have worked in Empanelled Hospitals will have a clear gap of one year between appointments.
  • Selected Officers (Officer in Charge, Medical Officer, Medical Specialists, Radiologist, Gynaecologist and Dental Officer) will undergo 10 days On Job Training (OJT); this duration will remain unpaid and is mandatory before assuming contractual appointment.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited for short listing suitable candidates for contractual hiring for 11/12 months duration on required basis for vacancies occurring in ECHS Polyclinics during 2026–27 as noted against each category.
  • All candidates are required to download the application form attached in editable PDF format, type the data and forward a printed copy duly affixed with passport size photographs by 10 Feb 2026 to Station Headquarters (ECHS), Pangode, Thirumala PO, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 006.
  • Attested copies of documents to be forwarded with application include Bio-data, educational certificates (10th/12th and final exam passed certificate), experience certificates for total experience period, mark sheets, attempts certificate, registration and renewed registration certificates, compulsory rotatory internship certificate, any other certificate required for the post, copy of full Discharge book and PPO for Armed Forces candidates, latest medical fitness certificate, Aadhar Card and PAN Card.
  • Applications received by post after 10 Feb 2026 will not be considered.
  • Candidates may preferably apply for only one post/vacancy in two ECHS Polyclinic locations.
  • Candidates earlier selected in last one year but declined to join duty need not apply.
  • Employment terms and conditions are subject to change arising out of unforeseen circumstances at any stage of employment without compensation at the discretion of appointing authority.
  • Changes to the notice, if any, will be posted on the specified web site only.
  • All Ex-Servicemen/dependents applying for the posts must register their names with AWPO and the Registration Number must be quoted in the application.
  • Written exam schedule, if conducted on a prior date, will be notified to eligible candidates through SMS/e-mail; candidates must bring pen/pencil, eraser, writing board etc.

How to Apply

  • Download the application form for employment in ECHS which is attached with the notification in editable PDF format.
  • Type all data in the application form, take a printout and affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided.
  • Fill details of post applied for, personal particulars, postal address with pincode, category, date of birth, Aadhaar number, PAN card number, AWPO Registration number, higher qualification and educational qualifications as per table in the form.
  • Provide complete details of work experience with period of employment, total experience and reason for leaving the job; attach experience certificates for consideration.
  • Ex-servicemen must provide details such as Arms/Service, unit last served, total period of service including SSC if any, previous service in Army/Central/State Govt, PPO and full discharge book details.
  • Attach attested photocopies of all required documents including educational certificates, mark sheets, attempts certificates, registration certificates, internship certificates, medical fitness certificate, Aadhar and PAN cards as specified.
  • Ensure all statements in the application form are correct and complete; sign the declaration with place, date and name of applicant.
  • Send the duly filled and signed application form along with attested copies of documents by post so as to reach Station Headquarters (ECHS), Pangode, Thirumala PO, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 006 on or before 10 Feb 2026.

General Information / Instructions

EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of Government of India and outcome of any litigation. Benefit of reservation under EWS category can be availed upon production of an ‘Income and Asset Certificate’ issued by a Competent Authority in the format prescribed by Government of India. Candidates may please note that they should be in possession of Income and Assets Certificate as mentioned above issued on or after 01.04.2025 and before the date of document verification at the time of interview. Candidates qualifying for interview under EWS category would be required to submit EWS certificate, at the time of interview. In case candidates fail to produce the same at the time of interview, they will not be allowed to appear for interview. Further, their request for interview under General category will also not be entertained.
  • NOTE: Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India (GoI) guidelines.
  • All the eligibility [age, educational qualification etc.] shall be computed as mentioned in subsequent paragraphs.
  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and should be proficient in the use of computers and information technology.

The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority.

OBC caste certificate containing the Non-Creamy layer clause should be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date for applying). Caste name mentioned in certificate should tally letter by letter with Central Government list/notification.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category but coming under creamy layer and/or if their caste does not find place in the Central List are not entitled to OBC reservation. They should indicate their category as General in the application form.
  • The selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India, depending on the requirement of the Bank. Therefore, only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • All the educational qualifications mentioned above should be from a University / Institution / Board recognized by Govt. of India / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. In case the date of passing is not properly mentioned in the mark- sheet or provisional certificate, proper document from Board / University indicating the date of declaration of results has to be submitted at the time of interview. In case the result of a particular examination is posted on the website of the University / Institute and web-based certificate is issued, then proper document / certificate in original issued and signed by the appropriate authority of the University / Institute indicating the date of passing that examination properly mentioned thereon will be reckoned for verification and further process
  • Only those who satisfy the required age and qualification criteria should apply. Applications that do not meet with the requirements will be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Interested candidates must fill in an Online Application Form. The application link will be live from January 26, 2026. Application in any other format will not be considered and will be rejected by the Bank, irrespective of fulfilling the eligibility criteria. Only Online Applications will be considered by the Bank. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Applicants are requested to ensure their eligibility before applying for any post. Fees once paid will not be refunded in case the applicant is not found to be eligible for the said post.
  • The date and timing of the Written test will be advised to the eligible candidates at a later date by notification on our website, personal email and/or SMS.

In all matters regarding eligibility, the selection process, the stages at which the scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, documents to be produced for the selection process, assessment, prescribing minimum qualifying standards in the selection process, number of vacancies, communication of results, etc., the Bank’s decision shall be final and binding on the candidates and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • Selected candidates, who are already in service must produce a proper relieving letter / discharge certificate in original from their present employer at the time of joining, failing which they shall not be allowed to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates (Deputy Managers), at the time of joining the Bank, will have to execute a personal bond for ₹ 3 lakh to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 5 years from the date of joining the Bank.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim / dispute arising out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and courts / tribunals / forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any clause / dispute.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest that they should not furnish any particulars that are false, tampered with or fabricated and should not suppress any material information while submitting application. At the time of examination, interview or in a subsequent selection procedure, if a candidate is (or has been) found guilty of: (i) Using unfair means (ii) Impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person, OR (iii) Misbehaving in the examination/interview hall or disclosing, publishing, reproducing, transmitting, storing or facilitating transmission and storage of contents of the test(s) or any information therein in whole or part thereof in any form or by any means, verbal or written, electronically or mechanically for any purpose, OR (iv) Resorting to any irregular or improper means in connection with his/ her candidature, OR (v) Obtaining support for his/ her candidature by unfair means, OR (vi) Carrying mobile phones or similar electronic devices of communication in the examination/ interview hall. Such a candidate may, in addition to rendering himself/ herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable; a) to be disqualified from the examination for which he/ she is a candidate: b) to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period from any examination conducted by the Bank. c) for termination of service, if he/ she has already joined the Bank.
  • CANDIDATES REPORTING LATE i.e., after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination. The reporting time mentioned on the call letter is prior to the Start time of the test. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities such as verification and collection of various requisite documents, giving of instructions, etc.
  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate’s currently valid photo identity (bearing exactly the same name as it appears on the call letter) such as PAN Card/ Passport/ Permanent Driving License/ Voter’s Card/ Bank Passbook with photograph/ Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead along with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a People’s Representative on official letterhead along with photograph / valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/ University/ Aadhar card/ E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/ Employee ID/ Bar Council Identity Card with photograph should be submitted to the invigilator for verification. The candidate’s identity will be verified with respect to his/her details on the call letter, in the Attendance List and requisite documents submitted. If identity of the candidate is in doubt the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the Examination.
  • Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Note: Candidates must produce in original the photo identity proof and submit photocopy of the photo identity proof along with Examination call letter as well as the Interview Call Letter while attending the examination/ interview respectively, without which they will not be allowed to take up the examination/ interview. Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter (provided during the process of registration) should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof. Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. If there is any mismatch between the name indicated in the Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification / their original marriage certificate / affidavit in original.
  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

Vacancy Details

Post No. of Vacancies Contract Duration
Research Associate, FedEx SMART Center 01 6 Months (Extendable)

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Master's degree (M.A., M.Sc., or M.B.A.) in any of the following disciplines from a recognized university:

  • Economics
  • Public Policy
  • International Trade
  • Public Administration
  • Management Studies
  • Logistics
  • Developmental Studies
  • Supply Chain Management
  • Ports and Shipping Logistics
  • Transport Planning
  • Transportation Engineering
  • Infrastructure Management
  • Operations
  • Or any closely related discipline

Professional Experience

  • Minimum Experience: 2 to 3 years of relevant professional experience
  • Experience Areas:
    • Policy research in logistics/Supply Chain
    • Consulting in logistics or supply chain management
    • Logistics operations
    • Air cargo operations
    • Infrastructure projects
    • Government advisory work
    • Think tanks or research institutions
    • Logistics organizations

Technical & Domain Proficiency (Required)

  • Economics & Research: Strong understanding of economics, socio-economic research, and applied policy analysis
  • Logistics Ecosystem: In-depth understanding of India's logistics, supply chain, or air cargo ecosystem across policy, regulatory, institutional, and operational dimensions
  • Policy Analysis: Ability to analyze national and international policy frameworks related to:
    • International trade and trade facilitation
    • Air cargo and transshipment
    • Customs procedures and border management
  • Field Research: Experience analyzing trade, logistics, autonomous deliveries, transport, and infrastructure systems through both policy-level assessment and field-based research
  • Cargo Workflow Analysis: Proven capability in mapping and analyzing cargo workflows across import, export, and transshipment processes at airports, ports, warehouses, and customs-controlled facilities
  • Bottleneck Identification: Ability to identify policy, regulatory, infrastructural, and operational bottlenecks impacting cargo efficiency, cost, and turnaround time
  • Benchmarking: Experience benchmarking Indian logistics or air cargo practices against global best practices and leading international hubs
  • Research Methods: Proficiency in applied research methods including:
    • Policy and literature reviews
    • Document analysis
    • Stakeholder interviews
    • Field studies
    • Process mapping
    • Quantitative and qualitative analysis
  • Writing Skills: Strong writing skills with experience contributing to:
    • Policy notes
    • White papers
    • Analytical reports
    • Research publications for government, industry, and multilateral stakeholders
  • Multimodal Analysis: Ability to extend logistics and cargo analysis across multimodal systems (air, ocean, road, rail networks)

Salary & Compensation

Research Associate

  • Salary Range: Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month
  • Determination: Exact salary will be commensurate with candidate's educational qualification, experience, and performance in selection process
  • Nature: Monthly remuneration for contract-based temporary position
  • Contract Basis: No additional benefits as it is a pure contract position

Job Description & Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

The Research Associate will work on policy research, analysis, and field studies related to India's logistics and supply chain ecosystems. Key responsibilities include:

  • Policy Research & Analysis:
    • Conduct applied policy research on India's logistics, supply chain, and air cargo sectors
    • Analyze policy frameworks related to international trade, trade facilitation, customs procedures, and border management
    • Evaluate effectiveness and impact of existing policies and regulations
    • Identify policy gaps and opportunities for reform
  • Cargo Operations Analysis:
    • Map and analyze cargo workflows across import, export, and transshipment processes
    • Study operations at airports, ports, warehouses, and customs-controlled facilities
    • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in cargo movement
    • Analyze cargo efficiency, cost structures, and turnaround times
  • Logistics & Supply Chain Research:
    • Conduct field studies and research on logistics operations and supply chain management
    • Analyze autonomous deliveries and transport systems
    • Assess multimodal logistics networks (air, ocean, road, rail)
    • Benchmark Indian practices against global best practices and international hubs
  • Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Conduct interviews with government agencies, industry stakeholders, and logistics operators
    • Gather insights from policy makers and infrastructure managers
    • Coordinate with multiple stakeholders for research inputs
  • Data Collection & Analysis:
    • Collect data through field visits, surveys, and document reviews
    • Perform quantitative and qualitative data analysis
    • Use research methods including process mapping and statistical analysis
    • Ensure data accuracy and methodological rigor
  • Research Outputs & Documentation:
    • Prepare policy notes and white papers
    • Write analytical reports based on research findings
    • Contribute to research publications for government, industry, and multilateral stakeholders
    • Document research methodology and findings clearly
    • Synthesize complex data into actionable recommendations
  • Project Support:
    • Support end-to-end research projects
    • Assist in proposal development and research design
    • Manage field-level data collection activities
    • Provide timely and transparent project status updates

Advertisement Date 03-02-2026
Last Date for Online Application Submission 16-02-2026
Selection Process To be determined (Shortlisting, Test/Interview)

Application Process

How to Apply

  1. Visit Application Portal: Go to https://icsrstaff.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php
  2. Search Advertisement: Find Advertisement Number ICSR/PR/Advt.13/2026 for Research Associate position
  3. Register: Register with your email ID and create login credentials
  4. Fill Application Form: Complete the online application form with all required information:
    • Personal details (Name, DOB, Contact information)
    • Educational qualifications
    • Professional experience and employment history
    • Relevant skills and competencies
    • Any additional information requested
  5. Submit Application: Click submit button to finalize application
  6. Print Confirmation: After successful submission, take printout of application form
  7. Keep Printout: You will need to submit the printout when called for test/interview
  8. Deadline: Submit before 16-02-2026 (application portal will close after this date)

Important Application Instructions

  • Online Only: Applications must be submitted only through the online portal; hard copies should NOT be sent to the Institute
  • Single Application: Only one application per email ID per advertisement; multiple applications for the same post will result in rejection
  • No Editing: Application cannot be edited or reverted after submission, so verify all information before submitting
  • Correct Email: Provide correct and active email address as all correspondence will be through email only
  • Printout Required: After successful online submission, obtain printout of application form to be submitted during test/interview
  • Deadline Strict: Applications received after 16-02-2026 will not be accepted
  • Eligibility Check: Candidates must ensure they meet all eligibility criteria before applying; admission to any stage is provisional subject to eligibility verification
  • No Duplicate Applications: Do not attempt to apply twice; if multiple applications received for same post, candidature will be rejected

Selection Process

Selection Procedure

  1. Stage 1: Application Screening
    • All applications will be reviewed for completeness and eligibility
    • Candidates will be shortlisted based on qualifications, experience, and suitability for research requirements
    • Institute reserves right to restrict candidates based on merit and relevance of experience
  2. Stage 2: Test/Interview
    • Shortlisted candidates will be called for written test/skill test/interview (mode to be decided by Institute)
    • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted; no communication to non-shortlisted candidates
    • Candidates must bring their application printout and testimonials (recommended)
  3. Stage 3: Final Selection
    • Final selection will be based on overall performance in screening and interview/test
    • Institute reserves right to not fill the position without assigning reason
    • Only selected candidate will be contacted with offer

Selection Criteria

  • Educational qualification and relevance to position
  • Relevant professional experience in policy research, logistics, supply chain, or related fields
  • Technical competency in research methods and data analysis
  • Domain knowledge of logistics, supply chain, and air cargo ecosystems
  • Writing and communication skills
  • Research project experience and ability to deliver quality outputs
  • Performance in test/interview
  • Ability to work in collaborative, multi-stakeholder environments

Important Selection Instructions

  • Institute's Discretion: Institute reserves right to decide the mode of screening (written test, interview, or combination)
  • Shortlisting Criteria: Candidates with experience higher than minimum prescribed will be given preference
  • Calling for test/interview conveys no assurance of selection
  • Information provided in application must be true; any false information will lead to rejection
  • Canvassing in any form will be disqualification
  • No correspondence regarding conduct or results of test/interview will be entertained

Terms & Conditions

Employment Terms

  • Nature: Purely contract-based temporary position
  • Duration: Initially for 6 months, later extendable based on performance and organizational requirement
  • No Permanency: Completion of contract period will NOT confer any right for further extension, regularization, or permanency at the Institute
  • Basis: All positions are on purely contract basis
  • Location: IIT Madras, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  • Reporting: Will report to Coordinator (Prof. Arshinder Kaur, Department of Management Studies)

General Conditions

  • Citizenship: Candidates must be citizens of India. Persons who migrated from Pakistan with intention of permanent settlement or subjects of Nepal are also eligible but need certificate of eligibility from Government of India
  • Minimum Qualifications: Minimum prescribed qualifications are required; higher qualifications do not entitle automatic interview call
  • Experience Relaxation: Institute may relax experience requirement for exceptionally outstanding candidates from SC/ST categories if needed
  • Antecedent Verification: Institute reserves right to verify antecedents and documents at any time, including after appointment
  • False Documents: If false/fake documents detected at any stage, appointment will be terminated and legal action may be taken
  • No Objection Certificate: If currently working at IIT Madras or another project, candidates must obtain NOC from proper channel; candidates without NOC will not be allowed to appear for interview
  • Gender Balance: IIT Madras encourages women candidates to apply
  • Crucial Date: Closing date of application (16-02-2026) is the crucial date for determining eligibility criteria for all candidates

  • Candidates will bring all original documents as applicable at the time of interview; no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
  • Employment of all individuals will be at the discretion of the appointing authority; changes in terms and conditions arising out of unforeseen circumstances may be made without compensation at the discretion of the appointing authority.

  • Employment period for Ex-Servicemen would be 12 months and for others it will be 11 months, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions.

Event Date

  • Only those candidates who secure the qualifying marks in the written test will be called for "Assessment of Talent" in the relevant field. Panel will be prepared in order of merit according to marks obtained out of 100.
  • Selected candidates will have to undergo medical examination and found fit for the medical classification prescribed for the post for which, he/she is being considered.

General Information/Instructions

  • The above posts are open to all candidates in possession of the notified qualification of education, age etc. The candidates who belong to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen categories are extended relaxation in upper age limit as admissible in general open market recruitments.

  • Candidates who qualify in the Written test will be called for Document Verification/Practical demonstration.

In case of any clarification, candidates may raise issues in the helpdesk given at https://pb.icf.gov.in/cultural_26/HELPDESK_ENTRY.PHP. No other mode of communication will be entertained. Any violation will be viewed seriously.
  • All SMS communications from ICF Administration will be from PB ICF.
  • Candidates may note that submission of fake / forged documents or providing false information will lead to cancellation of candidature / termination of service without any notice at any stage i.e. Written test / Practical demonstration / Empanelment / after Appointment. Further, such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification of the candidature.
  • Candidates must ensure that they must upload soft copies of the relevant Cultural, Educational Qualifications, photograph, LTI/RTI, Signature etc as required.   • Application without paying or paying less examination fee than prescribed by this Notification will be rejected.

  • Application will be accepted only through Online mode.
  • Candidates who wish to apply need to log on to the ICF web portal https://pb.icf.gov.in
  • Candidates should read the notification thoroughly and fill in the online application form carefully and correctly. No corrections in the application will be permitted once the application is submitted. Candidates can submit only one application, submission of multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Before filling the application form, candidates should keep ready all the relevant documents/certificates and image of recent passport size photograph (not more than 200 KB) in JPG format and to upload the photograph with clear front view of the candidate without cap and sunglasses.

The certificates and/or mark sheets of educational qualifications, including SSC, Intermediate, Diploma, UG Degree, PG Degree, and PhD, along with the consolidated mark sheet of the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the post applied. b. Birth Certificate (issued by competent Authorities under law) or High School certificate clearly indicating date of Birth. c. NOC from current employer, if applicable. In case of anticipated delay in getting NOC, candidates may submita scanned copy of the undertaking stating: “I, (Name of the candidate, Age, residence) am working in (Name of the organization) as (post name) from (date of Joining the current organization). I, hereby state that I will produce the NOC from the current employer at the time of test/interview/verification as and when required. In case fail to produce NOC, I will not claim any right to appear in the test/interview and any other process”. The undertaking is to be signed by the candidate with the date. e. Certificates of experience in chronological order and should be in proper format i.e. it should be on the organization’s letterhead bearing the date of issue, name, designation, specific period of work, nature of duties, and signature of the Administrative Authority/Owner of the organization along with his/her seal, which makes the candidate eligible for applying for the said post. f. Salary certificates for all the experiences of the candidate should be submitted. In the salary certificate, the breakup of gross salary should be indicated clearly viz Pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. Salary certificates obtained from private companies/parties with consolidated amount will not be considered. These Certificates should contain a breakup of the salary so as to enable us to compare with the scales of pay of the Government indicated against each post wherever required. g. Certificate of proficiency should be submitted, wherever required, with respect to desirable qualifications.

General Information / Instructions

In case the Universities/Board, award grades/CGPA/OGPA, the same will have to be indicated in equivalent percentage of marks as per the norms adopted by that University/Board and a certificate to this effect issued by the University/Board should be submitted in the online application. In the absence of the same, the candidature will not be considered. Appointment to the post is subject to being found medically fit by the Competent Authority.
  • In addition to the Pay and allowances as applicable to the employees posted in the Institute, the incumbent would be entitled to the following facilities: a) Reimbursement of Children Education Allowance as per Central Government Rules b) Reimbursement of Medical expenses including referral to outside specialized and reputed hospitals for OP/IP for them and their dependent family members. c) Suitable institute residential accommodation in the campus, subject to availability. d) Leave Travel Concession as per Central Government Rules e) National Pension Scheme for all direct recruits, except those incumbents who are governed under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972, as on the date of appointment in the Institute.
  • The competent authority/screening committees of NITW reserve all the rights to set higher standards & parameters, to shortlist the candidates, which may include highest qualification prescribed in the Recruitment Rules, desirable/preferable qualifications and/or experience, and other requirements mentioned in the notification/recruitment rules. The decision of the competent authority in all matters relating to the eligibility of the candidate, scaheme/mode of selection process,i.e., screening/skill/written test would be final and binding on all the candidates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 09.01.2026 to 08.02.2026 and no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates to go to the NITW website and under Advt. No. 01/2026, click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register application, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her Father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the SSC Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and Save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature.
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
