Eligibility Criteria – Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Recruitment 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Candidate must have passed any examination between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent.
  • Candidates having qualification higher than 10th class are not eligible.
  • Applicants must mention any work experience such as cooking, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, etc., as relevant to duties at residences of Judicial Officers.
  • Educational qualification must be possessed as on the date of notification (02.02.2026).

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2026)

  • Minimum age: 18 years.
  • Maximum age: 46 years.

Age Relaxation (as per Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules)

  • SC / ST / BC / EWS: 5 years.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PWD): 10 years.
  • For candidates working on contract or outsourcing basis in specified judicial/legal services – relaxation as per rules, provided they were within age limit at initial appointment and have at least 2 years of service by date of notification.

Reservation

  • Reservation applicable for SC, ST, BC, EWS, Persons with Disability (40% and above), and Women, as per Government of Telangana orders.
  • Community must be recognized as BC/SC/ST in the State of Telangana as per G.O.Ms references; otherwise, candidate is treated as Open Category.
  • 33 1/3% horizontal reservation for Women will be implemented.
  • Reservation for EWS will be as per relevant G.O.Ms issued by Government of Telangana.

Selection Process – Telangana High Court Office Subordinate 2026

OMR Based Examination & Viva-Voce

  • OMR-based written examination (objective type, multiple choice) – 45 marks.
  • Oral interview (Viva-voce) – 5 marks.
  • Question paper: General Knowledge, 45 questions, 1 mark each, duration 60 minutes.
  • Question paper will be in two languages – English and Telugu.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • OC & EWS: 45% in OMR examination.
  • BC: 40% in OMR examination.
  • SC / ST / PH: 35% in OMR examination.

Shortlisting & Weightage

  • Candidates qualified in OMR exam will be shortlisted in 1:3 ratio of notified/available vacancies for certificate verification and viva-voce.
  • Weightage marks will be given to candidates working on contract/outsourcing basis in notified judicial/legal services based on length of service, subject to minimum 2 years of service and securing minimum qualifying marks.

Merit List

  • Merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in OMR examination and viva-voce.
  • In case of tie in total marks, elder candidate in age will be preferred.
  • If tie persists, candidate with higher marks in prescribed educational qualification will be considered.

Application / Examination Fee

  • OC & BC candidates: Rs. 600/- (excluding service charges).
  • SC / ST / EWS / PWD candidates: Rs. 400/- (excluding service charges).
  • Concessional fee of Rs. 400/- for SC/ST is applicable only to communities recognized as SC/ST in Telangana.
  • Fee must be paid online only; once paid, it is non-refundable under any circumstances.

How to Apply Online for Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website of the High Court for the State of Telangana: https://tshc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the recruitment/notifications section and open the link for “Notification No. 101/2026 – Office Subordinate Recruitment”.
  3. Complete Part-A: One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) by entering your basic details to generate OTPR ID and password.
  4. Login using the OTPR ID and password and proceed to Part-B: Application Form for Office Subordinate posts.
  5. Fill in all required details carefully – personal details, educational qualification (7th to 10th class), community, disability (if any), and work experience (cooking, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, etc.).
  6. Upload scanned copies of required certificates/documents in PDF format (as per instructions in the user guide) and recent passport-size photograph and signature, if required.
  7. Pay the applicable online application/examination fee as per your category through the available online payment modes.
  8. Submit the online application and take a printout / save the application and payment receipt for future reference.

Important: Candidates must keep all scanned certificates ready in PDF format before starting the online application. Particulars furnished in the online form will be treated as final, and any wrong information regarding category/caste may forfeit the claim for reservation.

  • In case of Retired employees who are not drawing pension (as per CCS Pension Rules), the fixed monthly remuneration shall be arrived at by taking 50% of their Basic Pay drawn at the time of retirement plus Transport Allowance (TA) including DA on TA as was applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying

Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit

  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.

University of Kalyani Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Professor – Essential Eligibility

  • Option (a): Eminent scholar with Ph.D. in concerned/allied/relevant discipline, at least 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a research score of 120 as per prescribed criteria, plus minimum 10 years of teaching experience in University/College as Assistant/Associate/Professor or equivalent research experience with successful Ph.D. guidance.
  • Option (b): Outstanding professional with Ph.D. in relevant/allied/applied discipline from academic institutions/industry, with significant contribution to knowledge and at least 10 years of experience.

Associate Professor – Essential Eligibility

  • Good academic record with Ph.D. in concerned/relevant/allied disciplines.
  • Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in relevant subject.
  • Minimum 8 years of teaching and/or research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor level.
  • At least 7 publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a research score of 75 as per criteria.

Assistant Professor – Essential Eligibility

  • Option (a): Master’s Degree with 55% marks in concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University, and must have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or equivalent accredited test such as SLET/SET.
  • Option (b): Ph.D. degree from a foreign University/Institution with ranking among top 500 in World University Rankings (QS/THE/ARWU) in any year.

Department-wise Special Requirements

Biochemistry and Biophysics

  • Professor: M.Sc. in Biochemistry with teaching/research experience in Cellular and Molecular Biology, Immunology.
  • Associate Professor – Medical Biochemistry: M.Sc. in Biochemistry/Physiology/Molecular Biology/Biotechnology.
  • Associate Professor – Electrophysiology: M.Sc. in Biochemistry/Physiology/Biophysics.
  • Associate Professor – Proteomics & Biophysics: M.Sc. in Biochemistry/Biophysics/Zoology.

Environmental Science

  • Professor & Associate Professor: M.Sc. in Environmental Science/Botany/Zoology/Earth Science/Geology/Geography with specialization in ecology, environmental biology, toxicology, microbiology or related fields.
  • Assistant Professor: Open specialization with significant environmental field experience.

Library and Information Science

  • All posts require specialization in Resource Description and Content Designation.

Philosophy

  • All posts are with open specialization as per departmental requirements.

Marks Relaxation

  • 5% relaxation of marks at Graduate and Master’s level for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/Differently-abled candidates.
  • 5% relaxation from 55% to 50% at Master’s level for Ph.D. holders who obtained their degree before 19 September 1991.
  • No relaxation in qualifying marks for Differently-abled candidates in the discipline of Physical Education.

Age Limit (Assistant Professor)

  • Upper age limit: 40 years as on 01 January 2026.
  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation (maximum 45 years).
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates: 3 years relaxation (maximum 43 years).
  • Differently-abled candidates (except Physical Education): 10 years relaxation (maximum 50 years).

NET / SLET / SET Exemption

  • Candidates with Ph.D. in relevant subject as per UGC Regulations 2009 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET for Assistant Professor posts.
  • Candidates registered for Ph.D. before 11 July 2009 may be exempted if they satisfy conditions such as regular Ph.D. registration, external evaluation, open viva-voce, published work and conference presentations as per UGC norms.

No exemption is available for SC/ST candidates of other states. The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid only through the online portal integrated with the application system.

How to Apply Online for University of Kalyani Faculty Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official portal: Go to www.klyuniv.ac.in or directly access the recruitment portal at www.kums.klyuniv.ac.in.
  2. Register and create login: Click on the faculty recruitment link, register with a valid email ID and mobile number, and create your login credentials.
  3. Fill the online application form: Log in and complete all sections of the form with personal details, academic qualifications, teaching/research experience, publications and other required information.
  4. Upload supporting documents in PDF: Upload duly computed Academic/Research Score sheets (Table 1 for Professor/Associate Professor, Table 2A for Assistant Professor) along with PDFs of publication front pages, ISSN/ISBN/DOI details, impact factors, research projects, patents, awards and other proofs.
  5. Pay the application fee online: Pay the applicable fee for your post and category through the integrated online payment gateway. Keep the payment confirmation/transaction reference for future use.
  6. Review and submit application: Recheck all entries, ensure that all mandatory documents are uploaded, and submit the form before 6:00 PM on 09-02-2026. Download or print the final submitted application for your records.
  7. Follow further communications: Monitor your email and the university website for updates on shortlisting, interview schedules, and any additional instructions issued by the University of Kalyani.

Warning: Applications submitted after the deadline, with incomplete information, or without proper supporting documents/fee payment will be summarily rejected. No offline or email applications will be accepted.

Documents Required for University of Kalyani Faculty Recruitment 2026

  • Duly computed Academic/Research Score sheet (Table 1 for Professor/Associate Professor; Table 2A for Assistant Professor) with self-attested evidence.
  • PFDs of publication front pages with ISSN/ISBN/DOI and impact factor details.
  • Proof of e-content development, research guidance, funded projects, patents, awards/fellowships as applicable.
  • Photocopies of all academic testimonials and certificates; original documents must be produced at the time of interview.
  • Certificate of proficiency/competence in Bengali and English (medium of instruction).
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer for candidates in service.
  • Caste/Community certificate for SC/ST/OBC-A/OBC-B candidates issued by competent authority of West Bengal; Non-creamy layer certificate required if older caste certificate exists for OBC.
  • Disability certificate for PWD candidates in prescribed format.

Selection Procedure – University of Kalyani Faculty Recruitment 2026

  • Applications will be screened based on academic qualifications, research output, teaching experience and documented credentials.
  • Academic/Research Score will be used for shortlisting purposes only and will not be the sole basis of final selection.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, where teaching/research experience, academic record and performance will be evaluated by the Selection Committee.
  • The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable level and to consider only those deemed most relevant.

Important Instructions – University of Kalyani Faculty Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online applications and fees for each post.
  • Proficiency in Bengali and English (medium of instruction) is mandatory for all teaching positions.
  • Employed candidates must apply through proper channel and produce NOC at the time of interview.
  • Period spent on acquiring M.Phil/Ph.D will not be counted as teaching/research experience.
  • Only SC/ST/OBC certificates issued by the competent authority of West Bengal are valid for reservation.
  • OBC-A/OBC-B candidates must submit a current non-creamy layer certificate if their previous certificate is older than one year.
  • Probation period is normally 1 year, which may be waived or extended in exceptional cases; services may be terminated during/after probation without assigning reasons as per rules.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • Mere possession of minimum eligibility does not guarantee a call for interview; the University reserves the right to reject any or all applications or cancel the notification without assigning reasons.

  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

AIIMS Group A Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for REGA-2.0 Non-Faculty Posts

Advertisement

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) has officially announced AIIMS Group A Recruitment 2026. The Examination Section, AIIMS New Delhi, is conducting the Recruitment Examination for Group-A (REGA-2.0) to fill multiple Non-Faculty posts at AIIMS New Delhi and the Pasteur Institute of India, Coonoor (Tamil Nadu).

This is a golden opportunity for medical, research, veterinary, and media professionals looking to secure a prestigious Central Government job with excellent pay levels, allowances, and long-term career growth. The selection will be done through a multi-stage national-level examination.

Interested candidates must apply online before 20 February 2026 (05:00 PM). Late applications will not be accepted — Apply soon to avoid last-minute technical issues!

Category-wise distribution is provided in ANNEXURE-II of the notification (UR/EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwBD).

Educational Qualification for AIIMS Group A 2026

  • General Duty Medical Officer: MBBS or equivalent medical qualification as per Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 + Compulsory Rotating Internship.
  • Educational Media Generalist: Master’s Degree in Psychology / Behavioural Sciences / Social Sciences / Education / Health Education / Communication + 6 years media production experience. PhD preferred.
  • Research Officer: MBBS / B.V.Sc / B.Pharm / Pharm.D / MSc (Medical or Life Sciences streams) / BE/BTech (Biomedical/Pharma/Biotech) + 3 years biopharma industry experience.
  • Veterinary Assistant Surgeon: Recognized Veterinary Degree + Registration with State/Indian Veterinary Council. Knowledge of CCSEA norms preferred.

All qualifications must be completed on or before the last date of application.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Crucial Date: Last date of online application (20 February 2026)
  • Upper Age Limits:
    • GDMO & Educational Media Generalist: Not exceeding 30 years
    • Research Officer & Veterinary Assistant Surgeon: Not exceeding 35 years

Age Relaxation (As per Government Rules)

  • SC/ST: 5 Years
  • OBC: 3 Years
  • PwBD: 10 Years (Max age up to 56 years)
  • PwBD + OBC: 13 Years
  • PwBD + SC/ST: 15 Years
  • Ex-Servicemen: 5 Years
  • Central Govt. Employees (UR/OBC/SC/ST): Up to 5–10 Years (post-specific)

Application Fee

Category Fee
General / OBC ₹3000/-
SC / ST / EWS ₹2400/-
PwBD Exempted

Payment Mode: Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking (Non-refundable)

Section 5: Selection Process (REGA-2.0)

  1. Stage I – CBT (Online Written Test): 200 MCQs (160 Domain + 40 General English/Aptitude/Awareness), 1/3 Negative Marking.
  2. Stage II – Screening: Document eligibility check (5x candidates per seat).
  3. Stage III – Descriptive Written Test (DWT): Offline, 2 Hours, 50 Marks.

Final merit list will be prepared based on combined marks of Stage I & Stage III.

Section 6: Salary & Pay Scale

  • Pay Level 10: ₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500 (7th CPC)
  • Pay Level 11: ₹67,700 – ₹2,08,700 (7th CPC)

Plus Central Government allowances: DA, HRA, Medical, Transport, NPS, and other benefits.

  • Chargeman (Electrical): T–10 Scale of Pay (Rs. 28740 – 3% – Rs. 72110). Diploma in Electrical Engineering with one year experience in mining installations as supervisor after acquiring Supervisory Certificate of competency, covering mining installations issued by the appropriate government; OR ITI (Electrical) with three years experience in mining installations as supervisor after acquiring Supervisory Certificate of competency, covering mining installations issued by the appropriate government; OR Class 10th with five years experience in mining installations as supervisor after acquiring Supervisory Certificate of competency, covering mining installations issued by the appropriate government. Valid Supervisory Certificate of competency, covering mining installations issued by appropriate government is mandatory.
  • Electrician ‘A’: T–08 Scale of Pay (Rs. 28430 – 3% – Rs. 59700). ITI (Electrical) with four years experience as Electrician; OR Class 10th with seven years experience as Electrician. Should possess valid wiremen permit from Government Electrical Inspector.

Com/BBA) with 1 year of experience in the relevant field; OR Apprenticeship with 3 years of experience in the relevant field; OR Class 10th pass with 6 years of experience in the relevant field. Com/BBA) with 06 months of experience in the relevant field; OR Apprenticeship with 2 years of experience in the relevant field; OR Class 10th pass with 4 years of experience in the relevant field. Valid 2nd Class Winding Engine Driver’s Certificate is mandatory.
  • Qualification must be from Universities or Institutes recognized / accredited by councils / bodies like UGC/AICTE/NCTVT/SCTE&VT set up by Central/State Government (wherever applicable). Only full time Regular courses will be considered. This shall include Matriculation (Class 10th), Class 12th, ITI (Electrical), Diploma, Diploma (Electrical) and Graduation as the case may be.
  • Candidates having higher qualification are allowed for applying against the posts of Chargeman (Electrical), Electrician ‘A’ & Electrician ‘B’ only, subject to required experience & statutory qualifications as specified.

Salary/Stipend

  • T–10 Scale of Pay (Rs. 28740 – 3% – Rs. 72110) for Chargeman (Electrical).
  • T–08 Scale of Pay (Rs. 28430 – 3% – Rs. 59700) for Electrician ‘A’.
  • T–07 Scale of Pay (Rs. 28280 – 3% – Rs. 57640) for Electrician ‘B’ and WED ‘B’.
  • T–06 Scale of Pay (Rs. 28120 – 3% – Rs. 55620) for WED ‘C’.
  • Besides Basic Pay and Industrial Dearness Allowance, Perk & Allowance @ 23% of Basic pay, Annual Ex–Gratia, Leaves, Encashment of Earned Leaves, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, NPS etc. are admissible.
  • In addition to the above, the company offers free medical treatment for self, family and dependent parents as per rules. Candidates would be allotted company’s accommodation subject to its availability and no HRA would be allowed, if they do not occupy the allotted Company’s accommodation.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Prescribed maximum age limit as on 01.01.2026 for the above posts is 40 Years.
  • Only Indian Nationals of 18 (Eighteen) years of age and above are eligible to apply.
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 05 years.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non–Creamy Layer): 03 years.
  • Age Relaxation for Meritorious Sports person: 05 years (10 years in the case of those belonging to SC/ST).
  • Age Relaxation for Ex–Servicemen (ESM): Relaxation as per directives of Government of India; upper age will be relaxed for Ex–Servicemen as per rules.

  • The General/UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS Candidates are required to pay non-refundable application processing fee of Rs.500/- (Five Hundred Only).

  • No other form of remittance shall be accepted.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement 07/01/2026
Opening date for submission of online application 27.01.2026 (From 11:00 AM)
Last date of submission of online application 25.02.2026 (Till Midnight)
Cut–off date for reckoning eligibility for educational qualification & post qualification experience and maximum age 01.01.2026

Selection Process

  • The mode of selection consists of (1) Written Test and (2) Trade Test & Writing Ability Test for posts at Sl. no 01 to 05 of para no 2.
  • The maximum marks for written test will be 100 marks and the second level test (Trade Test & Writing Ability Test) will be of qualifying in nature.
  • Written Test question paper booklet will be in English & Hindi and will consist of objective type multiple choice questions. For answering the questions Optical Mark Reader/Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheet will be provided or any other mode as decided by HCL.
  • The Written Test question paper will consist of Subject Knowledge (On Specific Trade) – 80 Marks and General Knowledge – 20 Marks.
  • Candidates will be called for 2nd level test on the basis of performance in First Level Test (Written Test) by following reservation policy. Minimum qualifying marks in Written Test: SC/ST – 35 Marks, OBC (NCL) – 38 Marks and UR/EWS – 40 Marks.
  • The candidates for the post of Chargeman (Electrical), Electrician ‘A’, Electrician ‘B’, WED ‘B’ & WED ‘C’ will be called for 2nd level test (Trade Test & Writing Ability Test) in the ratio of 1:3 based on marks obtained in the Written Test.
  • Trade Test & Writing Ability Test / 2nd Level Test is qualifying in nature. Minimum qualifying marks (out of total of 100 marks): SC/ST – 35 Marks, OBC (NCL) – 38 Marks and UR/EWS – 40 Marks.
  • The merit list of the candidates for 2nd level test and also for final selection will be prepared trade/discipline wise on the basis of performance in the First Level Test (Written Test) only.
  • In the event of a tie in final merit list, criteria adopted: (a) 10th Marks (Higher the percentage, higher the rank), if tie not broken then (b) Age (Older the age, higher the rank in the merit).

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals of 18 (Eighteen) years of age and above are eligible to apply.
  • The candidates are advised to submit the Online Recruitment Applications well in advance without waiting for the closing date. No manual / paper application will be entertained.
  • Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organization/Public Sector Undertakings and Autonomous Bodies should furnish “NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE” at the time of verification of documents.
  • The internal candidates are eligible to apply as per rules of the company.
  • The date of birth as well as the name of the applicant will invariably be taken from Matriculation/10th class certificate issued by the recognized Board and no other proof of date of birth and name shall be accepted.
  • In case of variation in name/surname/name spelling in application and certificates, an affidavit sworn-in before a First-Class Judicial Magistrate/appropriate authority is required at the time of verification of documents.
  • Travelling Allowance will not be paid to any candidate appearing for written test/document verification/trade test & writing ability test.
  • The prescribed educational qualifications are mandatory and in absence of the same the candidate shall become ineligible to be called for document verification and written test.
  • HCL Management reserves the right to alter/fix the criteria for calling the candidates for document verification/written test on the basis of qualification, experience, etc., depending upon the number of applications received.
  • If any information provided by the candidate is found incorrect/incomplete or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, or if it is found that candidate has concealed/distorted any material information, his/her candidature will be cancelled at any stage or even after selection.
  • Short listing will be done on the basis of information provided in online application. HCL will not be responsible for veracity of information as no physical documents are called at the time of submission of application.
  • Candidates must ensure that accurate information is provided through online application. Any deviation found during document verification will result in rejection of the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to attempt registration more than once for same post. In case of multiple registrations, the one with latest application sequence number will be considered.
  • No request for change of examination venue will be entertained.
  • Mere fulfilling of the minimum criteria will not vest any right in candidates for being called for different stages of recruitment process. Management reserves the right to raise/relax/cancel/modify/alter the recruitment/selection process.
  • The selected candidates will be posted in Khetri Copper Complex, Rajasthan State. However, Management reserves the right to post/transfer the selected candidates to any of the other Mines/Offices of KCC as per requirement at any stage during service.
  • The email id and mobile number entered in the online application form should remain active till the process of recruitment is complete. No change in email id will be allowed once entered.
  • Information regarding document verification & written test will be provided in the Admit Card/Call Letter obtained at Careers Page of HCL Website and candidates will be intimated through email/SMS.
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Khetri, District Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan only.
  • HCL reserves the right to fill or not fill or partly fill any of the positions without assigning any reason and to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the recruitment process, if required.
  • HCL is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages workplace diversity.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and interested candidates only need to apply. Candidates should apply only through online registration from HCL website (www.hindustancopper.com) under the link “Careers”. No other means / mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Before filling the online application, candidates are advised to carefully read the instructions contained in “How to fill the Online Application form” provided on the website. They may click on the ‘Career’ button to get the instruction for online application submission.
  • Interested Candidates can apply against multiple posts, subject to fulfillment of eligibility criteria as mentioned at column no (D) & (E) of para no 2. Candidates have to pay separate application fee as per details mentioned at para no 5 if they decide to apply for more than one post.
  • The written test for posts mentioned at para no 2 shall be conducted in two different shifts on a same day: Forenoon session for Chargeman (Electrical), Electrician ‘A’ & WED ‘B’; Afternoon session for Electrician ‘B’ & WED ‘C’. Candidates interested to apply for more than one post have to apply accordingly as they will be allowed to appear in Written Test in one paper only in each session.
  • To complete the online application process and get the Application number, it is mandatory to put in all the relevant information such as qualifying degree details, percentage of marks, email address and mobile no., address for correspondence, soft copy of scanned photograph and signature (JPEG). Therefore, applicants are advised to keep such information ready before applying online.
  • Candidates have to upload documents in the online portal as per list given in the notification for each post (educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, caste certificates, statutory certificates, etc.).
  • While filling the online application it must be ensured that the working experience declared by the individual candidate shall be in line with the validity of the respective statutory certificate acquired by the candidate.
  • After submitting the online application, the candidates should print the Computer-Generated Online Application and the Acknowledgement Slip and keep a copy for their reference and records.
  • In case of any difficulty while filling online application, candidates may contact HCL, KCC on email [email protected] or landline no 01593 – 220128.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited only from eligible and willing Officers of all Major Port Authorities possessing prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions as per MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010 (Recruitment Rules at Annexure I).
  • Absorption/deputation will be of Officers holding analogous posts or officers in feeder posts with required qualifying service and experience in a Major Port Trust as specified in the Recruitment Rules.
  • Promotion channel in the Recruitment Rules specifies promotion from Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, with Degree in Civil Engineering from recognised University/Institution (or essential Diploma in Civil Engineering in specified cases).
  • Industrial/commercial/Govt. undertakings experience in planning/construction/design/maintenance, especially of Port and Marine structures, is required as per detailed Recruitment Rules extract.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Executive Engineer (Civil) carries the pay scale of Rs.50000-160000.
  • The circular also refers to pre-revised scales of Rs.20600-46500 and Rs.10750-16750 for the post, as per earlier pay structures in the Recruitment Rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • The crucial date for determining eligibility is 01.01.2026 in terms of Regulation 10(2) of the MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority & Promotion) Regulations, 2010.
  • The circular and attached Recruitment Rules do not explicitly mention minimum or maximum age limits in years; eligibility is governed by service, cadre and qualification conditions as on 01.01.2026.

Application Fee

Important Dates

Notification Date 19/01/2026
Crucial Date for Eligibility 01/01/2026 (as per Regulation 10(2) of MbPT (RS&P) Regulations, 2010)
Last Date for Receipt of Applications by Mumbai Port Authority 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Filling up of the posts of Executive Engineer (Civil) will be by absorption/deputation from Officers of all Major Port Authorities, in accordance with MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010.
  • Applications will be forwarded by the concerned Port Authority along with Vigilance and administrative clearance, certified copies of ACRs/ APARs and required certificates, for consideration by Mumbai Port Authority.
  • The process is a selection post as per the Recruitment Rules, with scrutiny of eligibility, ACRs and vigilance status; no written test or interview details are specified in the circular text.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be made in the format at Annexure II and submitted through proper channel by the concerned Major Port Authority.
  • The concerned Port Authority must forward the application along with: certificate on last page of application duly completed by HoD; certified copies of ACRs for last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25) duly attested by an Officer not below Dy. HoD on each page; statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs and grading signed by Secretary/HoD; and Vigilance & administrative clearances.
  • The circular, along with Annexures, is also available on www.mumbaiport.gov.in under “People & Career/Jobs”.

  • Self-attested copies of certificates in support of educational and other qualifications, and documents in support of employment in organisations other than Major Port Authority, may be enclosed with the application.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the application form in the format given at Annexure II of the circular.
  • Route the application through proper channel, ensuring the Head of Department completes the certificate on the last page of the application form.
  • Attach certified copies of ACRs for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), the year-wise ACR availability and grading statement signed by Secretary/HoD, and Vigilance & administrative clearances.
  • The concerned Major Port Authority must forward the complete application and enclosures to the designated authority in Mumbai Port Authority so as to reach on or before 20.02.2026.
  • Candidates must ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions as per the MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010 as on the crucial date 01.01.2026.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

Main Exam Structure

  • Total Written Papers: 9
  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks
Personality Test / Interview 275

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

Salary / Stipend

  • Annual CTC, which is negotiable, will depend upon Experience & Current Emoluments of candidates in the present employment and place of posting. The CTC comprises 90% fixed and 10% variable pay. Annual increment in CTC is subject to satisfactory annual performance. Any other Perks -NO
  • Variable Pay: The contractual officer shall become eligible for payment of variable pay subject to securing minimum qualifying 90% marks in the performance appraisal of the relevant period at half yearly intervals as on 31st March and 30th September subject to deduction of Income tax as per the extant Income tax rules. In case the contract ends before the completion of 6 months (from 2nd year onwards), the variable pay will be released on pro-rata basis.
  • ANNUAL INCREMENT: The Annual increment proposed from second year onwards can be upto 10% of annual CTC finalized at the time of Negotiation, subject to the achievement of performance appraisal score of at least 90% (Minimum score to be eligible for annual increment) with distribution of Annual increment aligned to the Fixed and variable components. Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: Mere fulfilling minimum qualification and experience will not vest any right in candidate for being called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and thereafter, adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank, will be shortlisted for interview. The decision of the Bank to call the candidates for the interview shall be final. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard. The shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.
  • Interview: Interview will carry 100 marks. The qualifying marks in interview will be decided by the Bank. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation will be done with the candidates in the order of Merit one by one (i.e., In case the selected candidate does not agree with the negotiated price, the name of the candidate shall be considered as Voluntary Exit from the recruitment exercise and next candidate in the merit list shall be called for negotiation). CTC Negotiation will be done at the time of Interview or after completion of interview process, separately.
  • Merit list: Merit list for selection will be prepared in descending order on the basis of scores obtained in interview only. In case more than one candidate scores the cut-off marks (common marks at cut-off point), such candidates will be ranked according to their age in descending order, in the merit list.
  • Final Selection: Top-most candidates in the Merit List, with whom CTC is negotiated successfully, will be finally selected.

  • Bank reserves the Right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage without assigning any reasons thereof, whatsoever.

The Bank may also conduct independent verification, inter alia, including verification of Police Records, etc. The Bank reserves the right to deny the engagement/appointment depending upon such disclosure and/or independent verification.

How to Apply

  • Candidates will be required to register themselves online through the link available on SBI website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and pay the application fee using Internet Banking/ Debit Card/ Credit Card etc.
  • Candidates should first scan their latest photograph and signature. Online application will not be registered unless candidate uploads his/ her photo and signature as specified on the online registration page (under 'How to Upload Document').
  • Candidates should fill the application carefully. Once application is filled-in completely, candidate should submit the same. In the event of candidate not being able to fill the application in one go, he can save the information already entered. When the information/ application is saved, a provisional registration number and password is generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the registration number and password. They can re-open the saved application using registration number and password and edit the particulars, if needed. This facility of editing the saved information will be available for three times only. Once the application is filled completely, candidate should submit the same and proceed for online payment of fee.
  • After registering online, the candidates are advised to take a printout of the system generated online application forms.
  • Login to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings

In this article, you’ll find the MRVC Project Engineer Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

MRVC Project Engineer (Civil / Electrical) Recruitment 2026 Overview

MRVC Project Engineer (Civil / Electrical) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Project Engineer (Civil) 16
Project Engineer (Electrical) 9

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Civil/Electrical Engineering from recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates should have qualified in the GATE-2023/2024/2025 in Civil/Electrical respective discipline.

Salary/Stipend

  • The selected candidates will be placed in the IDA equivalent E1/40,000-140000 grade. They shall be paid Basic Pay of Rs. 40,000/-, Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowances and other allowances, medical facilities and leave as per the policy of the corporation.

Age Limit (as on 16-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Relaxation in Upper Age Limit : 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL), subject to submission of a copy of Caste Certificate/OBC (NCL) certificate along with NCL declaration, in the format prescribed by the Govt. of India for "Appointment to Posts under Govt. of India" from a competent authority, at the time of application and interview, if called for.

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Notification Date 16.01.2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 10.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Only those candidates eligible in all respects and have qualified in the relevant GATE 2023/2024/2025 Score and have submitted their applications with all necessary documents shall only be considered for further selection process in MRVC.
  • Based on their GATE Score, candidates shall be shortlisted for document verification and personal interview on the basis of discipline-wise category-wise merit list (Not more than 5 times of vacancies).
  • In case a candidate does not appear for document verification along with original documents, his/her candidature shall be rejected.
  • Upon completion of document Verification, the candidates shall be Personally Interviewed.
  • Candidates shall obtain information about their status through the Corporation's website only.
  • Weightage to Different Parameters: GATE score (out of 100) 80%, Personal Interview 20%.
  • The qualifying percentage of marks in the personal interview is 60%.
  • In case of a tie in the total marks (GATE Score weightage + Personal Interview marks) scored between two or more candidates, following criteria will be adopted in order of sequence for deciding position in merit list: The candidate having higher score in the relevant GATE examination will be ranked higher. Where GATE scores are tied, candidates older in age shall be placed higher in the merit list. Where both GATE score and date of birth are tied, candidates with higher marks in qualifying degree shall be placed higher in the merit list.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidature of a candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of engagement process or after engagement or joining, if any information provided by the candidate is false or is found to be not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Candidates if shortlisted for document verification and Personal Interview are required to bring their valid GATE- Admit Card and GATE Score Card, Engineering Graduation Mark Sheet, Engineering Graduation Certificate, PG certificate if any, SSC Mark Sheet, Date of Birth Certificate/ID proof, SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS Certificate as the case may be, copy of the Application Form and recent Passport size photograph (photograph should match with the one pasted in the Application Form) for verification with other relevant documents at the time of document verification.
  • Photocopies of the original identification documents shall not be acceptable. Candidates will not be permitted to appear for the personal interview if original and valid photo ID proof is not presented along with the GATE Admit Card and Score Card.
  • Valid OBC-NCL/EWS certificate should be produced as per the format at Annexure II & III valid on the closing date of the application.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification.
  • Candidates must correctly enter their name, date of birth, qualification details. Applications once submitted cannot be altered. Accordingly, no request for change in applicant's data after submission of application shall be entertained.
  • MRVC reserves the right to cancel / restrict / enlarge/ modify / alter the engagement process, if need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years or above are eligible to apply for the post.
  • Before applying, the candidate should ensure that he / she fulfills the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this advertisement.
  • Essential qualification should be recognized in India and from a recognized Institution or University.
  • Date of issuance of final mark sheet shall be taken as the date of acquiring qualification.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/DGPA is awarded, its equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated in the application form as per norms adopted by University / Institute.
  • Percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in the bachelor's degree shall be calculated based on the practice followed by the university/institution from where the candidate has obtained the degree. In case the candidates are awarded grades/CGPA instead of marks, the conversion of grades/CGPA to percentage of marks shall be based on the procedure certified by the university/ institution from where they have obtained the bachelor's degree. In case the university/ institution does not have any scheme for converting CGPA into equivalent marks, the equivalence would be established by dividing the candidate's CGPA by the maximum possible CGPA and multiplying the result with 100.
  • Marks in Essential Qualification will not be rounded off for deciding eligibility of any candidate.
  • Mere submission of application to MRVC does not guarantee the adequacy of candidature for being considered for further selection process.
  • All information regarding this recruitment process would be made available in the career section of MRVC website only. Applicants are advised to check the website periodically for important updates. All correspondences shall be made through the registered e-mail ID only.
  • For any queries regarding this recruitment please send email to [email protected].
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Mumbai in case of any cause / dispute.

How to Apply

  • The duly filled in application as per the format at Annexure-I with following documents should be mailed to "[email protected]": GATE-2023/2024/2025 Admit Card & Score Card, Engineering Graduation Marksheet, PG Mark sheet, if any, SSC Marksheet, ID Proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card), Experience certificate (if any), SC/ST/OBC NCL/EWS Certificate.
  • Candidates should have a valid personal email ID, which should be kept active till the completion of selection process. MRVC shall send communication calling shortlisted candidates for Document Verification etc. through e-mail only.
  • Application should be complete in all respects, and as per the prescribed format. Applications not conforming to the prescribed format and without the required documents annexed will be summarily rejected.
  • THE LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION BY MAIL IS 10.02.2026.

Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation (MMRCL)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 06 Deputy Engineer, Junior Engineer, Assistant and Other Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official MMRCL website. The last date to submit the application form is 27-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the MMRCL Deputy Engineer, Junior Engineer, Assistant and Other Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MMRCL)
Post Name General Manager, Assistant General Manager, Deputy Engineer, Junior Engineer, Assistant
No of Posts 06
Advt No 2026-01
Salary Rs. 34,020 - 2,80,000/- (IDA Pay Scale)
Qualification Full time Degree/Diploma in Engineering
Age Limit Maximum 35 to 55 years (as per post)
Start Date for Apply 29/01/2026
Last Date for Apply 27/02/2026
