  • Documents: All documents must be self-attested scanned copies
  • Photograph: Recent passport-size photograph is mandatory
  • Caste Certificate: If claiming reserved category benefit, valid caste certificate issued by Competent Authority must be submitted
  • Receipt Number: Online fee payment receipt number must be entered in application form
  • Accuracy: Ensure all information is accurate and complete before submission
  • Bank Issues: Institute is not responsible for incomplete, pending, or failed online payment transactions; candidates should contact their bank

Selection Process

Selection Procedure

  1. Stage 1: Application Screening
    • All submitted applications will be reviewed for eligibility and completeness
    • Applications will be evaluated based on qualifications and eligibility criteria
    • Shortlist of candidates will be prepared based on well-defined criteria
  2. Stage 2: Shortlist Display
    • List of shortlisted candidates for walk-in-interview will be displayed on Institute website
    • Date and time of interview will also be displayed
  3. Stage 3: Walk-In-Interview
    • Shortlisted candidates must appear for walk-in-interview on specified date and time
    • Interview will be conducted by selection committee
    • Interview will assess candidate's knowledge, skills, and suitability for the position
    • Interview can be conducted in Hindi or English as per candidate's preference
  4. Stage 4: Final Selection
    • Final selection will be made based on interview performance and qualifications
    • Selected candidate will be notified by the Institute

Shortlisting Criteria

  • Meeting minimum essential qualifications
  • Possession of desirable qualifications and experience
  • Relevant field experience (particularly in biological/pharmaceutical research or cancer research)
  • Quality of academic qualifications
  • Animal handling experience (if applicable)
  • Institute may restrict number of candidates to be called for interview to a reasonable limit if applications are large
  • In case of deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates, desirable qualifications may be relaxed

Terms & Conditions

Employment Terms

  • Nature: Purely contractual temporary position
  • Duration: For the project tenure up to 04th December 2029
  • Basis: Project-based employment subject to project funding and annual performance review
  • No Right to Appointment: Selected candidates will have no right for appointment against any ARI or funding agency's permanent/regular posts
  • Project Assignment: Candidates may be assigned to another project based on institutional requirement
  • Location: MACS - Agharkar Research Institute, Pune

Important Terms

  • No Travel Allowance: No TA (Travel Allowance) is admissible for interviews or any other purpose
  • Minimum Qualifications: Prescribed essential qualifications are minimum; mere possession does not guarantee interview call
  • Equivalence of Qualifications: Consideration of qualifications as 'equivalent' to stated essential/desirable qualifications will be at discretion of selection committee
  • Performance Review: Continuation of position subject to annual performance review
  • Exceptional Qualification Relaxation: Desirable qualifications may be relaxed for deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates at discretion of Competent Authority
  • Project Requirement: Candidates may be reassigned to another project based on institutional need
  • Language Option: Candidates have the option to appear for interview in Hindi language as well as English

  • In case of large number of eligible applications received, then candidates equal to 05 times the notified vacancies will only be called for document verification and interaction based on their experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the Candidate.
  • The overall qualifying marks shall be minimum 60%. The candidates must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the personal interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC. Such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel. Posts notified are not regular establishment posts.
  • The candidate selected for the above contractual agreement shall not be absorbed in MRVC regular service. The candidate therefore shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC and shall be required to give an undertaking in writing to MRVC to that effect.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The candidates must bring with them original application, original certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopy in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational and experience on the date of document verification and interaction, failing which candidate will not be eligible for interview.
  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character.
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/ certificate/ information are found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, then the contractual service will be immediately terminated forthwith without assigning any reason and prior notice, besides legal action which may also be initiated.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/ restrict/ curtail/ enlarge the contract engagement process, if need so arises, without any prior notice and without assigning any reasons therefore.
  • No train/bus fare/ TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC. Any deviation in the said policy will be dealt on case to case basis, based on the merits of the case.
  • Officials serving Govt./PSUs / Autonomous Bodies, if selected, will be allowed to join only after they are properly relieved from their parent organisation.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract if the contract appointee is found unsuitable, by giving one month notice or payment in lieu thereof. Similarly, the appointee will be required to give one month notice to MRVC for termination of contract.
  • The selected candidate on engagement should also attend emergencies and other calls of duties, as demanded and expected, during their day to day activities.
  • In the event the appointee is found involved in undesirable activities such as embezzlement, unlawful activities (including passing on confidential information of MRVC), unauthorized absence, in-subordination or breach of any of the terms of contract without prejudice to the right to initiate civil/criminal proceedings, the contract appointment shall be terminated.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC from time to time. The email account and user ID's created for official purposes shall always be used in a responsible, effective, ethical and lawful manner. Any misuse of these resources and / or putting the Corporation at risk of any liability based on such misuse shall result in termination of employment and appropriate legal action.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].
  • Last date for submission of application by mail is 28.02.2026.
  • Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I). Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 28.02.2026.
  • Self-attested documents to be attached with the filled application: Copy of original application, Copies of certificate in proof of qualification (As per the qualification specified in Notification), Copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate), Copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card), Copy of document regarding experience, last served and others, Character certificate from Gazetted officer/Executive officers for certifying that he/she is bearing good moral character not older than six months.
  • Copy of employment letter issued by previous as well as present employer, Copy of Form 16 issued by previous / present employer, Copy of document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Number/PF Number.

  8. Applicants are advised to register online themselves and to keep their email id alive during the recruitment exercise. The candidates should give their mobile number in the application form for SMS/Call service from the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority.

The Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority reserves the right to hold any test wherever deemed necessary as well as the right to add, delete or allot any center at its discretion.
  10. Admission to further recruitment process will be purely provisional without verification of age / qualification / experience / category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) etc. of the Candidates with reference to documents.
  11. Original documents relating to Age/Qualification/Category etc. will have to be produced at the time of verification. Caste certificate accompanied with caste validity certificate must be submitted by candidates seeking reservation/relaxation as SC/ST/OBC in the prescribed proforma from the competent authority indicating clearly the candidate’s caste, the Act/Order under which the caste is recognized as SC/ST/OBC and the village/town the candidate is originally a resident of.

  13. Candidates serving in Government / Quasi Government Offices, Public Sector undertakings will be required to submit “No Objection Certificate‟ from their employer at the time of Verification/certificate scrutiny, failing which their candidature may not be considered. Candidates who are selected are required to submit unconditional discharge letter / relieving letter from their employer (Govt./Public sector / Private) at the time of joining Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, WITHOUT WHICH THEY WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO JOIN.
  14. The candidates will have to appear for the tests, verification of documents etc., at their own cost.
  15. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to their being found medically fit as per the requirements of the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. Such appointment will also be subject to the service and conduct rules of the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority.
  16. Decisions of the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority in all matters regarding eligibility, conduct of online examination, other tests and selection would be final and binding on all candidates.   18. Selected candidates will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Service Regulations of the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority in force.
  19. Candidate’s admission to the online test/written exam other tests is strictly provisional. The mere fact that the call letter has been issued to the candidate does not imply that his/her candidature has been finally cleared by the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority.
  20. The Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority reserves the right to cancel the above Recruitment Exercise at any stage of the process without assigning any reason thereof.

  • The Reserve Bank of India, Kanpur will be conducting an interview for the eligible candidates.

  • The shortlisted applicant/s after the interview will be subjected to medical tests as per prescribed norms and document verification process before engagement as Bank's Medical Consultant.

  • Candidate selected for the post will be appointed subject to him/her being found medically fit and acceptance of Terms and Conditions of Contract as per Annex-I and Code of Conduct as per Annex-II.
  • The selected applicant has to sign an agreement for Contract with the Bank before engagement of the services of Bank's Medical Consultant (on contractual basis) with fixed hourly remuneration.

General Information / Instructions

  • The Bank reserves the right to review the rate of remuneration from time to time, as well as the dispensary to be attached for the BMC and alter the duty hours at its discretion in case it becomes expedient to suit administrative and operative requirements.
  • Interested and eligible candidates may make an application in the prescribed format as at Annex-III. The application should be sent in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for Engagement of Part Time Bank's Medical Consultant on contractual basis".
  • The engagement under the contract is temporary. No claim shall lie for regular employment on that basis at any stage or pay and perks payable to regular employees of the Bank.
  • The contract will be terminable during the period of the contract, upon three months' notice on either side or three months remuneration in lieu thereof.
  • Your contract will be valid for a period of three years from the date of engagement subject to your accepting the above terms and conditions and observing the code of conduct of the Bank as given in Annex II. The contract will be reviewed every year.
  • Any dispute arising on account of the contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts of Kanpur.

How to Apply

  • The application should be sent in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for Engagement of Part Time Bank's Medical Consultant on contractual basis".
  • Send to: Regional Director, Reserve Bank of India, Human Resource Management Department (Recruitment Section), Mahatma Gandhi Marg, Kanpur - 208001.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Secondary School Examination (SSE) pass certificate of 10th standard with passing marks in Mathematics and English conducted by any recognized Board of School Education by the Government of India, State Governments, or Union Territories in India.
  • The applicant should have studied the local language at least up to 10th Standard from a recognized board. Post-wise local language details are given in Annexure-III.
  • Special provisions apply for engagement in Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, and Sikkim regarding local language requirements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Knowledge of computers
  • Knowledge of cycling
  • Adequate means of livelihood

Desirable

  • Candidates applying for BPM posts must be able to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • Ability to work in rural areas
  • Ability to use smartphones, laptops, or computer devices

Salary/Stipend

GDS are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carry an annual increase of 3 percent, subject to fulfillment of conditions. They are also entitled to Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time.

  • Branch Postmaster (BPM): Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380 per month
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM): Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month
  • Dak Sevak: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month

Additional Benefits:

  • Dearness Allowance on TRCA
  • GDS Gratuity
  • Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to National Pension System)

Age Limit (as on 16/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years

Age Relaxation

SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe) 5 years
OBC (Other Backward Classes) 3 years
EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) No relaxation
PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) 10 years
PwBD + OBC 13 years
PwBD + SC/ST 15 years

Note: Age will be determined as on the last date of submission of applications (16/02/2026).

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 100 (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Important Dates

Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment 02/02/2026 16/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)

Process of Engagement Closes 30/06/2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

  • Junior Manager (P&A) - HR-22: Recognized degree in any discipline and MBA (HR) with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Personnel Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Diploma in HR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in HR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Diploma in IR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in IR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Master of Social Work (MSW) with minimum 55% marks. Degree or Diploma should be from Recognized Institution (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Welfare Officer - HR-23: A Degree from any University established by law in Social Sciences or Labour Welfare OR Industrial Relations and Personnel Management. Thorough knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari Script
  • Senior Manager (IT) - HR-24: Full time Engineering Degree in Computer Science with a minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institution OR Full time Engineering Degree in Information Technology with a minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institution OR Full time Master of Computer Applications with a minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institution
  • Specialist SAP FICO - HR-25: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute OR CMA or CA from a government recognized University/Institute OR Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP General & PM - HR-26: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP SD - HR-27: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP BASIS - HR-28: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • AI Engineer/Data Scientist - HR-29: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field. At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong focus on applications related to manufacturing industry
  • Manager - Design & Development (Electronics) - HR-30: Full-Time Engineering Degree in Electronics with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Assistant Manager - (Design & Development) - HR-31: Full Time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronic Engineering with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/institute
  • Junior Manager - Design & Development (Electronics) - HR-32: Full Time Engineering Degree in Electronics with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Officer - O & M (Electrical/Electronics & Instrumentation) - HR-33: Full Time Engineering Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Instrumentation with minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institute. GATE Score Card - 2025 is required

Essential Qualifications

  • All essential qualifications should be from recognized Universities/Institutions approved by UGC/AICTE/Government of India as applicable
  • For GATE-based posts (HR-04 and HR-33), candidates must possess valid GATE 2025 score card
  • For professional qualifications like CA/ICWA/CS, candidates must have passed the final examination from respective institutes
  • For posts requiring registration with RCI (HR-18 and HR-19), candidates must be registered in Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR)
  • The prescribed qualifications are mandatory and in absence of the same any higher qualification even if possessed by the candidate does not make any candidate eligible
  • No age and percentage of marks bar for Departmental/Internal candidates who are on regular rolls or under Fixed Term Contracts with the corporation

Experience

  • General Manager Posts (HR-01, HR-05, HR-12, HR-20): Minimum 18 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector with eight years at senior management capacity. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediately lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Deputy General Manager Posts (HR-06, HR-13): Minimum 16 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediately lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Senior Manager Posts (HR-14, HR-24): Minimum 14 years post qualification experience in Government/PSU/reputed organizations. PSU/Government applicants should have minimum 02 years experience in the immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Manager Posts (HR-07, HR-15, HR-30): Minimum 12 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Deputy Manager Posts (HR-02, HR-08, HR-16): Minimum 10 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Assistant Manager (HR-31): Minimum 8 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing sector or research organization in field of design, research and development. Should have worked in immediate lower scale for at least 02 years. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Specialist SAP FICO (HR-25): Minimum 06 years of experience in SAP FICO with experience supporting general functions including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Fixed Asset Accounting, Inter-company Accounting, and Project System. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Junior Manager Posts (HR-03, HR-09, HR-17, HR-22, HR-32): Minimum 05 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Specialist SAP General & PM, SAP SD, SAP BASIS (HR-26, HR-27, HR-28): Minimum 05 years of experience in respective SAP modules. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • AI Engineer/Data Scientist (HR-29): At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in AI/ML engineering, with strong focus on applications related to manufacturing industry. Hands-on experience in developing and deploying AI models and machine learning algorithms for marketing and production environments. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Accountant (HR-11): 04 Years in field of Accounting functions
  • Officer Level Posts (HR-04, HR-10, HR-18, HR-19, HR-21, HR-23, HR-33): For HR-04 and HR-33 - GATE 2025 score required with relevant knowledge. For HR-10 - Good knowledge in Accounts and Taxation. For HR-18 - Knowledge in fabrication and fitting of artificial limbs and conducting camps. For HR-19 - Knowledge to examine patients with hearing, balance, or related ear problems and conducting camps. For HR-21 - As per qualifications mentioned with practical experience requirements. For HR-23 - Knowledge in labour or Social Welfare Work in an organization or other social and administrative work
  • Teaching experience and training period will not be counted as experience
  • Candidates from private sector should be drawing minimum consolidated fixed monthly gross salary as specified for respective grades (E-7: Rs. 1,86,120/-, E-6: Rs. 1,65,440/-, E-5: Rs. 1,44,760/-, E-4: Rs. 1,24,080/-, E-3: Rs. 1,03,400/-, E-2: Rs. 82,720/-, E-1: Rs. 62,040/-, E-0: NIL). Monthly gross salary includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, HRA and other Fixed Perks and Allowance. No variable pay and incentive or reimbursement of expenses shall be considered
  • Wherever applicable, candidates must produce experience certificate as per required format during document verification

Desirable

  • All applicants should preferably have good computer knowledge and communication skills
  • Acquaintance with SAP shall be an added advantage for the candidates as Corporation's working is in SAP
  • For Deputy Manager - Production (Textile): Experience with SAP/ERP systems and export related process is desirable
  • For General Manager (Marketing): Knowledge of Corporate social responsibility, asset management, acquisition mergers contracts and negotiation, MOU etc. is desirable. Experience on manufacturing, distribution and supply of Artificial Limbs and Rehabilitation Aids, maintaining MIS on large domain, in/out bound logistics/SCM and CRM with logistics will be preferred. Knowledge of ERP is desirable
  • For Deputy General Manager - Marketing: Exposure to social sector/rehabilitation/healthcare/medical devices/assistive devices will be preferred
  • For Senior Manager - Marketing (Consumer Sales): Exposure to rehabilitation and healthcare/medical devices will be preferred
  • For Manager (Market Research & Data Analysis): Experience in the field of healthcare/rehabilitation/assistive devices/medical devices/social sector or public policy programs will be preferred
  • For General Manager (Projects & Commercial): Candidates having exposure in handling turn key projects of sizeable value of engineering industry will be preferred
  • For AI Engineer/Data Scientist: Experience with advanced optimization algorithms for marketing, supply chain and production scheduling. Familiarity with robotics and automation in Industries. Understanding of Industry 4.0 principles and smart marketing and manufacturing technologies. Prior experience in integrating AI with ERP/MES systems
  • For Junior Manager - Design & Development (Electronics): Knowledge of embedded firmware development for real-time applications using various microcontroller platforms is desirable

Salary/Stipend

  • E-7 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 2,60,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 34,31,280/- (including Basic, IDA at 51.8%, Perks at 35%, HRA at 20%, Superannuation at 30% of Basic+DA, PRP/PLAI variable component)
  • E-6 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 2,40,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 30,36,312/-
  • E-5 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 2,20,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 26,52,864/-
  • E-4 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 2,00,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 23,21,256/-
  • E-3 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,80,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 19,55,088/-
  • E-2 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 1,60,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 15,14,040/-
  • E-1 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 13,03,392/-
  • E-0 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 9,77,544/-. Officers at E-0 will be given basic salary of Rs. 30,000/- for initial 1 year. On confirmation after satisfactory performance after 1 year of joining, basic salary will be fixed at Rs. 36,000/- under same pay scale
  • Group-D: Pay Scale Rs. 18,790/- to Rs. 64,130/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 6,25,496/-
  • IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) changes every quarter based on AICPI. Current IDA for Oct-Dec 2025 quarter is 51.8%
  • The annual increment is 3% of the basic pay every year
  • HRA for metro cities is currently 30% and for other cities is 20%
  • In addition to basic pay, selected candidates would be entitled for DA, HRA, perks and other benefits like PF contribution of 12%, Pension Scheme, PRP, Incentive (PLAI), Indoor treatment, hospitalization facilities under Medical Rules, Post-Retirement Medical Scheme, Gratuity, Earned leave and casual leave as per the rules of the Corporation
  • The employee and dependents are covered under Hospitalization scheme as per Group Health Insurance Scheme of the Corporation
  • OPD facility also be provided up to one month basic plus DA in a financial year subject to submission of bill from Corporation empaneled hospitals/doctors
  • Even after superannuation, the employee and spouse can avail post-retirement medical benefit
  • The Corporation has its PF Trust and the share of both employee and employer is 12%. Rs. 1,250/- every month goes to FPF maintained by EPFO. Family Pension is admissible after attaining the age of 58 years
  • The corporation has taken up a superannuation policy with LIC of India where employees can contribute 10% and the corporation shall contribute 10% of the salary. At the time of superannuation, LIC calculates the Fund Corpus and fixes annuity for the life of the employee and thereafter his/her spouse

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • E-7 Grade (General Manager Posts): Maximum age 55 years
  • E-6 Grade (Deputy General Manager Posts): Maximum age 52 years
  • E-5 Grade (Senior Manager Posts): Maximum age 50 years
  • E-4 Grade (Manager Posts): Maximum age 48 years
  • E-3 Grade (Deputy Manager and Specialist Posts): Maximum age 45 years
  • E-2 Grade (Assistant Manager Posts): Maximum age 42 years
  • E-1 Grade (Junior Manager and AI Engineer Posts): Maximum age 40 years
  • E-0 Grade (Officer Level Posts): Maximum age 30 years
  • Group-D (Accountant): Maximum age 34 years
  • The candidate should not have exceeded the age limit as of 01.01.2026. The date for reckoning the age, qualification, experience, etc. shall be 01.01.2026
  • No age and percentage of marks bar for Departmental/Internal candidates who are on the regular rolls of the Corporation or are under Fixed Term Contracts with the corporation
  • Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates (Percentage of disability 40% or above) will be provided as per guidelines of Government of India
  • The SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates who apply against unreserved (UR) posts will not be eligible for age relaxation
  • PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates (Percentage of disability 40% or above) are eligible for age relaxations

Application Fee

  • For Executive Posts (E0-E7): Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only)
  • For Non-Executive Posts (Group-D): Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred Fifty only)
  • Exemption: SC/ST/PwBD and departmental candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee
  • Payment Mode: Candidates are required to visit the ALIMCO website (www.alimco.in), click on the "Career" option, and then select "Pay Recruitment Fee." They will be redirected to the SBI e-Collect page, where they must click on the "GOVT/PSU/COURTS" option and search for "ALIMCO"
  • Alternative Payment Mode: In case candidates face any issues while making the application fee payment through SBI e-Collect, they may deposit the fee using bank details: Account Name: M/S ALIMCO, Current Account Number: 10384171780, IFSC: SBIN0003962, Bank Name: State Bank of India, Branch Address: ALIMCO, G. T. Road, Naramau, Kanpur - 209217
  • After successful payment, candidates must download the payment receipt (PDF) and upload the same in the application form
  • After successful payment, candidates are required to mention/fill up the transaction details in the application form before submitting the online application
  • The application fee, once paid, shall be non-refundable and non-adjustable under any circumstances
  • The application fee shall be refunded in case management decides to cancel the process of recruitment of any post for any reason
  • The Corporation shall not be held responsible for any inadvertent error, omission, or technical issue arising during the payment of the application fee

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Date 31/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 31/01/2026 (2:00 PM)
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 10/03/2026 (5:00 PM)
Last Date for Application Fee Payment Queries 06/03/2026 (5:00 PM)
Date for Reckoning Age, Qualification, Experience 01/01/2026

Selection Process

  • For most posts including General Managers, Deputy Managers, Managers, Junior Managers, and Officer level positions: Applications shall be scrutinized and eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview as per the recruitment policy of the Corporation. In case the number of eligible candidates in the ratio 1:20 (i.e., 20 applications exceeding on one post), the Corporation may conduct an online test prior to the interview. Average weightage will be 50% marks of the online test and 50% marks of the interview
  • For Specialist SAP Posts (HR-25 to HR-28): Selection shall be based on personal interview
  • For E-0 Level Posts - Accounts Officer (HR-10), P&O Officer (HR-18), Officer - Audiologist (HR-19): Selection shall be based on an online test
  • For Officer - Production (HR-04) and Officer - O&M (HR-33): Selection shall be based on marks obtained in the GATE-2025 scorecard
  • For Accountant (HR-11): Selection shall be based only on an online test
  • The candidature of all applicants shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates, testimonials, and other relevant documents
  • Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria/norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/online test
  • Management reserves the right to call suitable/short-listed candidates for online test/interview/Skill test
  • Management reserves the right to raise standard of specifications i.e. qualification/percentage of marks/experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • Management reserves the right to cancel candidature of any candidate or cancel recruitment process of any aforesaid post without assigning any reason

General Information/Instructions

  • ALIMCO (Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India) is a CPSU working under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
  • ALIMCO is a Government of India Undertaking 'Mini Ratna' Company
  • Recruitment is for ALIMCO HQ at Kanpur and its ALIMCO Auxiliary Production Centers at Bengaluru, Bhubaneshwar, Jabalpur, Mohali, Ujjain, Faridabad and Regional Marketing Centers at New Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Ranchi, Guwahati and Chennai
  • The applicant must be a Citizen of India
  • The number of vacancies indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of the management
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD will be as per Government of India directives
  • Out of total 41 vacancies, 02 vacancies are reserved for PwBD including 01 backlog vacancy for identified categories of PwBD (OH - Orthopedic Handicapped, MD - Multiple Disabilities) in Officer (P&O) HR-18 and Officer (Audiologists) HR-19
  • If candidates not available to fill-up the post by identified category, the posts could be filled-up initially by interchanging among the other identified PWD categories. Thereafter if no suitable candidate is available, then the posts could be filled-up by a person other than a person with benchmark disability and PwBD reserve vacancy shall be carry forwarded
  • The PWBD Candidates will be adjusted against the vacancy of respective categories viz. UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category but not covered under 'Non-creamy layer' should indicate their category as 'UR'
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category must submit OBC Certificate not older than 6 months from the date of reckoning (i.e., closing date of submission of application - 10/03/2026)
  • The appointment against vacancies reserved for EWS category candidates shall be provisional and subject to the Income and Asset certificate to be verified through the proper channels
  • Candidates must produce an attested copy of Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority in the prescribed format as prescribed by Government of India (Central Government format only) in English
  • If the SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificate has been issued in a language other than English/Hindi, candidates will be required to submit a self-certified translated copy
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD) once filled in the application form will not be changed and no benefit of other category will be admissible later on
  • Persons working under Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous bodies should apply through proper channel. The candidate may send advance copy of the application but may produce NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE at the time of interview/online or written test from their present Employer failing which they will not be allowed to appear
  • The candidates called for the Interview/Skill test will be reimbursed return rail/bus fare by shortest route on production of proof of journey from their present address to the place of interview as per the rules of the Corporation. No TA will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the online examination
  • Appointment to the post will be subject to being found medically fit by the Chief Medical Officer as per the prescribed Health Standards
  • The selected candidate will be posted in any of the offices/units/production centers of ALIMCO anywhere in India including in the initial posting as per the requirement of the corporation
  • The candidates may be called at HQ for preliminary training and induction after which they may be sent to place of their initial posting
  • Candidates are liable to be transferred anywhere in India as per the requirement of the corporation
  • During recruitment process, if any information provided by the candidate is found incorrect/incomplete or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, candidature shall be rejected/cancelled without assigning any reason. Similarly, even after joining, if found that incorrect information was furnished or material information was suppressed, services shall be summarily terminated
  • The Corporation reserves the right to prepare a panel for the posts advertised to fill up future vacancies arising after the publication of this advertisement
  • Any corrigendum/addendum/errata in respect of this advertisement shall be displayed only on ALIMCO's website i.e. www.alimco.in under the head "Recruitment". No further press advertisement will be issued
  • All important information regarding this recruitment will be available on the ALIMCO website www.alimco.in and candidates are advised to visit the website periodically to get updates
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to jurisdictions of Court at Kanpur Nagar only
  • Candidates are advised to give specific, correct, full information in the application form
  • Candidates are advised to submit only one application. In case of multiple applications, from a candidate, the latest one shall be considered as final
  • Incomplete applications and applications submitted with blur/fade document proof will be summarily rejected
  • Hard copies of the application form and supporting documents will not be considered during the selection process
  • The online test examination centers will be allotted by the Corporation, and once allotted, no requests for change of the online test center will be entertained
  • After submitting the online application, the candidates should print the Computer-Generated Online Application and the Acknowledgement Slip with Application number and keep a copy for reference and records

How to Apply

  • Candidates desirous of applying to any position must apply through online mode only
  • Candidates must create their profile first by clicking on the following link: https://erp.alimco.in/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/zhrap_erecuritment#
  • The applicants can start applying from 31.01.2026 since 2:00 PM afternoon and last date for submission of the Online Application Form is 10.03.2026 by 05:00 PM
  • Common Application format has been devised by ALIMCO for all the candidates
  • The profile can be completed using the above link and feeding all the data asked for and uploading all the documents relating to Age, Caste, Educational Qualification and Experience
  • Once the profile is created, the posts advertised by ALIMCO will appear in the candidate's login. Candidates may apply for one position at a time by clicking on the respective post
  • Candidates who desire to apply for more than one post must use separate forms for each application and also pay separate fee for each application
  • The Candidates should have a unique Mobile Number and valid e-mail ID for Registration
  • Candidates must possess a valid email ID which must be entered compulsorily in the online application form and cannot be changed once submitted
  • All correspondence with candidates will be conducted through email only. ALIMCO will not be responsible for any loss or non-receipt of emails due to an invalid or incorrect email ID provided by the candidate
  • For payment of the application fee, candidates are required to visit the ALIMCO website (www.alimco.in), click on the "Career" option, and then select "Pay Recruitment Fee"
  • They will be redirected to the SBI e-Collect page, where they must click on the "GOVT/PSU/COURTS" option and search for "ALIMCO"
  • After selecting "M/s ALIMCO," candidates should choose "Recruitment Fee" from the Payment Category drop-down menu, enter the required payment details, download the payment receipt (PDF), and upload the same in the application form
  • SC/ST/PwBD and departmental candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee
  • Before starting the registration process, keep the following ready: Photograph (*.jpg, *.bmp, Size up to 200 KB), Signature (*.jpg, *.bmp, Size up to 200 KB), DOB Certificate (*.jpg, *.pdf, Size up to 2 MB), Caste Certificate if applicable (*.pdf, Size up to 2 MB), Disability Certificate if applicable (*.pdf, Size up to 2 MB), Education Certificates (*.pdf, Size up to 1 MB), Experience-related Supporting documents (*.pdf, Size up to 1 MB), Fee Receipt of transaction file if applicable (*.pdf, .jpg, size up to 2 MB)
  • Once generated OTP will be sent to an e-mail ID provided by the applicant. After submission of OTP, the candidate can complete the registration process
  • Once the registration process is done, candidates can enter the Application Form by mentioning their USER ID (capital letter) and PASSWORD respectively
  • After login, a candidate needs to fill in their profile details like Personal Data, Educational Qualification, Work Experience, etc.
  • Before submitting the application form candidate needs to click on the save option. Upon clicking on the save option pop-up screen would open for further process of submission
  • After saving the application form candidate needs to upload a successful transaction receipt (if applicable)
  • At the last of the Application process candidates can choose the POST applied
  • After filling in all the above-required details, the candidate needs to click on the "submit your application" option
  • Once successfully submitted, candidates can save/print the application form for future reference
  • Once the profile is completed, the applicant should remember their username and password for future reference
  • Candidates are advised to submit their online recruitment applications well in advance
  • If any queries regarding submission of application form, candidate can reach on e-mail: [email protected] latest by 06.03.2026 till 05:00 PM
  • For detailed information regarding eligibility and other requirements, interested candidates may visit the ALIMCO website i.e. www.alimco.in
  • The Candidate shall keep in touch with the website for further information. No separate communication will be sent by the Corporation
  • Candidates should retain printed copy of their application form as they can be asked to produce it for future reference

IIT BHU Campus Surveillance System Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Organization Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi
Department Computer Science and Engineering
Project Campus Surveillance System - Surveillance and Server Room Setup
Total Vacancies 2
Employment Type Temporary (Maximum 89 days, Co-terminus with project)

Post Name No. of Vacancy Consolidated Remuneration (Rs.) Duration

Network Operator

Field Operator

  • Good oral and written communication skills
  • Willing to work efficiently in team environment
  • Self-motivated and capable of working under challenging conditions
  • Problem-solving and technical aptitude

Age Limit

  • Upper Age Limit: 40 years
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India norms

How to Apply

Method 1: Google Form

Apply using the Google Form: Click here to apply

Method 2: Email

Send your detailed CV to: [email protected]

CV should include:

  • Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Category
  • Permanent and Correspondence Address
  • Mobile Number and Email Address
  • Educational career details (starting from High School or equivalent)
  • Job experience and relevant experience
  • Self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates
  • Details of work experience and any other relevant experience

Application Deadline

  • Last Date: 21 days from the date of advertisement (04-02-2026)
  • Applications via Google Form or Email must be submitted within 21 days

Important Information

  • The posts are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project
  • Maximum duration: 89 days for continuation and oversight of surveillance and server room setup
  • No TA/DA for interview/joining
  • Other instructions will be shared with shortlisted candidates only
  • Selection based on merit and performance in interview

Desirable Qualifications and Expertise

  • Materials Science: Sound knowledge of piezoelectric and ferroelectric materials such as PVDF, PVDF-TrFE (Polyvinylidene Fluoride), PZT (Lead Zirconate Titanate)
  • Device Fabrication: Hands-on experience with fabrication of memory devices and pressure sensor devices
  • Printing Technologies: Hands-on experience with screen printing and ink-jet printing

  • Implementing work procedures and quality standards

  • Collaborating with team members and project partners

CIMAP Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications (Any one)

  • Master’s degree of a recognized University in Hindi or English with English or Hindi as a compulsory/elective subject or as medium of examination at degree level, OR
  • Master’s degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi or English medium and English or Hindi as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level, OR
  • Master’s degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or either of the two as medium of examination and the other as compulsory/elective subject at degree level, OR
  • Recognized Diploma or Certificate course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa, OR
  • Two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in Central or State Government offices including Government of India undertakings.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Knowledge at Matriculation level of one language other than Hindi listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution.
  • Degree or Diploma in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa from a recognized University or equivalent Master’s degree.

Job Profile – Junior Hindi Translator at CIMAP

  • Assist in effective implementation of the Official Language Policy of Government of India within CIMAP.
  • Translate official correspondence, scientific documents, reports and records from English to Hindi and from Hindi to English.
  • Assist in preparation of reports, returns and compliance documents related to Hindi implementation.
  • Perform any other related duties assigned by higher authorities from time to time.

CIMAP Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Written Examination Structure

Paper-I: Objective Type (1 Hour)

Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Negative Marking

Quantitative Aptitude 25 75 (3 marks each) 1 mark deducted for each wrong answer

Paper-II: Descriptive (2 Hours, 300 Marks)

  • Paragraph writing in English and Hindi.
  • Precis writing in English and Hindi.
  • Translation from English to Hindi and from Hindi to English.
  • Standard of questions: Graduation level; medium: English and Hindi.
  • Paper-II will be evaluated only for candidates who secure minimum threshold marks in Paper-I as decided by CIMAP.
  • Final merit list will be prepared based solely on marks obtained in Paper-II.
  • Admit cards for the written examination will be uploaded on CIMAP website only; no separate postal intimation.

Tie-Breaking Rules

  • Candidate with fewer negative marks in Paper-I will be placed higher.
  • If still tied, older candidate (by date of birth) will rank higher.
  • Next, earlier acquisition date of essential qualification will be considered.
  • Finally, alphabetical order of first names will be used if required.

Application Fee – CIMAP JHT Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the recruitment portal: Go to https://recruitment.cimap.res.in or access via www.cimap.res.in under “Careers/Recruitment”.

  4. Upload documents and photograph: Upload scanned copies of required documents in the specified format and size as per portal instructions.

  6. Submit and download application: Review all details, submit the online form, and download/print the generated application form for hard copy submission.

  1. Print the application form: Take a clear printout of the application generated after successful online submission.
  2. Sign and affix photograph: Sign on each page of the printed form and paste a coloured passport-size photograph, signing across the photo as instructed.

Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.

Vacancy Details

Post Name Total
Professional Trainee in Management 1
Professional Trainee in Civil Engineering 1

Eligibility Criteria

Professional Trainee in Management:

  • Essential Qualification
    • Master's Degree in Business Management or Administration or in a relevant Management related disciplines from a recognized University or Institution.
    • Strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and presentation tools.
  • Desirable Qualification
    • Certifications in Public Policy, Governance, Project Management, or Strategic Management.
    • Academic exposure to policy analysis, organizational management.
    • Proficiency in research methodology, report writing, and policy drafting.
    • Ability to prepare policy notes, briefing papers, presentations, and analytical reports for senior Government officials.

Professional Trainee in Civil Engineering: 

  • Essential Qualification
  • Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.
  • Desirable Qualification
  • Postgraduate Diploma / Certificate course in Construction Management, Project Management or Quality Control.
  • Certification in AutoCAD, STAAD, Primavera, MS Project or other relevant civil engineering software.
  • Training in estimation, costing and tender documentation.

Salary/ Stipend

  • First Year of engagement: Rs. 20,000/-
  • Second /Final year of engagement, if extended: Rs. 22,000/-

Age Limit (as on 06-03-2026)

  • Should not exceed 30 years as on the last date of submission of Online application.

Important Dates

Notification Date 3rd February 2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 6th March 2026

Selection Process

  • If the number of applications received in large numbers, the additional screening criteria may be adopted by the Screening Committee for the purpose of shortlisting before interview.
  • The University may decide its own method of shortlisting and evaluating the performance of the candidates in interview.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts advertised for any reasons whatsoever.
  • The University reserves the right to withdraw the advertisement, either partly or wholly, at any time without assigning any reason.
  • The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of trainees.
  • Degrees obtained by the candidate should have been awarded by a recognized University / Institute.
  • The last date for submission of application by email is 6th March 2026.
  • Candidates need to RETAIN hard copy of Application Form along with all copies of certificates / educational qualification / experience / testimonials and other requisite documents in support of eligibility, which are required to be submitted at the time of interview, if shortlisted.
  • Candidates who have obtained degrees or diplomas or certificates for various courses from any Institution declared fake / derecognized by the University Grants Commission, New Delhi shall not be eligible for being considered for recruitment to the posts advertised.
  • It shall be the responsibility of the applicant to assess his own eligibility for the training field for which training is being offered in accordance with the prescribed qualifications, experience, etc. mentioned in this present advertisement. Suppression of factual information, supply of fake documents, providing false or misleading information or canvassing in any manner on the part of the applicant detected at any point of time shall lead to termination of his/her training.
  • Candidates shall have to produce original certificates relating to his/her age, qualifications, experience etc., at the time of appearing in Interview.
  • The candidate is required to be physically / online present for the interview on prescribed date, time and venue and no request for change in the schedule will be entertained.
  • No correspondence whatsoever will be entertained from the candidates regarding conduct and result of selection and reasons for not being selected.
  • Incomplete application will be out-rightly rejected. Age and qualifications will be reckoned as on the closing date of submission of online application form.
  • In case of any dispute / ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of the University shall be final.
  • If the number of applications received in large numbers, the additional screening criteria may be adopted by the Screening Committee for the purpose of shortlisting before interview.

How to Apply

  • Candidates who wish to apply are required to submit filled-in and signed application in the prescribed format as per Annexure-I. The scanned application form along with all supporting documents in a single PDF file to be sent by email to [email protected]. Hard copy submission is not required.

IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Senior Research Associate / Research Associate 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must possess a Ph.D. in Management or relevant field, demonstrating strong research competence and subject expertise.
  • An excellent academic record with First Class performance throughout, including Postgraduation in Management, Entrepreneurship, Social Sciences, or related subjects from a reputed institute or university, completed in regular mode.
  • A minimum of 2–3 years of relevant professional experience, with a strong preference for research-oriented roles.
  • Preference shall be given to candidates who have demonstrated experience in publishing high-quality research papers employing quantitative and/or qualitative research methodologies.
  • At least one research publication in a peer-reviewed journal (national or international), reflecting the ability to conduct independent research, apply appropriate methodologies, and contribute to scholarly knowledge.
  • Desirable: Experience in primary/field data collection and analysis, as well as in publishing research papers.
  • Desirable: Expertise in quantitative methods and/or qualitative research approaches, and proficiency in STATA/R and/or Atlas.ti/NVivo.

Salary/Stipend

  • The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly fellowship ranging from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 70,000/-, depending on qualifications and experience.
  • HRA will be paid as per applicable norms..

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 17-01-2026
Last date to apply 10-02-2026

Selection Process

  • Applications received in response to the advertisement will be scrutinized.
  • Shortlisted applicants will be called for a personal interaction and documents verification with original documents.
  • Based on qualifications, experience and outcome of personal interaction, the candidate will be selected.

General Information/Instructions

  • The position is purely contractual in nature.
  • The candidate selected for the above post will be appointed on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year, which may be extended further based on performance and institute requirements.
  • Incomplete/Ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Only the eligible candidates will be called for the interview.
  • Only selected candidates will be intimated. No other query will be entertained.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, if called for.
  • Canvassing through any means will be taken seriously and the candidate is liable to be rejected.
  • Applications received after the last date or those with incomplete information will be rejected.
  • For any query, candidates may write at [email protected].

How to Apply

  • Please fill the Google form mentioning the key details (photo, resume, total marks, work experience).
  • Application is to be submitted through the link: https://forms.gle/SKoQ3XUHNET6met86.

HLL Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager Internal Audit 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for HLL Internal Audit Recruitment 2026 is 5 posts. Category-wise distribution is as follows:

Name of the Post Total Post
Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager 5

Posting Locations: New Delhi / Lucknow / Guwahati / Mumbai / Thiruvananthapuram.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification (Essential)

  • MBA (Finance / Systems / Operations / Hospital Administration) OR
  • B.Pharm OR
  • B.Tech.

2. Post-Qualification Experience

  • Deputy Manager: Minimum 2 years of experience in Internal Audit / Finance / Accounts or in relevant area as specified in the tasks for the position. Preference for experience in Pharma / Diagnostic Laboratory operations.
  • Assistant Manager: Minimum 1 year of experience in Internal Audit / Finance / Accounts or relevant area.

3. Age Limit

  • Deputy Manager: Maximum 40 years as on 01.01.2026.
  • Assistant Manager: Maximum 37 years as on 01.01.2026.
  • The crucial date for determining age limit is same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience.

4. Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives.
  • SC/ST candidates must submit caste certificate in prescribed format for Government of India posts.
  • OBC candidates must submit Non-Creamy Layer OBC certificate in prescribed format.

Job Tasks / Responsibilities

  • Evaluate adequacy and effectiveness of internal control systems.
  • Conduct financial, operational and compliance audits as per approved audit plan.
  • Ensure adherence to internal policies, statutory regulations and industry standards.
  • Identify system gaps or weaknesses and recommend corrective improvements.
  • Document audit observations and present findings to management.
  • Support special assignments including investigations and management reviews.
  • Audit Pharmacy / Diagnostic Laboratory operations.
  • Work on Quality Control, Quality Management Systems and Quality Assurance.

Selection Process

  • All information submitted in application will be verified with original documents at interview stage.
  • If any information is found false, incorrect or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage.
  • HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process or not fill any/all posts, and number of vacancies may increase or decrease as per organizational requirements.
  • The decision of Management regarding selection will be final.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

How To Apply

Candidates must apply online through the specified Google Form by following these steps:

  1. Access the Google Form using the link provided in the advertisement (“Click here to Apply”).
  2. Download the prescribed job application form from the link in the form or from the HLL website.
  3. Fill the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file (handwritten applications will not be accepted).
  4. Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form (maximum upload size 10 MB per file).
  5. Attach additional supporting documents (CV, educational and experience certificates, latest salary slip) in PDF or Word format, each file under 10 MB.
  6. Select the correct post applied for in the form to ensure proper processing.
  7. Submit the form on or before 11/02/2026; late submissions will not be considered.

Crucial Date for Age & Experience Calculation Same as cut-off date specified for qualification and post qualification experience

  • Before applying, candidates must ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Applications not in prescribed format will not be considered and no separate communication will be sent.

Application Fee

Details regarding any application fee are not mentioned in this advertisement.

  • Deputy Manager: Basic pay range Rs. 25,000 – 45,000 per month; approximate gross salary Rs. 49,700 per month (Non-Metro) at minimum of scale; annual CTC approx. Rs. 7.14 lakhs.
  • Assistant Manager: Basic pay range Rs. 20,000 – 40,000 per month; approximate gross salary Rs. 39,760 per month (Non-Metro) at minimum of scale; annual CTC approx. Rs. 5.77 lakhs.
